Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a CBRE Sr. Data Analyst, you will perform a variety of analyses to ensure that recommendations and business conclusions are backed by sound data findings and thorough data research.

This job is part of the Data Science & Analytics job function. They are responsible for reviewing data that supports improving effectiveness and predicting outcomes to develop business intelligence.

What You’ll Do


Coordinate data aggregation and curate complex reports using various business intelligence and reporting applications.
Perform ad-hoc, strategic review of structured and unstructured data, reflecting global real estate markets and the operations of real estate assets.
Develop data structures and pipelines to organize, collect, cleanse, and standardize information to generate insights and address reporting needs.
Define complex data requirements and gather information using judgment and statistical tests.
Use programming and evaluation tools, including open-source programs to plan models and extract insights.
Identify opportunities to maximize data usage. Apply modeling and optimization methods to develop new strategies and improve business performance.
Develop ad-hoc reporting based on the review of existing data sources.
Exhibit rigor, judgment, and ability to present a highly detailed 'data story' to many levels of the organization.
Confirm the quality and integrity of new and existing data sources.
Collaborate with the agile development team to provide recommendations and communications on enhancing existing or new processes and programs.
Apply general knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish assigned tasks and solve routine problems.
Have a broad knowledge of one's own job discipline and some knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
Impact the quality of own work and the work of others on the team; work within guidelines and policies.
Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. May convince to reach an agreement.
Work primarily within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
Explain complex information to others in straightforward situations.


What You’ll Need


Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. A combination of experience and education will be considered in lieu of a degree. Master’s degree preferred.
Understanding of existing procedures and standards to solve slightly complex problems.
Ability to understand possible solutions using technical experience to apply appropriate judgment and precedents.
In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.


Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Our Values in Hiring

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

Disclaimers

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

About CBRE Group, Inc.

CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2024 revenue). The company has more than 140,000 employees (including Turner & Townsend employees) serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage serving, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Please visit our website at www.cbre.com.

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Sr. Data Analyst position is $120,000 annually [or $57.70 per hour] and the maximum salary for the Sr. Data Analyst position is $130,000 annually [or $62.50 per hour]. The compensation yield to a successful candidate will depend on their skills, qualifications, and experience. Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance

Equal Employment Opportunity: CBRE is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We have a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Candidate Accommodations: CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Overview

Are you passionate about using cutting-edge technologies & capabilities across Microsoft’s Intelligent Data Platform? Do you strive to improve customer experience and business performance? Do you like to affect change at a billion-dollar global user scale company, and deliver improvements that result in material impact? If yes, we want you in Monetization and Business Planning (MBP)! 

Our organization directs the commercial portfolio’s pricing, packaging, licensing, channel, and monetization strategies. As a Senior Data Analyst in the Monetization Strategy and Licensing team, you will act as a strategic partner to functional teams, responsible for improving operational efficiency by delivering insights and data models that impact how go-to-market decisions are made. You will become an integral part of how we scale Microsoft’s monetization strategy. You will develop your career, forge effective cross-functional relationships, take on progressively broader responsibilities, and establish yourself as a strategic advisor. You can expect to have sponsorship for your work, support for your professional development, and encouragement to bring your authentic self to work.      

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

Responsibilities


Lead AI and Automation systems performance reporting, leveraging telemetry from our automation systems to provide insights to our partners.
Partner with our business and engineering leaders to set up KPIs to measure effectiveness of AI automation
Identify connections across data sources and contribute to the development of analytical frameworks as you develop an understanding of the business.
Leverage your understanding of the business to examine projects through a customer and/or stakeholder-oriented focus.
Identify and leverage appropriate sources of data and contribute to the development of recommendations.
Determine appropriate analytical techniques and critically evaluate assumptions.
Share and simplify relevant findings and insights and ensure presented results are accessible and accurate.
Support and/or consult with other teams and identify relevant data-driven recommendations.
Recommend efficiency improvements for core work and evaluate the viability of automated data collection methods.
Understand linkages between analytical models and contribute to the review process—and, if the model is deemed deficient—seek to determine why.
Work within and across teams to ensure alignment in data sources and processes and engage stakeholders to act on opportunities.
Stay abreast of privacy requirements and ensure data have undergone appropriate reviews.
Embody our culture and values.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications


Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 2+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis
OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 4+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis


OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications


Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 4+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis
OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 6+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis


OR equivalent experience.
4+ years of experience in building PowerBI dashboards and 2+ years of experience in building semantic models on Microsoft Fabric.
Experience building extract transform and load (ETL/ELT) solutions in Azure or any other cloud platform.


Data Analytics IC4 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $106,400 - $203,600 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $137,600 - $222,600 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:

https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. Title: Data Analyst Sr - Quality and Safety
Description:
Work Location: Downtown Seattle (Hybrid – 3 days/week on-site)

Supports the Hospital and Enterprise Analytics' vision, mission, and strategic initiatives by using technical expertise to design, create and develop analytical solutions and by providing internal consultation and project management. The incumbent provides leadership in the facilitating and gathering business requirements, and provides knowledge in business/clinical processes, analytical expertise, technical programming skills, and substantial leadership skills in working with key stakeholders, end users and project team members. This position identifies and resolves issues throughout the development of analytical solutions, and is accountable for identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in workflow processes in the implementation of these solutions. Primary responsibility is the design, creation and deployment of analytical solutions for Executive leadership and other key stakeholders within the SCH organization. The incumbent is responsible for frequently taking a formal or an informal lead on project tasks, and leads efforts to design and implement analytic solutions, including reports, dashboards, and views from a wide range of existing data sources, and provides leadership in evaluating and optimizing these solutions. The incumbent also assures integrity of the data for current and future use in strategic initiatives, continuous quality improvement efforts and hospital goals, and for insuring the sustainability and adaptability of all developed solutions.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor's Degree in Health Science, Computer Science, Math, Business or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience/technical training that demonstrates analytical and technical competency.

Minimum five (5) years experience in progressively more responsible work as a data analyst, developer or equivalent.

Experience in data extraction/integration/aggregation using SQL, R or python.

Expert in use of data visualization for non-technical audiences.

Experience with at least one notable BI reporting tool (e.g., Tableau, QlikView, PowerBI, Business Objects, html/d3).

Experience working with source control tools and version management.

Required Credentials

N/A.

Preferred

Experience working with senior and executive leaders.

Experience with EHR Data (Epic)

Quality and safety related experience.

Experience working as a data analyst within a healthcare setting.

Experience with clinical, hospital and/or financial applications and/or systems.

Experience as a member of a delivery team supporting integrated analytics products and solutions for a wide range of customer groups.

Uses reasonable and basic statistical analyses to make comparisons and detect trends, communicate insights.

Utilizes established data analysis models and tools for analyzing qualitative or quantitative data.

Compensation Range

$118,174.00 - $177,262.00 per year

Salary Information

This compensation range was calculated based on full-time employment (2080 hours worked per calendar year). Offers are determined by multiple factors including equity, skills, experience, and expertise, and may vary within the range provided.

Disclaimer for Out of State Applicants

This compensation range is specific to Seattle, positions located outside of Seattle may be compensated differently depending on various factors.

Benefits Information

Seattle Children’s offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 403(b), life insurance, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more. Additional details on our benefits can be found on our website www.seattlechildrens.org/careers/benefits.

Our founding promise to the community is as valid today as it was over a century ago: we will care for all children in our region, regardless of the families’ ability to pay. Together, we deliver superior patient care, advance new discoveries and treatments through pediatric research, and serve as the pediatric and adolescent, academic medical center for Washington, Alaska, Montana and Idaho – the largest region of any children’s hospital in the country.

Title: Data Analyst, Global Operations
Description:
At Meta, we are experiencing an extraordinary wave of innovation in automation and intelligent tools that is transforming how we drive impact through data & analytics. As a data analyst in global operations, you’ll have the opportunity to combine your analytical expertise with an AI-first mindset to design and deploy analytical solutions that drive strategic decision-making and operational efficiency at a global scale. You will partner with operational, data science, data engineering, and product teams globally to optimize processes, automate workflows, provide data-driven insights, and uplift the team’s proficiency in leveraging new technologies.

Data Analyst, Global Operations Responsibilities:


Partner with operations, data science, engineering, and product teams to address complex business challenges through AI-first analytical strategies and solutions
Build, maintain, and optimize scalable data pipelines, dashboards, automated reports, and self-service tools for teams across Meta
Champion the adoption and integration of AI tooling within analytics workflows, educating and uplifting team proficiency in modern solutions and innovative thinking
Communicate complex insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, influencing decisions and business outcomes
Continuously explore and experiment with emerging technologies and automation methods to advance the team’s analytics offerings


Minimum Qualifications:


7+ years of experience in analytics, operations, product, engineering, or related fields—ideally within deadline-focused tech environments or consulting
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, or equivalent practical experience
Advanced proficiency in SQL, and experience with Python, for data analysis and automation
Proven experience building and deploying scalable data pipelines and productionizing dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Tableau)
Track record of proactively using AI tools to drive productivity and innovation across projects and teams (bonus for championing AI adoption and education within teams)
Solid understanding of statistical analysis with practical application to real-world business problems
Demonstrated ability to independently manage analytics projects end-to-end, from problem definition to business adoption and impact measurement


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s degree or higher in a quantitative discipline such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field
Hands-on experience with AI/ML model development, deployment, and/or integration


About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Title: Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a CBRE Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst you will be responsible for conducting advanced research, data mining, reporting and interpretation of company performance metrics.

This job is part of the Data Science & Analytics job function. They are responsible for reviewing data that supports improving effectiveness and predicting outcomes to develop business intelligence.

What You’ll Do


Generate and review reports using aggregate data from multiple sources to assist in creating a complete evaluation, improvement, or recommendation.
Review the accuracy of information provided and respond to escalated requests from management and vendors.
Understand and work with advanced scenario planning tools and models. Investigate new trends in general business conditions.
Identify opportunities for large improvements among the clients and company.
Work with personnel from other departments and information technology groups to facilitate successful project implementations.
Review the maintenance and reporting of benchmarks and performance metrics.
Act as subject matter expert for key systems and processes and day-to-day functions.
Apply general knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish assigned tasks and solve routine problems.
Have a broad knowledge of own job discipline and some knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
Lead by example and model behaviors consistent with CBRE RISE values. May convince to reach an agreement.
Impact the quality of own work and the work of others on the team.
Work primarily within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
Explain complex information to others in straightforward situations.


What You’ll Need


Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
Understanding of existing procedures and standards to solve slightly complex problems.
Ability to analyze possible solutions using technical experience to apply appropriate judgment and precedents.
In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.


Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Our Values in Hiring

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

Disclaimers

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

About CBRE Group, Inc.

CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2024 revenue). The company has more than 140,000 employees (including Turner & Townsend employees) serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage serving, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Please visit our website at www.cbre.com.

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst position is $120,000 annually [or $57.70 per hour] and the maximum salary for the Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst position is $130,000 annually [or $62.50 per hour]. The compensation yield to a successful candidate will depend on their skills, qualifications, and experience. Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance

Equal Employment Opportunity: CBRE is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We have a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Candidate Accommodations: CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

Title: Senior People Analytics Data Analyst
Description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to join our Human Resources People Analytics team. In this strategic role, you will leverage your analytical expertise and problem-solving skills to transform raw data into actionable insights, enabling HR and business leaders to optimize processes, enhance performance, and drive organizational efficiency. Your work will be pivotal in shaping data-driven HR strategies and fostering organizational success. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design advanced data models and visualizations that contribute to our mission of operational excellence.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Key Responsibilities


Analyze HR data to deeply understand processes, trends, and opportunities, ensuring findings are actionable and aligned with organizational goals.
Design and implement advanced data visualizations and dashboards using tools like Tableau or PowerBI to drive strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with HR and business teams to identify to develop metrics that promote excellence and optimize workflows.
Perform detailed data analysis and validation to ensure accuracy and reliability of insights provided to stakeholders.
Proactively address challenges, offering innovative, data-driven solutions that enhance HR processes and outcomes.
Communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively, ensuring all stakeholders understand implications and actions.
Develop and maintain data documentation, run books, and data dictionaries in collaboration with HR data governance.
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in people analytics and apply them to enhance our workforce strategies.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field or equivalent in years of exp.
8+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or related domains.
Expertise in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI).
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide impactful solutions.
Excellent attention to detail, ensuring recommendations are accurate and actionable.
Strong communication skills for effective interaction with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A mindset of ownership and curiosity, with the drive to understand data within its broader business context.


Preferred Qualifications


Solid experience in HR analytics, with a deep understanding of its impact on talent management and policy decisions.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, R, Etc).
Experience with enterprise systems such as Workday and Cornerstone.
Familiarity with big data platforms and cloud technologies.


Special Mentions


Relocation assistance provided for qualified candidates.


Base Pay Range For

WA applicants is $134,434.00 - $188,207.25

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)

Be a subject matter expert on marketing measurement.
Leverage analytical expertise and sound statistical reasoning to deliver clear, meaningful insights to complex, ambiguous questions.
Build and maintain Tableau dashboards, communicating trends and opportunities to stakeholders.

Job Description

Data Analyst – RFQ, Proposal & Business Performance Analytics

________________________________________

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to support customer’s Program Management and Business Development organization. This role will be responsible for tracking and analyzing the end-to-end opportunity pipeline from RFQ receipt through quote submission, negotiation, contract award, and program kickoff.

The analyst will transform business development, estimating, proposal, and program data into actionable insights that improve bid management, enhance forecasting accuracy, increase win rates, and provide leadership visibility into opportunity conversion performance.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, experience managing large datasets, and the ability to develop executive scorecards, dashboards, and business performance analytics.

Industry Experience


Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline, with 3–7 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or performance analytics roles.
Proven experience working with large datasets and developing executive dashboards, scorecards, and business performance reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and SQL.
Prior experience supporting Program Management, Business Development, Estimating, Proposal Management, Sales Operations, or RFQ-to-Award processes is highly desirable.
Preference will be given to candidates with experience in the aerospace, manufacturing, defense, or industrial sectors, including exposure to opportunity pipeline management, win-rate analysis, forecasting, and KPI framework development.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to transform complex business data into actionable insights and leadership-ready recommendations.


Key Responsibilities: Summary of Responsibilities & Skills


Track and manage the complete RFQ-to-Award lifecycle, including RFQ receipt, quote submission, negotiations, award decisions, and program handoff.
Collect, consolidate, validate, and maintain opportunity, proposal, and award data from multiple business systems.
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting tools that provide visibility into pipeline health and business performance.
Analyze RFQ volumes, proposal activity, quote turnaround times, award rates, win/loss performance, and revenue opportunities.
Perform month-over-month, quarter-over-quarter, and year-over-year trend analysis to identify business growth patterns and performance gaps.
Generate actionable insights on customer activity, opportunity conversion rates, business segment performance, and program trends.
Create executive-level reports and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and PowerPoint for leadership reviews.
Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as RFQs received, quotes submitted, proposals pending, awards won, pipeline value, and forecasted revenue.
Conduct comparative analysis across customers, product lines, business sectors, manufacturing sites, and program portfolios.
Support forecasting activities by providing visibility into near-term awards, future revenue potential, and business growth opportunities.
Collaborate closely with Program Management, Estimating, Sales, Engineering, and Business Development teams to improve data quality and reporting effectiveness.
Identify bottlenecks in the proposal and quotation process and recommend process improvements to enhance responsiveness and win rates.
Standardize KPI definitions, reporting methodologies, and dashboard formats to enable consistent reporting across the organization.
Drive continuous improvement through automation of reports, enhancement of analytics capabilities, and development of scalable business intelligence solutions.
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to management to support strategic decision-making and business growth initiatives.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in Excel (advanced), SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and PowerPoint for data analysis, dashboard development, executive reporting, and business performance monitoring.
Experience working with large, complex datasets, including data extraction, cleansing, transformation, validation, and trend analysis.
Ability to develop and maintain RFQ-to-Award dashboards, KPI scorecards, pipeline reports, and revenue forecasting models.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, conversion drivers, business risks, and growth opportunities.
Experience performing win/loss analysis, opportunity pipeline tracking, proposal performance measurement, and business forecasting.
Effective data storytelling and executive communication skills, capable of translating complex data into actionable insights and leadership recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across Program Management, Business Development, Estimating, Engineering, and Operations teams.
Continuous improvement mindset with experience standardizing reporting processes, automating analytics, improving data quality, and implementing scalable business intelligence solutions.

Position Summary

This is the full-time conversion role for Data Analyst Interns who have successfully completed their internship in F5's Data Analyst Internship program and have earned their Bachelor's or Master's degree. Current or recent Data Analyst Interns in F5's internship program who have successfully completed their internship

Understanding of basic descriptive statistics and data distributions (e.g., counts, rates, trends, outliers)
Solid understanding of data concepts (e.g., data quality, databases, schemas)
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail; ability to follow data lineage and identify root causes of data issues
Strong verbal and written communication skills (able to summarize findings for both technical and non-technical audiences)
Ability to learn quickly and comfort tackling complex, cross-system problems with curiosity and initiative
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deliver on deadlines in a collaborative environment
Proficiency with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) required; Tableau experience is a plus
Familiarity with SQL, Python, or R for analysis is preferred but not required
Interest in enterprise data concepts (data domains, data quality, governance, master/reference data)
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Experience with F5's systems and business processes (gained during internship)

Successfully completed a Summer 2026 internship with F5.

Strong performance and positive feedback from internship managers and mentors

Seamless Transition: Move from internship to full-time with continuity in your team, projects, and growth trajectory

Collaborative Culture: Work alongside experienced analysts, engineers, and leaders in an inclusive, innovative environment
Career Growth: Excel in your role and build a long-term career path with F5, including opportunities for advancement and specialization
Inclusive Community: Be part of F5's diverse, people-first culture where individual contributions are valued

Competitive salary commensurate with experience and market conditions

Professional development and continuous learning opportunities

Hybrid work environment with periodic in-office collaboration in Seattle

Access to F5's employee resource groups and community

In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.

WWRR includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WWRR, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for leveraging data and analytics to identify gaps, measure effectiveness, and drive decisions to improve the returns experience. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. You will own end-to-end project execution for initiatives within your focus area, including influencing partner teams, driving prioritization on the roadmap, and working with tech to resolve issues you surface. You will leverage SQL and analytical tools to support the projects you own. Additionally, you should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impact the bottom line of the business.

Key job responsibilities


Use data and analytics to identify operational gaps, drive business decisions, and own resolution with partner teams.
Employ the appropriate tools and methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse, and help reduce bad debt
Analyze customer behavioral patterns and develop policy change recommendations based on findings and drive implementation with partner teams
Leverage data to influence partner teams and drive prioritization to get issues resolved
Write SQL queries and leverage data to surface gaps, track project health, and report on outcomes
Work closely with business, engineering, and partner teams to align on priorities and deliver against your focus area


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of program or project management experience
3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
2+ years of SQL experience
Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams

Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology

Experience building automated reporting or dashboards using BI tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, or similar)
Experience managing stakeholder communications and driving alignment across multiple teams

GENERAL SUMMARY

Under the specific direction of a senior analyst, supervisor or manager; you will collect, process, map, and analyze data to support the loading of accurate data for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system implementation. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to determine how data will be transformed from the current PLM system to the new PLM system and verify and validate the data loads for accuracy to ensure a successful implementation of the PLM. In this role you will be involved with data clean-up in the PLM of data objects and the correction and maintenance of attributes and other information; you will partner with business users to implement data updates in accordance with existing business processes where applicable. You will review systems requirements and business processes, codes, tests, debugs and implement software solutions for the PLM system. You will be expected to operate in an individual contributor role that requires the use of judgment in applying expertise and is expected to work independently with minimal supervision.




PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Support the Project Lead/Work Stream Lead for Bills of Material, Parts and associated documentation
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs and business objectives
Complete validation and verification of data for multiple loads of data into the PLM tool.
Support and complete data clean-up by submitting requirements and collaborating with IT for PLM and ERP data clean-up and maintenance following the IT process for mass updates of data.
Develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel
Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and insights

Remembrance, Resolution, Reconciliation, Restoration, Renewal Job Summary About the Position: As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for the efficient extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of data from various sources, creating and maintaining documentation of all data sources, and developing insightful data visualizations using business intelligence tools such as Power Bi. Your role is essential in ensuring that data is accurate, accessible, and actionable for informed decision-making for all key stakeholders. About The Position

Essential Duties


ETL (Extract, Transform, Load):
Design and implement ETL processes to extract data from diverse sources, transform it into a usable format, and load it into databases or data warehouses.
Collaborate with data engineers to optimize ETL pipelines for scalability, reliability, and performance.
Monitor and troubleshoot ETL processes to ensure data quality and consistency.
Automate ETL workflows to streamline data integration and reduce manual intervention.
Data Visualizations:
Create interactive and visually appealing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI, or other relevant software.
Connect Power BI to various data sources, including databases, APIs, and online services.
Transform raw data into meaningful insights, trends, and actionable information.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their reporting needs and provide tailored Power BI
Data Governance:
Implement and enforce data governance practices, including data quality standards, data lineage, and metadata management.
Ensure compliance with data security and privacy regulations, including access controls and encryption.
Establish data retention policies and manage data archiving and purging processes.
Provide data-driven strategies that enhance operational efficiency and drive improvements.
Documentation and Training:
Document ETL processes, API endpoints, and Power BI reports for knowledge sharing and troubleshooting.
Collaborate with department Data Manager to provide training and support to end-users and stakeholders on data access, API usage, and Power BI reporting.
Continuous Learning and Innovation:
Stay updated with the latest industry trends, tools, and techniques in data analysis and visualization.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation to enhance data analysis efficiency.
Performs other related duties as assigned.

Required

Education and Experience:


2-5 years experience or related work and/or Bachelor’s degree in a technical or other applicable discipline.
Proven experience as a Data Analyst or similar role, with a track record of successfully delivering data-driven insights.
Proven experience in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar (non-Excel) software.
Proven experience in ETL development, including proficiency with ETL tools (e.g., Apache NiFi, Python)
Understanding of data governance principles, data security, and compliance regulations.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Ability to adapt to evolving data technologies and industry best practices.


Preferred


Programming skills, including knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation.
Expertise in API development and management, with knowledge of RESTful API design principles.
Demonstrated experience with one or more of the following modern data management concepts - data lakes, nonrelational databases (NoSQL), cloud hosting (AWS), serverless storage or automated database recovery
Project management.

Title: Sr. Business Analyst (Customer Success)
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. BUSINESS ANALYST (CUSTOMER SUCCESS)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, delivers low-latency broadband internet worldwide, connecting consumers in remote and underserved areas. The team drives consumer adoption and expansion by analyzing market trends, optimizing acquisition strategies, and informing pricing and retention initiatives. This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with a blend of quantitative skills and curiosity for market dynamics, capable of turning complex data into actionable strategies for consumer growth.

Responsibilities


Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort performance, using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities
Develop forecasting models for subscriber growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators
Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement
Conduct market research and price analysis, evaluating elasticity, competitive pricing, and promotional impacts to recommend optimizations that drive revenue and affordability
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and sales teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning
Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection for consumer use cases, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis
Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making
Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree
5+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations
3+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
1+ years of experience leading projects


Preferred Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
Experience with forecasting, financial metrics (e.g., LTV, CAC), or pricing analysis
Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)
Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)
Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention
Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)
Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders


Additional Requirements


Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed
This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range

Level 3: $120,000.00 - $175,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. Company events that celebrate the spirit of Pokémon.

Information Analyst III, Workforce Management

Position Summary

The Information Analyst III, Workforce Management is responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights that support workforce planning, operational performance, business decision-making, and regulatory compliance. This role partners closely with leaders and stakeholders across the organization to identify reporting needs, analyze trends, improve data quality, and develop scalable analytics solutions.

As a senior analyst, this position leads complex analytical initiatives, establishes reporting standards and best practices, mentors less experienced analysts, and drives data-informed decisions that support organizational goals. The Information Analyst III serves as a trusted advisor for workforce analytics and business intelligence needs across multiple functional areas.

This is a hybrid role, located on our campus in Mountlake Terrace WA

What You'll Do


Partner with business stakeholders to understand complex business challenges, define reporting requirements, and deliver data-driven solutions that improve operational performance, reduce costs, support compliance, and enhance workforce effectiveness.
Design, develop, document, maintain, and optimize reports, dashboards, data models, and analytical solutions that support workforce management and organizational decision-making.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and actionable insights.
Develop automated reporting and dashboard solutions that improve visibility into key workforce, operational, and business performance metrics.
Validate and peer review analytical work, reports, and dashboards to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to established standards.
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting processes, operational databases, and overall analytical efficiency; recommend and implement solutions.
Lead complex analytical projects and cross-functional initiatives, coordinating efforts to achieve project goals and measurable business outcomes.
Analyze and resolve complex reporting and data issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions.
Create and maintain technical documentation, reporting standards, data definitions, and process documentation.
Provide mentorship, guidance, and training to analysts and business partners on reporting tools, methodologies, and best practices.
Assist with project planning by estimating resource requirements, effort, timelines, and project complexity.
Develop workforce analytics, forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and operational performance reporting to support workforce management strategies.


What You’ll Need

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business Analytics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; or four (4) years of equivalent work experience.
Five (5) years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Experience working with large datasets, data validation, and analytical problem-solving.
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions that support business decision-making.


Preferred Qualifications


Three (3) or more years of experience in healthcare, health insurance, workforce management, or a related industry.
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large-scale data environments.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Experience with cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern analytics environments.
Experience developing workforce analytics, staffing models, forecasting solutions, scheduling analytics, or operational performance reporting.
Knowledge of contact center operations, workforce planning, or healthcare operational analytics.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Advanced knowledge of SQL, reporting tools, business intelligence platforms, and data analytics methodologies.
Strong understanding of relational databases, data structures, data governance, and reporting best practices.
Excellent analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.
Demonstrated ability to lead analytical initiatives, manage competing priorities, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Proven ability to mentor analysts and promote best practices in reporting, analytics, and data management.
Knowledge of healthcare operations, healthcare data, health insurance concepts, and workforce management principles.
Ability to translate business needs into scalable analytical and reporting solutions that drive measurable results.

At Premera, data plays a critical role in improving the health and well-being of our members and communities. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to influence strategic decisions, improve workforce effectiveness, and partner with leaders across the organization to deliver meaningful business outcomes through analytics and insight.

Retirement programs, including a 401K employer match and, believe it or not, a pension plan that is vested after 3 years of service.

Generous paid time off to reenergize.

Employee recognition program to celebrate anniversaries, team accomplishments, and more.

It's a data-driven world. Be part of a rotational development program that harnesses the power of data and cutting-edge technology to analyze performance trends, identify opportunities, and keep Liberty Mutual moving forward.

 

The Details

Do you love telling stories with data? Are you looking to jump into the broad world of analytics? Are you looking to jumpstart your career with a global Fortune 100 company?

Here’s a fantastic opportunity to hone your strategic, technical, and analytical skills while learning the ins and outs of the fast-paced insurance industry.

The Analyst Development Program (ADP) helps aspiring graduates (like you!) develop a broad knowledge base through a curated training curriculum, an established mentorship program, and rotational assignments tailored to your developmental goals. Through both collaborative and independent work, you will begin your career ready to make an impact with your foundation of business acumen, analytical toolbelt, and professional skills all with the support of your instant network in our vast analyst community.

Qualifications

What you’ve got:


You have 0-2 years of related professional experience. 
You hold, or will be completing, a Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Business, MIS, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related discipline.
A strong academic record with a cumulative 3.0 GPA preferred.
You possess strong analytical and quantitative skills that fuel your passion for identifying and investigating patterns and trends. 
You possess strong interpersonal, communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
You have experience with, or a strong desire to learn, technical tools and platforms, including Microsoft Excel; data and analytics technologies such as SQL, Python, R, SAS, and Snowflake; data visualization tools such as Power BI; and emerging AI tools and techniques used to support data analysis and business insights.
You must have permanent work authorization in the United States.


We encourage interested candidates to apply promptly, as the role may be unposted once we’ve received a sufficient number of candidates. We conduct interviews and extend offers on a rolling basis.

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

 

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

 

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

Title: Revenue Operations Analyst
Description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive OKR and revenue dashboards across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or Finance
3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience querying large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery); comfort navigating messy, high-volume data is essential
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools


Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance


Emotional Health


Paid sabbatical program after four years
Paid family and paternity leave
Annual educational stipend
Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement
CFA exam stipend
Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program
Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days


Social Health


Matching gifts program
Employee resource groups
Subsidized emergency childcare
Dependent Care FSA
Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events


Financial Health


401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program
Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000
Target annual bonus percentage: 10%


Working Conditions

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

We are excited to get to know you and your background. Concerned that you might not meet every requirement? We encourage you to still apply as you might be the right candidate for the role or other roles at PitchBook.

Title: Real Estate Data Analyst
Description:
Overview

Global Workplace Services (GWS) plans, delivers, and operates Microsoft's global real estate portfolio of approximately 40 million square feet (SF). Trusted data is the foundation for how GWS monitors performance, plans its portfolio, and makes enterprise real estate decisions, and that foundation is only as reliable as the cleanliness and integrity of the data behind it.

The Real Estate Data Analyst is the accountable owner of the day-to-day data-management and data-quality function for the GWS real estate portfolio, consolidating the hands-on data cleanliness, validation, reference-data, and single-source-of-truth work into one role, with supporting analytics and reporting as a secondary component. It executes against the analytics standards defined by the Portfolio Strategy, Transactions & Analytics lead, while data-foundation strategy and architecture sit with GWS Platforms leadership.

Responsibilities

Data Governance – Collection, Cleanliness, & Validation


Own and run the data validation framework across GWS real estate data: attendance & headcount data and forecasts; audit, map, and clean up portfolio, projects, buildings, lease, and space records across source systems, and reconcile discrepancies to a single source of truth.
Maintain business reference values and mappings for Finance (cost centers, internal orders, and plant codes) and the business (taxonomy, approvals, and status values), and support building-to-plant-code cleanup and SAP alignment.
Own the recurring audit, mapping, and cleanup cycles; apply and refine validation logic; and identify, flag, and correct errors while reducing duplicate data entry.
Maintain consistent metric definitions, data dictionaries, and reference materials, and support adherence to data governance, reporting standards, and compliance.
Track and report data-quality measures such as error rates, correction cycle times, and completeness so data health is visible to stakeholders.


Supporting Analytics & Reporting


Produce and maintain recurring reporting cadences (for example, weekly and monthly attendance and utilization reports and quarterly refreshes) and build and maintain dashboards, primarily in Power BI.
Supply clean datasets and supporting analysis and visuals to the Portfolio Strategy, Transactions & Analytics function for scenario planning, demand planning, and transaction-pipeline reporting, working to the specifications that role defines.
Contribute data, visuals, and analysis to Portfolio Insights sessions and business reviews such as QBRs.


Data Systems, Automation & Partnership


Partner with GWS data, systems, and technology teams to maintain the health, accuracy, and scalability of portfolio analytics data, including CAFM and IWMS and space-management systems and integrated data pipelines.
Identify and support automation of validation and error-correction, including AI-assisted or rules-based approaches, to reduce cycle time and manual effort.
Partner with Portfolio Managers, the Portfolio Strategy, Transactions & Analytics lead, Finance, Procurement, GWS Technology, and the Workplace Research & Standards team to source data, align on definitions, and communicate clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.


Qualifications

Required / Minimum Qualifications


Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 2+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis OR equivalent experience.


Additional Or Preferred Qualifications


Experience with data quality, data validation, data governance, or master-data management, including auditing, mapping, and cleanup of business data.
Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python or R for data extraction, cleanup, and analysis.
Familiarity with corporate real estate and workplace data (attendance, occupancy, utilization, space, lease, and projects data) and with CAFM/IWMS, space-management, or ERP systems such as SAP.
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring reporting cadences in Power BI, or comparable platforms such as Tableau or Looker.
Attention to detail and the ability to translate data into clear, decision-ready insights; demonstrated interest in the corporate real estate industry.
Bachelor's Degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Finance, Real Estate, Information Systems, Business Management, or related field AND 1+ year(s) of experience in data analytics, data management, business intelligence, reporting, or real estate, portfolio, or workplace-occupancy analysis, OR 2+ years of equivalent experience.
Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools, including Microsoft Excel and Power BI.

Analytical Skills

Data Visualization & Business Intelligence

Business Technology Optimization

Data Management

Title: Senior Legal Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Overview

At MoFo, we couldn’t write our own success story without yours. Ready to write your story?

Join MoFo as a SENIOR LEGAL BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE ANALYST in our Seattle office!

https://www.mofo.com/offices

About The Role

Develop, implement, and support business intelligence, data analytics, and reporting solutions for legal matters and strategic client initiatives. Work closely with attorneys, clients, eDiscovery professionals, and other stakeholders to translate complex legal and business requirements into actionable insights and scalable analytical workflows. Serve as a subject matter resource for data analysis, visualization, and data-driven decision-making.

Business Intelligence and Data Analytics


Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and scorecards for legal, financial, operational, and matter data.
Analyze large and complex datasets and perform ad hoc analysis in response to client, attorney, and leadership requests.
Develop and standardize key performance indicators, metrics, visual templates, and reporting conventions.
Develop self-service analytics capabilities that consolidate data, dashboards, and documentation for stakeholder use.
Replace manual, spreadsheet-based reporting with automated solutions and quantify the resulting impact.


Data Management and Technical Solutions


Develop and optimize data models, queries, integrations, and ETL/ELT processes using SQL and comparable tools.
Work with technology teams and data owners to integrate disparate systems into reliable analytical datasets.
Establish data definitions, business rules, lineage, and quality controls, and resolve data-quality issues proactively.
Follow structured development and change-management practices, including development, test, and production promotion.
Develop solutions in accordance with firm technology, security, confidentiality, and data governance requirements.


Legal and Client Analytics


Partner with attorneys and legal professionals to translate matter and client objectives into analytical requirements.
Develop analytics for matter activity, litigation and discovery metrics, financial performance, and resource utilization.
Analyze outside counsel and vendor spend to surface cost trends, budget variances, and optimization opportunities.
Develop customized reporting for strategic clients and extend successful solutions to additional matters and firm functions.
Prepare executive-ready summaries and KPI scorecards for firm and client senior leadership.


Artificial Intelligence and Innovation

TITLE: Decision Support Analyst

JOB OVERVIEW: The Decision Support Analyst supports organizational decision-making by collecting, validating, analyzing, and interpreting healthcare, finance, cost accounting, and operational data. This role partners with senior analysts, Finance, operational leaders, Information Technology to develop reports, conduct analyses, maintain data systems, develop pro-forma income statements, and support cost accounting methodologies that inform hospital operations, patient care, service line performance, and financial planning. The Analyst works with moderately complex datasets and contributes to routine and ad hoc reporting, cost model validation, overhead and indirect cost allocation, service line and procedure-level cost analysis, and documentation of decision support and cost accounting processes while continuing to build expertise in healthcare analytics and decision support systems.

DEPARTMENT: Treasury

HOURS OF WORK: Typically, Monday - Friday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm

REPORTS TO: Director Treasury Operations

Prerequisites:

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, healthcare administration, data analytics, or a related field required.

Minimum of five years of experience in healthcare analytics, financial analysis, decision support, cost accounting, or a related field required.

Experience working with healthcare, financial, operational, or cost accounting data, including reporting, analysis, and reconciliation activities required.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel required; experience with SQL, data query tools (Power BI ,Tableau ,Epic Reporting), reporting systems, or business intelligence applications preferred.

Understanding of financial concepts, cost accounting principles, cost structures, allocation methodologies, and data analysis techniques, including familiarity with healthcare operations, billing, clinical, budget, or general ledger systems.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, organization, process documentation, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Understanding of cost accounting fundamentals, including direct and indirect costing, overhead allocation, allocation drivers, cost center structures, service line profitability, and chart of account relationships.

Ability to validate and reconcile data, apply basic statistical concepts, analyze trends, investigate variances, and explain differences between cost models, allocation outputs, and actual financial results.

Qualifications:

Working knowledge of healthcare financial, clinical, operational, billing, decision support, general ledger, budget, data warehouse, and cost accounting systems.

Ability to create pro-forma income statements and support service line, contribution margin, profitability, and financial performance analyses.

Ability to develop, maintain, validate, and document allocation methodologies, assumptions, cost drivers, process controls, and related cost accounting procedures.

Experience evaluating expense classifications, cost center mappings, and chart of account relationships preferred.

Strong organizational, teamwork, communication, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to learn new systems, tools, and processes quickly.

Generic Job Functions: See Generic Job Description for Administrative Partner.
