Collect, validate, reconcile, and analyze healthcare, finance, cost accounting, and operational data to ensure accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting sources.

Develop and maintain routine and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and analyses that support operational, financial, cost accounting, service line, and decision support needs.

Prepare revenue, expense, utilization, profitability, contribution margin, service line, cost trend, and pro-forma analyses to support financial planning and performance review.

Support the development, maintenance, monthly processing, and validation of decision support models, cost models, reporting tools, data structures, cost accounting hierarchies, cost center mappings, and chart of account relationships.

Reconcile cost accounting system results and model outputs to the general ledger, financial statements, ancillary feeder systems, and other source systems; identify variances, root causes, corrections, and methodology refinements.

Develop, maintain, document, and periodically validate methodologies for assigning direct costs and allocating overhead, indirect costs, shared services, support departments, and other expenses across departments, service lines, procedures, programs, and reporting dimensions.

Review allocation statistics, cost drivers, source data, expense classifications, cost center assignments, and data mappings; recommend reclassifications or mapping changes to improve cost reporting and financial analytics.

Support department, service line, procedure-level, and patient-level cost models, including documentation of assumptions, data sources, allocation calculations, reconciliations, process controls, and methodology changes for management review or audit support.

Partner with Finance, operational leaders, senior analysts, Information Technology, and other stakeholders to understand reporting needs, validate data, automate processes, explain allocation results, and deliver actionable decision support solutions.

Support annual budget, forecasting, financial planning, service line analysis, process improvement, reporting standardization, automation initiatives, department projects, and other assigned initiatives.

Tesla Laboratories is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) providing Cyber Security, Intelligence Analysis, Financial Management, Facilities Engineering Services, and Program Management support to the Intelligence Community (IC), the Department of Defense (DoD), and other federal government customers. We take pride in fostering a culture that values family, professional growth, and long-term career development—setting us apart from other services companies.

Requirements

Tesla Laboratories is seeking a Program/Data Analyst to support Design Technical Support (DTS) services for the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Northwest (NAVFAC NW), Planning Design and Construction Directorate, Design Division (PDC4). This position supports the existing NAVFAC workforce and provides increased capability for Design-Bid-Build and Design-Build projects and associated efforts undertaken by NAVFAC Northwest customers within the NAVFAC Northwest Area of Responsibility (Puget Sound area).

Perform program/data analysis tasks, including:


Data analytics related to tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Tracking financial metrics of success for construction and engineering-related projects
Budget tracking and execution metric presentation


In addition, the Program/Data Analyst will:


Coordinate with team members to execute project scope, create/manage schedules, and track/brief budget execution in conformance with project and customer requirements
Create project technical dashboard reports via Microsoft software (Power BI, Project, Excel, etc.)
Facilitate the minimization of project delays by providing technical reviews and recommendations within predetermined timeframes
Research codes, guidance, policies, procedures, processes, criteria, and federal laws/regulations, and provide sound technical recommendations both verbally and in writing
Apply innovative technical principles, practices, and theories to the resolution of technical issues
Coordinate with the Government client, NAVFAC team members, leadership, project stakeholders, and various regulatory agencies
Coordinate and facilitate meetings, make recommendations based on project requirements, coordinate workflow processes, schedule/coordinate Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs), and effectively communicate findings to project personnel; provide written minutes for all meetings
Review technical reports, RFIs, designs, design changes (design-build and design-bid-build), project deliverables, submittals, and cost proposals from contractors to ensure compliance with customer and RFP requirements
Provide technical support for review of the commissioning plan, design and construction submittals, and field inspections
Provide technical support for construction field activities
Provide a summary of accomplishments during weekly meetings and in a prepared monthly status report
Provide weekly reports documenting technical engineering support and quality assurance on each assigned project, including status, issues, costs, schedule, and findings/observations/recommendations/data collected
Prepare reports, Requests for Proposals, and/or scopes of work in the required format, including applicable attachments, and participate in briefings/conferences
Prepare and deliver briefs supported by necessary project documentation to project team members, base personnel, and senior management
Ensure timely submission of submittals, reviews, and recommendations


Minimum of 5 years of financial management experience in a field related to the tasks described above.

Competitive compensation

Title: Business Analyst (Customer Success)
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BUSINESS ANALYST (CUSTOMER SUCCESS)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, delivers low-latency broadband internet worldwide, connecting consumers in remote and underserved areas. This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with a blend of quantitative skills and curiosity for market dynamics, capable of turning complex data into actionable strategies for consumer retention.

Responsibilities


Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort performance, using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities
Develop forecasting models for subscriber growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators
Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement
Conduct market research and price analysis, evaluating elasticity, competitive pricing, and promotional impacts to recommend optimizations that drive revenue and affordability
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and sales teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning
Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection for consumer use cases, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis
Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making
Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree
2+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations
1+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)


Preferred Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
Experience with forecasting, financial metrics (e.g., LTV, CAC), or pricing analysis
Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)
Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)
Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention
Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)
Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders


Additional Requirements


Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed
This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range

Level 1: $85,000.00 - $115,000.00

Level 2: $100,000.00 - $140,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Itar Requirements

1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.


SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Title: Go-To-Market Analyst
Description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive OKR and revenue dashboards across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or Finance
3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience querying large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery); comfort navigating messy, high-volume data is essential
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools


Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance


Emotional Health


Paid sabbatical program after four years
Paid family and paternity leave
Annual educational stipend
Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement
CFA exam stipend
Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program
Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days


Social Health


Matching gifts program
Employee resource groups
Subsidized emergency childcare
Dependent Care FSA
Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events


Financial Health


401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program
Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000
Target annual bonus percentage: 10%


Working Conditions

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

We are excited to get to know you and your background. Concerned that you might not meet every requirement? We encourage you to still apply as you might be the right candidate for the role or other roles at PitchBook.

Title: RCM Performance Analyst
Description:
Epic RCM Performance Analyst

Position Summary

Join Deloitte's AI & Engineering practice to deliver back-end Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) services, including Billing and Claims Submission, A/R Follow-up, Denials Management, Payment Posting, and Credits and Refunds, for health care provider client

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/01/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Epic RCM Performance Analyst on the AI & Engineering team, you will develop and maintain KPI reporting and dashboards tracking denial rates, AR aging, remittance trends, and productivity and quality performance across the operations team. Analyze 835/277 remittance and claims data using Epic Resolute and BI reporting tools to identify high-impact denial categories, payer-specific patterns, and systemic billing variances. Build and maintain Excel-based models and BI reports / dashboards to convert raw claims and remittance data into audit-ready, decision-useful insights. Conduct ongoing trend analysis and root-cause sampling of denial, variance, and productivity data to isolate systemic, payer, or process-driven issues. Partner with quality assurance, training, and operations leadership to validate findings and confirm root causes prior to remediation. Monitor payer guideline and requirement changes and assess their downstream impact on denial trends and account processing performance. Collaborate with operational teams to translate analytic findings into targeted process improvement recommendations and remediation plans. Supporting implementation of remediation plans by working with staff and team leads to confirming corrective actions are applied and sustained. Track the effectiveness of interventions over time and refine analytic and reporting approach based on outcomes. Develop clear, data-driven materials and presentations for internal leadership and client stakeholders summarizing KPI performance, trends, and recommended actions. Support monthly and quarterly business reviews with root-cause narratives, performance summaries, and improvement recommendations. Present analytic findings to varied audiences, from operational staff to client and engagement leadership. A successful candidate would possess these skills:


Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines


The team

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Our Industry Solutions offering provides verticalized solutions that transform how clients sell products, deliver services, generate growth, and execute mission-critical operations. We deliver integrated business expertise with scalable, repeatable technology solutions specifically engineered for each sector.

Qualifications

Required:


3+ years of experience in back-end revenue cycle operations, with working knowledge of core functions (claims, denials, AR follow-up, credits, payment posting)
Hands-on experience with Epic Resolute Hospital Billing and claims clearinghouse systems, including tracing 835/277 remittance data
Demonstrated experience conducting root-cause and translating findings into recommended process improvements
Advanced Excel skills with familiarity in Epic Analytics/Reporting or other BI reporting tools
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate KPI, quality, and productivity data into actionable insights
Experience developing reporting materials and presentations for internal leadership and/or client audiences
Clear, confident communicator able to present findings and recommendations to varied audience sizes


Preferred:


Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Experience supporting clinical or healthcare business operations
Experience managing multiple projects or workstreams
Experience preparing and delivering technical demonstrations
Experience analyzing billing workflows, claim issues, or operational data


The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $70,000 to $90,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Title: Commercial Operations Analyst (onsite in Bothell, WA)
Description:
The Data Analyst supports the business by partnering closely with Sales Operations, Sales, Product, Marketing, and R&D teams to deliver insights, reporting, and process improvements. Our team operates as an internal service organization — we exist to make our partner departments faster, smarter, and more data-informed. This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Success in this role comes from pairing the right applications with the right processes, used in unison. Strong tools without disciplined process produce one-off answers that don’t scale; strong process without the right tools slows the business down. The analysts who thrive here do both — picking the right system for the question (Tableau, Excel, Oracle, Salesforce, Eloqua, GA4, Qualtrics), then wrapping it in clear scoping, documentation, stakeholder review, and automation so the work compounds over time.

This role is a great fit for someone who takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable for delivering results, and is energized by reducing manual work across the business — someone who celebrates wins with the team and treats setbacks as opportunities to learn.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Sonosite, we reinvent how healthcare is delivered with point-of-care ultrasound technology. As the leader in bedside ultrasound systems, our innovations save lives—from premature babies in NICUs to trauma patients in emergency rooms.

We’re looking for purpose-driven team members ready to build technology that impacts real-world scenarios, including natural disasters and even war zones. By joining FUJIFILM Sonosite, you’ll be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, out-of-the-box thinking, and a passion for life-saving innovations. Let’s make a difference together.

Our headquarters in Bothell, Washington, blends riverside charm with urban amenities, quality schools, and an ever-evolving downtown—all part of the vibrant Seattle metro area.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

Job Description

Essential Job Functions:


Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau Server to support decision-making across Product, Sales, Marketing, and R&D.
Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, ask clarifying questions, and translate business questions into actionable analyses.
Build and maintain forecast models and own the forecasting process end-to-end — consolidating inputs from Sales, Product, and Marketing into a clear view of performance by product category and geography and applying historical trend analysis to improve forecast accuracy over time.
Develop pricing models to evaluate new-product pricing and validate margin targets, partnering with Application Analysts to load approved pricing accurately into Oracle and Salesforce.
Work with Oracle EBS data sources made available via Tableau; develop a working understanding of the system to interpret and contextualize the data accurately.
Pull and analyze data from Salesforce Sales Cloud (leads, opportunities, quotes) to support sales reporting and forecasting.
Develop email marketing reporting using Oracle Eloqua, partnering with Marketing to track campaign performance and engagement metrics.
Analyze on-page web analytics using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to support marketing and product decisions.
Design, deploy, and analyze surveys in Qualtrics; turn results into clear, actionable recommendations.
Use Excel extensively for ad hoc analysis, modeling, and stakeholder-facing deliverables.
Identify and execute opportunities to reduce manual effort across the organization — automating recurring reports, simplifying workflows, and eliminating one-off data pulls.
Partner with the Data Governance team to support reliable data pipelines and consistent, trustworthy data ingestion.
Conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies and reporting issues; favor proactive reporting over reactive firefighting.
Present findings, recommendations, and project updates to senior leadership with a clear narrative arc — leading with the takeaway, tailoring the message to the audience, and using clean visuals to drive confident, data-informed decisions.
Document processes, data definitions, and standard operating procedures using Oracle Agile and Microsoft Loop to enable knowledge transfer and team continuity.
Manage multiple concurrent requests; pull work proactively from the team backlog and move projects forward without needing step-by-step direction.
Build stakeholder review cycles into project timelines — share drafts with enough lead time to incorporate feedback rather than pushing deliverables out at the last minute.


Knowledge And Experience


2–5 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar role.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud reporting (leads, opportunities, quotes).
Experience with Oracle Eloqua (or equivalent) for email marketing reporting and campaign analytics.
Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) for web and on-page analytics.
Working knowledge of Oracle EBS as a business system (modules, workflows, terminology).
Demonstrated experience automating manual reporting or processes.
Experience with Google BigQuery, particularly for interfacing with GA4 data exports.
Familiarity with Qualtrics for survey design and analysis.


Skills/Abilities


Proficiency with Tableau (Desktop and Server) building dashboards, publishing, working with extracts and permissions.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas, basic modeling).
Basic SQL knowledge — comfortable reading queries and writing simple SELECT/JOIN statements.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to executives, including C-suite leadership.
Strong time and project management skills — including proactive planning for stakeholder review and feedback cycles.
Self-starter mindset: comfortable pulling work from a backlog, clarifying scope with the manager and stakeholders, and driving tasks to completion independently.
Strong documentation skills and a commitment to knowledge sharing.
Exposure to data governance & data architecture concepts.
Familiarity with ETL or data prep tools (Tableau Prep, Alteryx, Python/Pandas, dbt).
Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to enhance analyst workflows — drafting, summarizing, accelerating analysis, or generating code.


Salary And Benefits


$75,000.00/yr - $95,000.00/yr depending on experience (Compensation will vary based on skills, experience and location; it is not typical to be hired at or above the top of the salary range).
Insurance:
Medical, Dental & Vision
Life & Company paid Disability
Retirement Plan (401k):
4% automatic Company contribution
Fujifilm matches 50 cents for every dollar you contribute, up to 6% of your salary
Paid Time Off:
You can accrue up to 120 hours of PTO in your first year of employment
PTO increases based on years of service
Employee Choice Holidays:
32 hours additional paid time off, based on date of hire in the calendar year
Paid Holidays:
Eight (8) paid holidays per year

Master's degree in relevant field.

About The Job

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

In this role, you will be responsible for safeguarding the Google Ads ecosystem. Your role is a blend of technical data analysis, strategic cross-functional leadership, and direct investigative work. You will use data to predict their next moves, influence how engineering teams build detection systems, and ensure that safety measures do not disrupt the experience for legitimate advertisers.

We are on a critical mission to protect Google's users and ensure online safety across core and emerging Ads products. Our team is at the forefront of raising the bar on content through coherent policies and scaled, effective enforcement. We have expanded beyond traditional product protections to manage emerging challenges—including brand safety and controversial content across Google's growing Ads ecosystem.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Conduct investigations to catch fraudsters, enforce our product policies, learn scam patterns/trends and identify product vulnerabilities.
Identify automation and efficiency opportunities and drive solutions through analysis or cross-functional partnerships.

Title: Government Healthcare Data Consultant
Description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Government Human Service Consultant (GHSC) - Informatics team at Mercer, a Marsh business. This role can be based in Phoenix, Minneapolis, Atlanta, or Seattle and offers a hybrid work arrangement, requiring a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Medicaid is a government-sponsored health insurance program in the United States designed to provide healthcare coverage to low-income individuals and families. As a consulting firm specializing in Medicaid, Mercer’s GHSC team assists state governments in optimizing their Medicaid programs. Our team plays a vital role in managing and analyzing Medicaid claims data to enhance patient access to care, improve cost efficiency, and elevate the quality of services provided to these individuals.

As a Government Healthcare Data Consultant, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced programmers, actuaries, and clinicians, contributing to meaningful projects that aim to positively impact the lives of individuals and families in need. Join us in making a difference!

We will count on you to:


Utilize SAS programming software to interpret, validate and analyze large health care data sets
Participate in initial meetings with clients or project leads to define the scope of the project and provide insight and expertise including knowledge of the capabilities and flexibility of various approaches
Define the data process based on project scope, insight from the project lead and direction from the project's senior actuarial staff
Understand the reasons and impacts of data anomalies and exceptions on the analysis, formulate solutions, and communicate to client teams
Thrive and be motivated by an environment that embraces AI and technology-enabled tools
Perform technical peer review for data analysis projects
Act as a mentor for junior staff


What you need to have:


BA/BS or equivalent experience required
Minimum 4 years’ experience using SAS (desired), SQL, or equivalent programming language
Experience with healthcare claims data
Strong analytical and mathematical skills
Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks in a demanding work environment
Strong critical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills


What makes you stand out?


Experience with Medicaid programs and associated health care data, preferably in a consulting environment
Excellent interpersonal skills; strong oral and written communication skills


Why join our team:


We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have an impact on colleagues, clients, and communities.
Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.


The applicable base salary range for this role is $68,500 to $137,000.

The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition assistance, 401K savings and other retirement programs as well as employee assistance programs.

Title: Clinical Data Analyst, Spotfire
Description:
SystImmune is a leading and well-funded clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company located in Bothell, WA and Princeton, NJ. It specializes in developing innovative cancer treatments using its established drug development platforms, focusing on bi-specific, multi-specific antibodies, and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). SystImmune has multiple assets in various stages of clinical trials for solid tumor and hematologic indications. Alongside ongoing clinical trials. SystImmune has a robust preclinical pipeline of potential cancer therapeutics in the discover and IND-enabling stages, representing cutting-edge biologics development. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company's success.

The Spotfire Clinical Data Analyst will specialize in the installation, maintenance, and development of clinical data visualizations utilizing Spotfire. This role emphasizes creating and enhancing Spotfire-based patient profiles, real-time data review dashboards, clinical metrics dashboards, and other customized visualization reports such as live TLFs. Additionally, the Analyst will collaborate closely with Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Clinical Science, and Clinical Operations to optimize data visualization strategies.

This position requires a full-time onsite presence at our Redmond, WA office.

Responsibilities:


Lead the installation, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of Spotfire for clinical data analysis and visualization
Design, develop, and maintain Spotfire dashboards for patient profiles, real-time clinical data review, surveillance, metrics tracking, and other customized visualizations
Develop sophisticated, interactive visualizations to support internal data review processes, surveillance, reconciliation, and reporting needs
Collaborate with Clinical Data Managers, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, and Clinical Science teams to identify requirements and translate them into effective Spotfire visualizations
Manage and continually improve the Spotfire analytics environment, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and performance
Establish and maintain a Global Spotfire Library, aligning visualization standards across multiple studies and programs
Train and mentor Clinical Data Managers and other stakeholders in effectively utilizing Spotfire dashboards and reports
Coordinate timelines and deliverables with Clinical Data Management and other cross-functional teams to ensure visualizations meet expectations
Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of new technologies and methodologies to enhance Spotfire capabilities
Document visualization specifications, maintain clear documentation for Spotfire-related processes, and contribute to departmental SOPs
Uphold industry standards including protocol compliance, ICH GCP, FDA regulations, and CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM)


Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Biostatistics, Computer Science, Life Science, or a related field
Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in Spotfire visualization development and administration in a clinical trial setting, preferably in oncology and hematology
Expert-level proficiency in Spotfire including installation, configuration, dashboard development, data integration, scripting (IronPython, TERR, etc.) and performance optimization
Strong experience developing patient profiles, real-time data review dashboards, clinical metrics dashboards, and complex reports
Experience with SAS/R, SQL programming, and data manipulation
Familiarity with clinical trial data standards (CDISC SDTM, ADaM), experience with TLF generation preferred
Experience integrating Spotfire with clinical databases and EDC systems (e.g., Medidata RAVE, Oracle Inform, Veeva)
Strong organizational skills, critical thinking, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Familiarity with regulatory guidelines including GCP, ICH, and FDA requirements
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)


Compensation and Benefits:

The expected base salary range for this position is $90,000 - $130,000 annually. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s qualifications, experience, and skills.

SystImmune is a leading and well-funded biotech company with a bright future. We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company’s success. SystImmune offers a comprehensive benefits package including: 100% paid employee premiums for medical/dental/vision, also STD, LTD, a 401(k) plan with a 50% company match of up to 3% and a vesting schedule of only 5 years, 15 PTO days per year, sick leave, plus 11 paid holidays and MORE.

We offer an opportunity for you to learn and grow while making significant contributions to the company’s success.

SystImmune is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diverse talent and encourage all qualified applicants to apply.

Title: Senior Analyst, Portfolio Analytics and Planning
Description:
Description

Join the Personal Lines Auto Program Delivery & Enhancements (PDE) Build team — our brand-new, high-visibility team shaping next-generation auto rating programs and the core frameworks PDE relies on to deliver efficiently and with precision.

In this role, you'll support portfolio planning and operational analytics across the delivery value stream. You'll bring analytical rigor to rollout scheduling, capacity forecasting, and performance metrics — building the tools, schedules, and views that help the team sequence work, balance capacity, make informed trade-offs, and optimize in market value for the organization. You'll help turn a complex, multi-state, multi-program landscape into a clear, visible, data-driven plan. You'll partner with State Management, Program Management, Data Science, Tech, and other teams across the Delivery value stream to keep our roadmap realistic, visible, and on track. This is a ground-floor opportunity to help shape how we plan and pace delivery — with exposure to senior leadership.


This position may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location. The level of position offered will be based on skills and experience at manager discretion. **


What You'll Do


Analyze & recommend: Investigate planning and capacity questions, conduct scenario analysis, and synthesize your findings into clear, actionable recommendations that drive rollout schedules and cadence.
Support portfolio planning: Help maintain an integrated view of program rollouts across states and programs including rollout sequencing, dependencies, milestones, and cadence.
Measure performance: Develop the metrics, dashboards, and reporting that track delivery progress, surface risks, and inform trade-off decisions for the team and leadership.
Put tech to work: Integrate tools like AI, PowerBI, PowerApps, JIRA, and Excel into day-to-day workflows to boost quality, traceability, and speed-to-market.


You'll love this job if you enjoy


Understanding how things work, end to end
Bringing order and structure to complex, moving parts
Working with data to tell a clear story
Cross-functional collaboration
A continuous-improvement and growth mindset


Skills and experience that will lead to success in the role


Experience in analytics, portfolio/program planning, forecasting, operations, or a related area
Strong analytical and quantitative skills — comfortable building custom logic, forecasts, and performance metrics from data
Experience with data, reporting, and app-building tools (e.g., Power BI, Power Apps, Excel)
Curiosity about how to apply AI and automation to streamline planning and reporting
Detail oriented and a strong steward of quality outcomes
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to turn ambiguity into structure
Clear written and verbal communication — able to translate complex data and plans into concise recommendations
Comfort working across multiple teams and managing several priorities at once


What You'll Gain


A strong foundation in portfolio planning, capacity modeling, and delivery orchestration at scale
Exposure to the high-visibility workstreams
Insight into how we build and bring rating programs to market
A broad view of the auto product and pricing ecosystem
Relationships and exposure across the organization (e.g., State Management, Technology, Data Science)
Project and stakeholder management experience
Foundational product and pricing knowledge to set you up for future roles in Product


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics or Insurance preferred; or equivalent experience
Approx 5 or more years related work experience
Knowledge of insurance principles and concepts required
Advanced analytical/problem solving and research skills
Effective communication skills for writing reports/proposals and making presentations
Ability to work independently and lead others during projects
Knowledge of the business practices and processes
Proficiency with spreadsheets and data base software

Title: Senior Marketing Analytics Lead - Minecraft
Description:
Overview

At Mojang Studios, the creators of Minecraft, we are on a mission to build a better world through the power of play.

Why play? Well, play is at the heart of everything we do. It’s the blocky backbone of our games, the core of our development philosophy, and even the origin of our name. From the relentless experimentation of our endlessly inspiring community to the classrooms where Minecraft has become an essential teaching tool, play is the bedrock of our existence.

We enable millions to create and play together, connect people across the globe, and foster a community that is among the most active and passionate in the world. Our community is global and incredibly diverse. When we are developing anything within our franchise, we keep this in mind. We want everyone to not only feel included in Minecraft, but also to see themselves in what we make. Our goal is for the Mojang Studios team to be as diverse as our community.

The Player and Data Insights team is seeking a Marketing Analytics Lead to shape how Mojang Studios measures, optimizes, and grows the impact of its marketing investments. You will partner closely with Marketing and Data Science teams to develop measurement strategies, evaluate marketing performance, and identify opportunities to drive player acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue. This role combines marketing analytics, business intelligence, measurement strategy, and executive storytelling to connect campaign performance with player and business outcomes. You will develop scalable reporting, trusted measurement frameworks, and AI-enabled analytics capabilities that help teams make faster, more informed decisions.

In the end, it’s the people of Mojang Studios that make this place truly special. When you join, you’ll find yourself in the company of incredibly bright, warm, and creative individuals – all united and working toward a single goal. Come help us reach it!

Responsibilities


Partner with Marketing leaders to define success metrics, measurement plans, and key performance indicators for campaigns, channels, and strategic initiatives.
Develop and maintain executive scorecards, dashboards, and reporting solutions that provide a trusted view of marketing performance.
Analyze campaign, channel, and player behavior data to uncover actionable insights and opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.
Translate complex marketing and player data into clear recommendations that influence planning, prioritization, and investment decisions.
Partner with Data Science teams to evaluate marketing performance, understand key business drivers, and measure the impact of marketing initiatives.
Establish consistent metrics, reporting standards, and measurement frameworks that improve trust and alignment across marketing reporting.
Deliver recurring business reviews and performance narratives that connect marketing activity to player engagement and business outcomes.
Evaluate emerging analytics and AI capabilities that improve reporting, insight generation, and access to data-driven decision making.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:


Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 2+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis
OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 4+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis
OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications


8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data analytics, business intelligence, or related fields, or equivalent experience.
Experience partnering with Marketing leaders to define measurement strategies, evaluate performance, and drive data-informed decision making.
Experience developing executive dashboards, scorecards, business reviews, and reporting solutions that enable strategic decision making.
Advanced SQL and/or Python skills with experience analyzing large-scale customer, player, marketing, or digital engagement datasets.
Experience analyzing and interpreting performance data across paid media, lifecycle marketing, CRM, web analytics, or other digital marketing channels.
Experience translating complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience applying AI-enabled analytics, automation, or self-service reporting capabilities to improve insight generation and data accessibility.
Passion for games, player experiences, and data-informed decision making.

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Prime Video Partner Experience & Supply Chain
Description:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

What You'll Do

Join Prime Video's Partner Experience & Supply Chain team as a Business Intelligence Engineer and become the data expert who transforms how we work with our content partners and optimize our supply chain.

You'll be the go-to person for turning complex supply chain data into clear insights that drive real decisions. Working alongside product managers, engineers, and operations teams, you'll build the analytics tools and dashboards that help everyone understand what's working, what's not, and where we should focus next.

The Problems You'll Solve

Our supply chain generates massive amounts of data, but data alone doesn't drive change - insights do. You'll tackle questions like: Where are the bottlenecks slowing down content delivery? Which partner workflows need improvement? How can we predict and prevent supply chain issues before they impact customers?

You'll create the visibility tools that turn these questions into actionable answers, helping teams spot trends early and make confident, data-backed decisions.

What Makes This Role Different

You won't just be running reports - you'll be a strategic partner shaping how Prime Video manages relationships with content partners and optimizes the entire supply chain. Your work will directly influence how quickly and efficiently we bring content to millions of viewers worldwide.

You'll have the autonomy to identify opportunities, propose solutions, and build the tools that matter most. If you love diving deep into data, translating complexity into clarity, and seeing your insights drive tangible improvements, this role offers that impact.

Key job responsibilities


Analyze data to identify and execute on business opportunities
Understand data resources and select appropriate sources for each analysis
Build fast prototypes using Amazon AI tools (Kiro, Claude CLI, QuickSuite) and translate them into production-grade data products
Evaluate requirements and select optimal tools, balancing speed, efficiency, and scalability
Build data pipelines and dashboards from multi-dimensional datasets to report product metrics and KPIs
Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders verbally and in writing


About The Team

We are part of the central Product and Data Team within the Partner Experience & Supply Chain organization at Prime Video. Our structure and scope is a hybrid model where we collaborate closely with our tech teams to build data products that solve problems affecting PV customers and our internal stakeholders.

We optimize the supply chain and deliver the highest standard of video streaming content to our customers. Our team is the trusted analytical powerhouse that drives unified data solutions, making Prime Video the preferred entertainment destination for customers worldwide.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
4+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
Proven ability to determine when and how to integrate GenAI tools, evaluate and refine GenAI outputs, and apply responsible AI practices to augment productivity and quality

Description:
About DAT

DAT Freight & Analytics is an award-winning employer of choice and a next-generation SaaS technology company that has been at the leading edge of freight and logistics innovation for nearly five decades. Founded in 1978, DAT operates the largest freight marketplace in North America — processing 250 million+ load posts annually and maintaining one of the largest repositories of freight market transaction data in the world. On a defined path to $1 billion in revenue, DAT deploys a suite of software solutions, machine learning models, and intelligent automation tools that help brokers, carriers, and shippers price freight accurately, source capacity, reduce risk, and operate more efficiently. With nearly 700 teammates across offices in Denver, CO; Portland, OR; Seattle, WA; Springfield, MO; Toronto, ON; and Bangalore, India, DAT combines the credibility of a multi-decade market leader with the drive of a company that is not done disrupting the industry it helped build. For more information, visit www.DAT.com

Application Deadline: 10/1/2026

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Senior Associate to help redefine how BizOps gets done at DAT. This hybrid role sits at the intersection of strategy, business intelligence, and applied AI: you'll deliver the insights leaders rely on for strategic decisions, while designing and deploying AI agents that scale and extend our analytics capabilities.

You'll partner with stakeholders across the business to surface high-value problems, develop and report on KPIs that inform target priorities and team performance, and build agentic workflows that turn recurring tasks into self-service tools. With each analysis, you'll ask the natural follow-up: what can an agent do to complement this next time?

This is a high-impact IC role with meaningful visibility at the leadership level. Agents are rapidly transforming internal BizOps functions, and you'll shape how we incorporate them into ours.

What You’ll Do

Develop and operate agentic solutions to traditional business intelligence responsibilities:


Strategic Oversight: Support leadership in developing and executing business strategies. Assist with setting organizational goals, tracking progress, and ensuring alignment across departments.
KPI development & ownership: Develop and own the key performance indicators that leadership uses to measure business health, ensuring metrics stay aligned with evolving strategic priorities.
Strategic & ad-hoc analysis: Partner with stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Product, and Marketing to scope analytical questions, deliver deep-dive insights, and translate findings into clear recommendations that drive business decisions.
BI development & reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and data models that make key business metrics accessible, accurate, and trustworthy across the organization.
Agent design & deployment: Design, prototype, and deploy AI agents that augment workflows, including agents that monitor metrics for anomalies, generate narrative summaries, answer ad-hoc data questions, and automate routine reporting cycles.
Performance monitoring & iteration: Track how deployed agents and dashboards perform in the wild, gather feedback from end users, and continuously refine outputs to improve accuracy, usefulness, and adoption over time.
Automation opportunity identification: Spot repetitive analytical tasks across the organization and evaluate which are best suited for agentic automation versus traditional BI tooling, balancing impact, complexity, and risk.
Data quality & integrity: Partner with Data Engineering to validate source data, surface inconsistencies, and ensure that both human-facing analyses and agent outputs are built on a trustworthy foundation.
Documentation & enablement: Document agent capabilities, limitations, and intended use cases so stakeholders know when to trust outputs and when to escalate or verify.


The Skills And Experience You’ll Bring


3-5 years in high-growth startups, strategy consulting, business intelligence, data analytics or specialized BizOps roles. Series A–C experience is a significant plus.
Strong SQL and Excel skills. You can independently get to the data you need and build the models behind your own reporting.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
Daily working fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day work; comfortable writing clear prompts, evaluating outputs, debugging agent behavior, and knowing when human judgment must override automation.
Growth mindset and a willingness to work hard; this will be a high-effort, high-reward type role for those excited about building business leverage with AI.


Nice to Haves:


Experience deploying AI agents or LLM-powered tools, including thinking through evaluation, monitoring, and failure modes.
Experience in logistics, fintech, marketplaces, or B2B SaaS businesses.


Why DAT?

DAT is an award winning employer of choice.

For starters, we have a hybrid work environment, but we also know what makes a great workplace. We have a time-tested and resolute set of operating values predicated on integrity, mutual respect, open communication, and executing with excellence. These values inform our strategic vision as much as any one of our products does. We’ve been an employer of choice in the Portland metropolitan area for four decades, and within one year of opening our Denver office, DAT was #26 on Built In Colorado’s 100 Best Places to Work In Colorado.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Reporting to the Manager of Analytics, you’ll use your expertise to inform strategic decisions across product optimization, technology, testing, and overall quality.

Communicate with studio stakeholders to identify opportunities where data can better support decision making
Work with partners to define the right questions to ask and the right data to use, helping embed data in daily decision-making
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
Build dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders make better, faster decisions
Contribute to the development of predictive models and other applications of machine learning that personalise player experiences or support product decisions
Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights


What You'll Bring


4+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, mobile apps, or other digital products
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.


Pay Transparency - North America

British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD

Description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100787

Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.
