Title: Data Analyst - SQL / Databricks
Description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role

As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence organization, you will turn operational and customer data into actionable reports and dashboards that drive business decisions. You will partner directly with internal business teams, such as sales compensation, to gather reporting requirements, document technical specifications, and build user friendly data assets.

Your primary hands-on work will involve writing SQL views and building dashboards directly within Databricks using data populated by our engineering team. A key aspect of this role is context engineering, where you will add structured descriptions and metadata to tables, views, and columns so that our data is easily discoverable and accurately queried by AI tools like Claude. Additionally, you will validate report accuracy, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation of your reporting logic to ensure long-term reliability.

Your Opportunity


You will have the opportunity to build and scale the business reporting layer within Databricks.
You will be part of a globally distributed team of data professionals.
This role is designed for someone who wants to grow their analytical skills in a collaborative, business facing environment.
Leverage modern AI coding agents, such as Databricks' Genie or Claude, to assist in writing and optimizing your queries.


What You'll Need


2 to 4 years of experience in a business intelligence, reporting, or data analyst role.
To be considered for this role, you must meet one of the following criteria: Hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Columbia, MD office three days a week, or hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Boston, MA office three days a week.
Fundamental working proficiency in SQL, including an understanding of select statements, order of operations, joins, aggregations, and filtering.
Basic to working proficiency with Databrick, a comparable lakehouse, or cloud data platform such as Snowflake.
Experience building dashboards and presenting data visually using tools like Databricks native dashboards, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical business stakeholders and translate them into usable data assets.
A detail oriented mindset with comfort in documenting data objects, definitions, and logic for downstream users.


And Ideally


Prior experience writing table and column descriptions or metadata to support data catalogs, semantic layers, or natural language query tools.
Exposure to Python or PySpark within Databricks notebooks, which will give you a significant advantage for career progression on this specific team.
Familiarity with analytics engineering practices, such as dbt, or version control systems like Git.
Experience working in enterprise software, SaaS, or cybersecurity environments.


This is the base pay range for this position. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. Tenable also offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits which include: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) retirement savings with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; an employee referral program; flexible spending accounts; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); education assistance; parental leave; paid time off (PTO); company-paid holidays; health and wellness events; and community programs.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Responsibilities

Sabre Systems is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to provide advanced analytics and operational intelligence support to the Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIRSYSCOM) Cyber Warfare Department (CWD) at Patuxent River Naval Air Station located in Southern Maryland. This position is an 100% on-site role. The selected candidate will serve as a critical member of the Cyber Planning and Response Center (CPRC), delivering data-driven insights that enable informed decision-making across mission planning, readiness assessment, resource allocation, and operational tracking activities.

This position requires a strong analytical background, demonstrated experience working with complex datasets and PowerBI, and the proven ability to translate technical findings into clear, actionable intelligence for senior leadership and operational stakeholders. The selected candidate will be responsible for but not limited to


Execute comprehensive data management and analysis activities to support mission intelligence objectives
Extract, query, and analyze data from complex databases and multiple disparate data sources
Perform extensive data cleaning, normalization, and validation to ensure data integrity and reliability
Conduct statistical analysis to identify operational trends, patterns, and anomalies
Develop, maintain, and automate intelligence dashboards and reporting solutions
Build predictive data models to support operational forecasting and strategic planning
Translate technical and analytical findings into concise, plain-language summaries focused on financial, readiness, and operational impacts for senior leadership
Support data-driven decision-making by transforming raw data into verified quantitative metrics and strategic insights
Work collaboratively with data engineers and developers to acquire, process, and format data both at source and post-extraction to create analytical products
Partner with data analysts and data scientists to prepare diverse data sources for advanced analytics work
Liaise with business and operational stakeholders to understand business needs, metrics, goals, and objectives
Translate and map user requirements to underlying data sources and develop extraction plans
Develop thorough documentation for data sources and pipelines in collaboration with data scientists, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders (e.g., data dictionaries, flow models, process documentation)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve data collection processes, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency


Qualifications

Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related technical field
Minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience in data analysis, intelligence analytics, or related technical disciplines
Proven experience using Microsoft Power Platform tools, including PowerBI and Power Automate
Demonstrated experience working with large datasets, database querying, and statistical analysis methodologies
Experience with Qlik/Qlik Sense analytics and dashboard development
Strong proficiency in data visualization, predictive analytics, and business intelligence best practices
Advanced database querying capabilities
Experience with data modeling and statistical analysis tools
Must have an active DoD Top Secret/SCI security clearance
Must be a U.S. Citizen


Preferred Qualifications


Familiarity with Department of Defense (DoD) or Navy acquisition and operational environments
Experience supporting cyber operations or intelligence mission sets
Knowledge of Navy enterprise systems and data architectures
Advanced certifications in data analytics, business intelligence, or related disciplines


Work Environment


Full-time onsite position located at Patuxent River Naval Air Station in Lexington Park, Maryland
Collaborative environment supporting mission-critical defense and operational initiatives
Opportunity to work with cutting-edge analytics technologies in support of national security objectives


Compensation Statement

At Sabre Systems, LLC, compensation is based on factors such as location, qualifications, experience, and contract-specific requirements; however, final compensation will be determined by individual qualifications and applicable contract terms. The general salary range for this position is as follows $120,000.00 - $180,000.00

Refer & Earn Employee Referral Bonus Eligibility


A Level 3 Employee Referral Bonus applies to this requisition for qualifying referrals. At Sabre Systems, we value great talent and encourage our employees to refer exceptional candidates. If you have any questions about the referral policy or this position, please contact the Recruiting team.


Sabre Overview

Sabre Systems, LLC, has been providing innovative technological solutions and services for Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and commercial customers for more than 35 years. We support the ever-evolving areas of advanced communication technologies, cyber, systems and software engineering, and digital transformation.

With over three decades in business, Sabre Systems, LLC remains committed to our small business values and a people-first philosophy. We foster a welcoming, inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and encourages open communication. Our collaborative environment supports continuous learning and professional growth at all levels. We prioritize the health, well-being, and success of our employees, offering comprehensive, evolving benefits designed to meet their diverse needs. Join us and be part of a thriving, people-driven culture.

We respect the unique perspectives that a diverse workforce of minorities, women, individuals with disabilities, and protected veterans brings not only to our company, but also to our customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability or genetic information.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality

Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence

3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders

Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers

Description:
Who We Are

SeekWell is the parent company of 1-800 Contacts, Luna, and The Framery. Our goal is to make it simpler, easier, and more accessible for people to get the vision care they need. We maintain the legendary, award-winning culture 1-800 Contacts started almost 30 years ago and continue to develop innovative, pioneering products and businesses that make consumers cheer. We’re owned by KKR – one of the world’s largest and most successful private equity investment companies. We’ve built an excellent company and changed an industry by putting the customer first, always. The best is yet to come!

Why you want this job

In this role, you’ll work closely with SeekWell’s operations teams to turn data into insights that help the business make smarter decisions and improve how we work. You’ll collaborate with teams across the organization, dig into data, and have the opportunity to see your work make a real impact. If you’re a go-getter who enjoys solving problems with data, this is a great opportunity to grow your skills and build your career with a collaborative team.

What You’ll Do


Collect, clean, and transform data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency in analysis, maintaining all necessary data dictionaries. 
Support enterprise data migration projects by analyzing data requirements, translating current operational logic into new platforms, and refactoring processes to maintain data integrity.
Build and maintain Databricks Silver tables designed to serve analytics and reporting needs, ensuring data quality and consistency throughout data migrations.
Work closely with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers to clearly articulate the data needs for analysis and actively participate in the collaborative data modeling process. 
Continuously monitor data quality and provide recommendations for improvement and contribute to the development and maintenance of data infrastructure and tools. 
Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies. 
Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and visualizations to present data-driven insights. 
Clearly communicate findings to stakeholders through reports, presentations, and informal communication channels like Slack. 


What You'll Need


4+ years of data analyst experience in a corporate setting
Proficiency with Databricks and SQL
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely
Hybrid Work Requirement: Ability to work in the office two days per week in Draper, UT


Why we will love you


Experience with data analysis tools such Python, R, and Excel
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)
Experience with statistical software (e.g., SAS, SPSS)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities
Comfortable interacting with stakeholders from all levels of the organization
Familiarity with data management best practices and regulatory requirements for sensitive data (e.g., HIPAA, CCPA)


Perks


Free eye exams for your entire family
Deep discounts on lenses, glasses, and other services
Amazing healthcare coverage
401(k) match

Tuition reimbursement program
In-house restaurant with highly discounted meals (Steak dinner under $6)
Free snacks, ice cream, and drinks every day
Full onsite gym

Title: Data Analyst

Description

ICF is seeking a Data Analyst to support an enterprise learning data and analytics platform that leverages emerging technology to ingest data in real time at extreme volumes and high velocity. The role focuses on data mining, analysis, and visualization to uncover insights and solve business problems.

Responsibilities


Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.
Analyze learner, workforce, and training performance data to identify trends, gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Create recurring and ad hoc reports for program managers, executives, and stakeholders.

Develop key performance indicators (KPIs), metrics, and scorecards to support organizational objectives.
Support data governance, metadata management, and data standardization efforts.

Translate business requirements into data collection, reporting, and visualization solutions.
Partner with technical teams, business stakeholders, and subject matter experts to identify reporting and analytics needs.
Document data definitions, business rules, reporting methodologies, and analytical processes.
Present findings, trends, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Support audit requests, compliance reporting, and data calls from federal stakeholders.

Bachelor's degree

Experience developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations for business stakeholders.
Experience writing complex SQL queries and performing data validation activities.
Proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or other business intelligence and visualization tools.
Experience with data transformation and preparation tools.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and relational databases.
Experience working with large datasets from multiple data sources.
Understanding of statistical methods, data profiling, and trend analysis.
Ability to communicate complex analytical findings through effective visualizations and presentations.
Familiarity with Agile project environments and requirements management processes.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience analyzing learning management system (LMS) data, student participation data, certification data, or workforce development metrics.
Experience supporting enterprise analytics initiatives in regulated federal environments.
Experience developing executive dashboards and performance measurement frameworks.
Knowledge of learning analytics, Kirkpatrick evaluation methodologies, training effectiveness measurement, or workforce planning analytics.
Experience with Power BI, Azure Data Services, Microsoft Fabric, or other Microsoft analytics platforms.
Experience supporting FDA, HHS, or other federal health-sector organizations.
Familiarity with data governance, privacy requirements, and federal information management standards.

Title: Data Analyst – Power BI Microsoft Fabric (35903)
Description:
Data Analyst – Power BI / Microsoft Fabric

Location: Ottawa, ON – On-site

Hours: 40 hours/week (8 hours/day)

Start: ASAP

Compensation: $90,000–$106,740

Benefits: Full benefits

Clearance: Must be eligible to successfully complete the required background/security screening

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join a highly collaborative technology and data team supporting a complex, operational environment in Ottawa.

This is an excellent opportunity for a junior-to-mid-level Data Analyst with strong Power BI, SQL and Microsoft data technologies experience who enjoys turning data into meaningful dashboards, reporting and business insights.

Reporting to a senior technology leader and working closely with a Data Architect, you will design and maintain dashboards, reports, data models and analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and related Azure/cloud analytics technologies.

This is also a stakeholder-facing role. Strong communication, listening skills and the ability to understand business requirements and explain data clearly are equally important to technical capability.

What You'll Do


Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations and performance metrics for operational and executive audiences.
Develop and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze data from multiple systems.
Build and maintain dimensional and semantic data models supporting reporting and self-service analytics.
Develop data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and Warehouse workloads, and related Azure Data Services.
Integrate structured and semi-structured data from APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Use Python/Pandas for data preparation, automation and analysis.
Gather and understand stakeholder requirements and translate them into effective analytical and reporting solutions.
Analyze complex datasets and communicate findings as clear, actionable business insights.
Support data quality, consistency, documentation, governance, privacy and security requirements.
Help evaluate, improve and automate existing reporting processes and systems.
Work closely with technical teams, business stakeholders and external vendors/service providers.


What We're Looking For


Post-secondary degree/diploma in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting or a related analytical role.
3+ years developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
Strong SQL skills, including querying, transforming and analyzing large datasets.
Experience with dimensional data modelling.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse/Warehouse), Azure Data Services or comparable modern cloud analytics platforms.
Experience with Python/Pandas.
Experience integrating data using APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Ability to analyze complex information and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong communication and listening skills, professional presence and a clear, structured approach to problem-solving.
Comfortable working directly with business users, customers and stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE


Microsoft certifications such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate or Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
Tableau experience and exposure to other BI/reporting technologies such as Qlik, Looker, SSRS or advanced Excel.
Experience with Snowflake, AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience in aviation, transportation or another complex 24/7 operational environment.
Knowledge of data governance, privacy and information security practices.
Experience with operational performance metrics and reporting standards.
Ability to communicate in English and French is an asset.


Who Will Succeed In This Role

You don't need to be the most senior technical person in the room. We're looking for someone who combines solid hands-on data skills with the ability to listen, understand requirements, communicate clearly and work collaboratively.

You should be technically adaptable, comfortable taking direction from senior data/technology professionals, and confident interacting directly with stakeholders to turn their requirements into useful, reliable data solutions.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Our Mission

To create an organization that sets the standard of excellence in the compassionate treatment of behavioral health and addiction disorders.

Who are we?

Since 2015, Nevada Behavioral Health Systems (NBH) has been providing mental health and substance abuse services to residents across Nevada. By collaborating with a diverse network of experienced behavioral healthcare providers, we have built a community-based care system that offers members personalized options tailored to their individual needs. In 2023, we rebranded as NovumHealth with the expansion of our services in Arizona, California, and Utah.

Position: Data Analyst

Location: Las Vegas, NV – Onsite (This role is not eligible for Remote or Hybrid)

Starting Salary Range: $60,000 - $70,000

The starting salary range for this role is a reasonable estimate, with a goal to pay a competitive market salary focusing near the median of our pay ranges. However, final offers for all positions will be based on several factors such as experience level, education and certification, skills, and internal pay equity.

What’s the role?

The Data Analyst is responsible for leveraging data to uncover actionable insights that drive clinical, operational, and business decisions. This role requires expertise in healthcare analytics, specifically in interpreting clinical and operational data requests, managing large claims datasets, and developing data visualizations that effectively tell a story to diverse stakeholders. Proficiency with healthcare frameworks such as HEDIS, NCQA, and value-based care metrics is critical to success in this role.

What you’ll do:


Collaborate with clinical and operational teams to translate requests into actionable queries and analytics that inform decisionmaking.
Analyze large datasets, including claims data, to uncover trends, identify risks, and generate insights related to cost, utilization, and quality.
Develop dashboards and visualizations in Power BI to present findings to both technical and nontechnical audiences, tailoring presentations to executive stakeholders when necessary.
Design and implement frameworks for tracking healthcare performance metrics, including HEDIS, NCQA, and valuebased care measures.
Perform data cleaning and validation to ensure the accuracy and reliability of datasets.
Create comprehensive reports that combine storytelling with quantitative insights to drive actionable recommendations.
Identify and communicate opportunities for process improvement or cost optimization through data analysis.
Support ad hoc requests for data analysis, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of results.
Collaborate with crossfunctional teams, including clinicians, IT, and operations, to ensure alignment of data analytics with organizational goals.
Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices in healthcare analytics.


What you’ll bring:


Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics and statistical modeling.
Familiarity with electronic medical records systems.
Advanced proficiency in Power BI for developing dashboards and visualizations.
Strong SQL skills for querying relational databases and preparing datasets for analysis.
Experience with data cleaning and working with large, complex datasets.
Indepth understanding of healthcare performance metrics, including HEDIS, NCQA, and valuebased care frameworks.
Exceptional storytelling skills to present data in a meaningful way to diverse stakeholders.
Strong critical thinking and problemsolving abilities to uncover insights and recommend solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex data findings to nontechnical audiences.


What you’ll need to start:


Bachelor’s degree Analytics, Data Analytics, Health Informatics, or a related field.
Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Health Informatics, Public Health or a related field Preferred.
3+ years of experience with healthcare analytics, with a strong focus on clinical and operational data.
Proven experience with claims data analysis, including familiarity with total cost of care and utilization metrics.
Certified Healthcare Data Analyst (CHDA) certification or similar credentials.
Must pass drug screening and background check in order to start employment with NovumHealth.


What will make you stand out:


Experience in Power BI, SQL, R, and other complex data analysis.


What do we offer?


Competitive Salary
Generous vacation policy, paid holidays, and paid sick time
Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, and Vision Insurance (Employeepaid)
Optional supplemental Insurance Coverage
Company paid access to Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
401k Retirement Savings Plan
Free Financial coaching and access to Credit Lines and Personal Loans through FinFit
Preferred Auto, Home and Renter’s insurance through Allstate
Employee Discounts through Corestream
…and so much more!

At this time, we are unable to sponsor work visas for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the job posting location on a fulltime basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a CBRE Sr. Data Analyst, you will perform a variety of analyses to ensure that recommendations and business conclusions are backed by sound data findings and thorough data research.

This job is part of the Data Science & Analytics job function. They are responsible for reviewing data that supports improving effectiveness and predicting outcomes to develop business intelligence.

What You’ll Do


Coordinate data aggregation and curate complex reports using various business intelligence and reporting applications.
Perform ad-hoc, strategic review of structured and unstructured data, reflecting global real estate markets and the operations of real estate assets.
Develop data structures and pipelines to organize, collect, cleanse, and standardize information to generate insights and address reporting needs.
Define complex data requirements and gather information using judgment and statistical tests.
Use programming and evaluation tools, including open-source programs to plan models and extract insights.
Identify opportunities to maximize data usage. Apply modeling and optimization methods to develop new strategies and improve business performance.
Develop ad-hoc reporting based on the review of existing data sources.
Exhibit rigor, judgment, and ability to present a highly detailed 'data story' to many levels of the organization.
Confirm the quality and integrity of new and existing data sources.
Collaborate with the agile development team to provide recommendations and communications on enhancing existing or new processes and programs.
Apply general knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish assigned tasks and solve routine problems.
Have a broad knowledge of one's own job discipline and some knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
Impact the quality of own work and the work of others on the team; work within guidelines and policies.
Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. May convince to reach an agreement.
Work primarily within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
Explain complex information to others in straightforward situations.


What You’ll Need


Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. A combination of experience and education will be considered in lieu of a degree. Master’s degree preferred.
Understanding of existing procedures and standards to solve slightly complex problems.
Ability to understand possible solutions using technical experience to apply appropriate judgment and precedents.
In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.


Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Our Values in Hiring

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

Disclaimers

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

About CBRE Group, Inc.

CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2024 revenue). The company has more than 140,000 employees (including Turner & Townsend employees) serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage serving, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Please visit our website at www.cbre.com.

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Sr. Data Analyst position is $120,000 annually [or $57.70 per hour] and the maximum salary for the Sr. Data Analyst position is $130,000 annually [or $62.50 per hour]. The compensation yield to a successful candidate will depend on their skills, qualifications, and experience. Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance

Equal Employment Opportunity: CBRE is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We have a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Candidate Accommodations: CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This position can be based in the Washington D.C or Chicago, IL office.




Position Summary

NAR is seeking a Data Analyst to help deliver data-driven insights, analytics solutions, and AI-enabled products that support decision-making across the organization. This role focuses on working directly with business stakeholders to understand analytical requirements, transform complex and fragmented data into actionable information, and build scalable solutions that provide measurable business value.




The Data Analyst will design and implement data preparation processes, perform advanced analysis, and develop applications and visualizations. They will make data and analysis accessible to non-technical audiences. The role works extensively within the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric ecosystems and involves close collaboration with data scientists, and business stakeholders in different parts of the organization.




The successful candidate will contribute to data quality initiatives, AI-assisted analytics workflows, and the development of new solutions that leverage both traditional analytics and AI technologies. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across analytics, visualization, and application development disciplines, with a practical focus on delivering solutions that are reliable, scalable, and widely adopted by the business.




Duties And Responsibilities

Partner with business stakeholders and non-technical teams to gather requirements, identify opportunities, and deliver data-driven solutions
Extract, transform, clean, and validate data from multiple internal and external sources to support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making
Develop and maintain Python notebooks using SQL, Spark, and related technologies for data analysis, exploration, and reporting
Create dashboards that effectively communicate insights to business audiences using technologies such as Power BI, Streamlit, Django, and other frameworks
Collaborate with Data Scientists on data quality initiatives, statistical analyses, AI-assisted testing frameworks, and machine learning-related projects
Participate in source control, deployment, and project management processes using tools such as Git and Jira
Other duties, as assigned




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience in data analytics or a related technical role.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including experience writing complex queries.
Strong Python development skills, including working with notebooks, expertise with data analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy), and use of visualization libraries (e.g., Plotly, Matplotlib).
Experience building dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Streamlit, or Django.
Experience working with cloud-based platforms and services; Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric experience preferred.
Use of Git and use of project management systems such as Jira.
Good grasp of basic statistical concepts.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Experience with AI, such as the use of AI-code generation, is a positive.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting are preferred




Compensation: $75,000 - $95,000 depending on office location

NAR provides comprehensive benefits including health/dental/vision insurance.

NAR is on a hybrid schedule and in the office 3 days a week.




Organizational Overview

The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) is a team of professionals dedicated to providing world-class service to approximately 1.5 million REALTORS® working in the United States and around the world. The real estate industry is fast-paced and fast-changing--each year, our members participate in the sale, lease, and management of real estate. As in every industry, our members’ value proposition is constantly being challenged by innovation.




It is our mission to empower REALTORS® as they preserve, protect and advance the right to real property for all. We cannot do that without the ideas, passion, and commitment from our talented employees. As our greatest assets, employees are offered their pick of competitive benefits/perks and flexible work options.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Description

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

Realtor.com is a two-sided platform helping match the consumers on our site and apps to our paying customers. The Data Science & Analytics team at Realtor.com provides trusted data and insights to optimize every aspect of consumer/customer experience and to drive the company’s commercial performance.

Avail Realtor.com is a fast-growing platform transforming how independent landlords and tenants manage the rental experience. Built with the spirit of a startup and backed by the scale and stability of a leading digital real estate company, Avail provides a complete suite of tools, resources, and education to help landlords manage their properties with confidence and professionalism. As part of the Avail team, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact – shaping the future of this rapidly expanding brand and helping to reimagine the rental industry for millions across the U.S..

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst with a strong background in business intelligence and strategic analytics to help shape the future of Avail. As a trusted partner to the Avail leadership team, you will be the vital link between complex data and pivotal business moves, striving to enable and empower data-driven decision making across the business.

In this role, you will analyze large and complex data sets, define and track business KPIs, build automated reporting solutions, conduct robust analyses, generate actionable insights, and deliver clear recommendations that inform critical decisions across strategy, product, marketing, and operations.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented analytics expert, a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, and a team player who excels in cross-functional collaborations, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and driven by a desire to make things better.

What You'll Do:

Partner closely with Avail business stakeholders to understand/clarify needs and requirements, and translate them into analytical problems.
If the required data is not available, work with the team to identify the right data sources, and build analytical data layers in collaboration with the data engineering partner.
Independently conduct end-to-end data analytical work from data collection, ETL, analysis, to the delivery of insights and recommendations.
Serve as Avail’s Business Intelligence expert and own KPI development, measurement, tracking, and reporting. Closely monitor KPIs and carry out deep-dive analysis to explain changes and trends, and surface areas of opportunities.
Own and run regular business performance reporting, and actively contribute analytics-related content to business reviews and other reports.
Build automated reports and dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Mixpanel, etc.
Build and grow adoption of self-service solutions that empower stakeholders to access data and insights, and hence accelerate data-driven decision making.
Conduct market and competitor analysis using a variety of internal and external data sources.
Work with Avail leadership team on strategic initiatives and planning, providing analytical support on financial modeling, forecast, opportunity sizing, and so on.

What You Bring:

Bachelor’s degree, ideally in a quantitative field or Data/Business Analytics.
6+ years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role.
SQL proficiency is a must, with 6+ years of experience.
Proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets for quick reporting and ad hoc analysis.
Strong capability to work with complex data sets and perform EDA, descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analyses.
Experience with cloud-based data environments such as Snowflake and AWS.
Significant experience creating business intelligence reports using Tableau, Mixpanel, Power BI, or similar tools.
Proven experience using data and analytics to drive revenue and other business KPIs, and doing so in a proactive manner by actively seeking to identify opportunities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to diverse technical and business audiences at different levels.
Experience in collaborating with cross-functional partners.
Experience managing multiple priorities, responding to urgent data requests, and adapting to changing business needs and priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a quantitative field or Data/Business Analytics.
Proficiency with a scripting language such as Python or R.
Experience in the tech sector, especially marketplace or property tech.

How We Work:

We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.

How We Reward You:

Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to:

Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage
Family forming benefits
13 Paid Holidays
Flexible Time Off
8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off
Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3.5% company match
Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non-degreed programs
1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions
Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program
Free snacks and refreshments in each office location

Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com®

Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow.

Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals.

Lone Star Circle of Care (LSCC) Business Intelligence department (BI) seeks a highly qualified candidate to fill the position of Healthcare Data Analyst. BI is driven by its mission to deliver quality, cost-effective services to the neediest Texans. This position makes a significant contribution to LSCC's mission by assisting with data reporting and analytical activities.

The Healthcare Data Analyst performs complex data collection, reporting and analysis to monitor, evaluate and increase efficiencies for LSCC. Work involves conducting detailed analysis of and extensive research on data, used for financial estimates and operational deliverables. Includes providing results, and monitoring and implementing data quality. May provide guidance to others. Works under general supervision, with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment. The Healthcare Data Analyst works with various teams to explore different aspects of a system (people, policy, and processes) to determine why particular areas are performing well or have opportunities for improvement

The ideal candidate thrives in an environment that emphasizes teamwork to achieve goals, excellence through high professional standards and personal accountability, curiosity to continuously grow and learn, critical thinking for effective execution, and integrity to do things right even when what is right is not easy. This position will be required to travel to other LSCC facilities as needed. The Data Analyst collaborates with employees at all levels of the organization, fosters positive and professional working relationships, and delivers exceptional customer service.



A Day in the Life of a Data Analyst may look like this:


Attends work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with LSCC's leave policy and performs other duties as assigned.
Analyzes data using standard statistical tools, methods, and techniques. Consults with internal and external customers and LSCC staff to identify user needs. Compiles and queries data. Identifies data gaps, errors, anomalies, inconsistencies, and redundancies by analyzing the content, structure, and relationships within data. Interprets results to identify significant differences in data. Identifies and interprets data patterns and trends and assesses data quality. Cleans and prunes data to discard irrelevant information.
Prepares concise, comprehensive technical reports to present and interpret data, identify alternatives, and make and justify recommendations on data revisions. Assists in defining, developing, and implementing data standards. Assists in developing data quality measures, analyzing data quality results, and implementing necessary changes to ensure data quality improvement. Assists in developing statistical modeling and graphical analysis
Create comprehensive documentation for new developments, updates, and enhancements for both developers and end-users.
May develop and implement data collection systems, data analytics, and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality.
May perform quality assurance and serve as a subject matter expert on data integrity, extraction, and compilation. May guide the selection of data management tools, and the development of standards, usage guidelines, and procedures for those tools.
May provide guidance to others.
Performs related work as assigned.




We ask our Data Analysts to possess a minimum of:


Experience in data, reporting or business analytics
Experience in gathering requirements for reporting


The following experience/skills are preferred:


Experience and education may be substituted for one another with experience in healthcare, Medicaid, or other medical report data preferred.
Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with major coursework in data science, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, management information systems, accounting, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field is generally preferred.
Knowledge of SQL preferred.


Key Success Factors

Some key factors that will make an individual successful in this role:


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools.

Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems


Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance

Designing analytics that help brands forecast sales and demand
Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights

Required


4+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics roles
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong experience building dashboards and analytical reports

Strong communication skills working with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience with BI tools (Omni, Looker, Mode, etc.)
Experience working with financial, retail, or operational datasets
Comfort working directly with users
Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles
Technical or quantitative degree

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Summary:

The Sr Data Analyst partners with stakeholders across P&C Operations (Underwriting, Product, Actuarial, Claims, and Marketing) to deliver advanced analytical insights that inform business strategy and operational decision-making.




This role’s responsibility includes performing data analysis (e.g., conceptualization, mining/modeling, and presentation of data) and developing methods to efficiently capture, manage, and analyze data.




The position serves as a trusted partner to business leaders by translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and identifying opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.

This is a 100% in-office position. Candidates must be able to work on-site at a designated company office during standard business hours.




Essential Responsibilities:

Partners with stakeholders to define business problems, translate data needs into analytical solutions, and ensure alignment between business objectives and data outputs.
Develops and maintains methods to distribute management information, as appropriate, throughout P&C Operations using tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Designs, develops, and maintains dashboards (Power BI), reports, and data products for use throughout P&C Operations using the tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Develops and optimizes SQL queries, Python/PySpark scripts, and data pipelines to extract, transform, and validate data for analysis and reporting.
Independently leads analytics initiatives, managing priorities, timelines, and deliverables from intake through deployment.
Responds to support questions promptly, courteously, and accurately, with an analysis of the results and any issues or changes made with minimal guidance.
Synthesizes analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations, tailoring communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure enterprise reporting and analytics adhere to defined data governance standards, business rules, and data quality expectations.
Validates data accuracy and completeness across source systems and downstream reporting layers, identifying trends, anomalies, and data quality issues. Performs quality assurance checks to validate completeness and accuracy of data and/or deliverables for release with minimal guidance.
Supports recurring operational data needs (e.g., month‑end, quarter‑end, and ongoing production reporting cycles) by ensuring timely, accurate delivery of analytics and reports.
Identifies trends, patterns, and opportunities within data to support process improvements and strategic initiatives.




Additional Responsibilities:

Document, update, and utilize the policies, procedures, and processes used throughout P&C Operations.
Mentor junior analysts by reviewing policies, procedures, and processes and validating the queries/code, reports, and dashboards for accuracy and quality.
Proactively identify opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders to remedy the errors timely with minimal guidance.
Ensures that the data produced remains secure, respecting corporate privacy and security procedures.
Assists with training for stakeholders in areas such as proper data usage, SQL, or Power BI.
Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure alignment between analytics solutions and enterprise data platforms (e.g., cloud data warehouses, semantic models, and BI environments).




Qualifications / Experience Required:

Four to six years of relevant work experience
Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, computer science, data science, data analytics, or a related field. Equivalent work experience in a business or technical environment will be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
Proficient in Python/PySpark, SQL (CTE, window functions) and Power BI using graphs, charts, and map features.
Experience in data quality control/governance, data mining, and modeling
Working knowledge of emerging analytics technology (e.g., Agentic AI/ML concepts)
Strong soft skills with clear, effective oral and written communication.




Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake Ecosystem, and Visual Studio Code
Strong understanding of Property & Casualty insurance data concepts and operational workflows is preferred.




The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.




$113,000 - $143,000

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation


Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives


Business Intelligence


Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies


Data Management


Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality


Our ideal candidate will have:


Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services


Basic Qualifications:


Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)


Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

McLean, VA: $111,200 - $126,900 for Sr. Data Analyst

Richmond, VA: $101,100 - $115,400 for Sr. Data Analyst

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries.

If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1-800-304-9102 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com

Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site.

Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. (COPSSC).
