Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Why Bison:


Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability



Bison Transport is committed to Diversity and Inclusion in the Workplace.

Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, performance tuning, and data validation.

Strong Excel skills for ad-hoc analysis and validation work.
Experience with data quality frameworks and validation techniques.

Experience with operational or real-time reporting environments.
Familiarity with railroad, logistics, or transportation data.
Exposure to the Azure data stack, including ADF, Synapse, and Databricks.
Understanding of event-driven systems and streaming data.


Soft Skills


Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to translate data into business impact.
Ability to work across business and technology teams without formal authority.
Highly analytical with a strong problem-solving mindset.
Self-driven and able to operate in ambiguous and fast-paced environments.

Description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and business-focused Senior Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Life Insurance operations. Reporting to the Head of Lead Management, this role will be responsible for delivering insights that optimize sales performance, improve customer retention, and support new market expansion initiatives through the transfer of operational knowledge and best practices. The successful candidate will leverage analytics, automation solutions to improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experience.




Key Responsibilities




1. Sales Optimization & Growth Support (30%)

Analyze sales performance and identify opportunities to improve lead conversion, agent productivity, and overall sales effectiveness
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting for key sales metrics
Support forecasting, capacity planning, and sales strategy initiatives
Provide actionable insights to support the continued growth of the sales organization
Identify opportunities to automate reporting and business process




2. Care & Support Analytics (Post-Sales & Retention) (50%)

Analyze customer and policyholder behavior to identify drivers of retention, persistency, and customer satisfaction.
Monitor and report on key post-sales metrics, including retention, service levels, and customer experience.
Partner with Care & Support teams to identify operational improvement opportunities.
Support the development and measurement of customer retention initiatives.
Deliver insights that improve customer lifetime value and operational effectiveness.




3. New Market Expansion & Knowledge Transfer (20%)

Support the organization's expansion into new markets by documenting and transferring key operational, sales, lead management, and customer service learnings from existing business operations.
Partner with stakeholders to capture best practices, processes, reporting frameworks, and performance insights that can be leveraged in future markets.
Develop and maintain knowledge repositories, documentation, and reporting standards to support successful market launches.
Identify opportunities to replicate successful sales, lead management, and customer retention strategies across markets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure operational readiness and consistency during market expansion initiatives.
Track and report on key readiness milestones and business learnings throughout implementation programs.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Economics, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related role.
Experience in Life Insurance, Financial Services, or a regulated industry is preferred.




Technical Skills

Strong SQL skills, including Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL).
Experience using Python for data analysis, reporting, and automation.
Proficiency with Power BI and/or Tableau.
Experience with Databricks and modern analytics tools.
Working knowledge of AI/Machine Learning concepts and predictive analytics.
Experience building automated reporting, dashboards, and ETL processes.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.




Core Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Customer-focused mindset with strong business acumen.




Benefits




That's why you can expect to be rewarded for the hard work you put in through job satisfaction, career development and the fantastic range of benefits we offer:




What's in it for you?




4 weeks vacation per year
10 paid sick days per year
Hybrid role – 3 days in office and 2 days work-from-home
100% employer paid health benefits from day 1 including $500 Healthcare Spending Account
Parental leave top-up
5% RRSP matching after 3 months of service
Learning and growth opportunities
Free weekly lunches, epic social events, and more!

Title: Data Analyst - SQL / Databricks
Description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role

As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence organization, you will turn operational and customer data into actionable reports and dashboards that drive business decisions. You will partner directly with internal business teams, such as sales compensation, to gather reporting requirements, document technical specifications, and build user friendly data assets.

Your primary hands-on work will involve writing SQL views and building dashboards directly within Databricks using data populated by our engineering team. A key aspect of this role is context engineering, where you will add structured descriptions and metadata to tables, views, and columns so that our data is easily discoverable and accurately queried by AI tools like Claude. Additionally, you will validate report accuracy, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation of your reporting logic to ensure long-term reliability.

Your Opportunity


You will have the opportunity to build and scale the business reporting layer within Databricks.
You will be part of a globally distributed team of data professionals.
This role is designed for someone who wants to grow their analytical skills in a collaborative, business facing environment.
Leverage modern AI coding agents, such as Databricks' Genie or Claude, to assist in writing and optimizing your queries.


What You'll Need


2 to 4 years of experience in a business intelligence, reporting, or data analyst role.
To be considered for this role, you must meet one of the following criteria: Hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Columbia, MD office three days a week, or hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Boston, MA office three days a week.
Fundamental working proficiency in SQL, including an understanding of select statements, order of operations, joins, aggregations, and filtering.
Basic to working proficiency with Databrick, a comparable lakehouse, or cloud data platform such as Snowflake.
Experience building dashboards and presenting data visually using tools like Databricks native dashboards, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical business stakeholders and translate them into usable data assets.
A detail oriented mindset with comfort in documenting data objects, definitions, and logic for downstream users.


And Ideally


Prior experience writing table and column descriptions or metadata to support data catalogs, semantic layers, or natural language query tools.
Exposure to Python or PySpark within Databricks notebooks, which will give you a significant advantage for career progression on this specific team.
Familiarity with analytics engineering practices, such as dbt, or version control systems like Git.
Experience working in enterprise software, SaaS, or cybersecurity environments.


This is the base pay range for this position. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. Tenable also offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits which include: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) retirement savings with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; an employee referral program; flexible spending accounts; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); education assistance; parental leave; paid time off (PTO); company-paid holidays; health and wellness events; and community programs.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clair

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. But we're not just another digital bank or on-demand pay provider. We meet Americans at their place of work by embedding our products within the scheduling, workforce management, and payroll apps they already use every day.

Learn more about us at getclair.com/about

About The Role

We’re looking for a top-tier analytics professional to deliver insights that drive growth. As a Senior Data Analyst at Clair, you’ll join a growing team of data practitioners who are passionate about bringing financial security to underserved communities by giving workers access to their earnings right when they need them. As a trusted thought partner to product and business teams, you’ll surface impactful insights supporting their goals. Through experimentation, analysis, modeling, and dashboard development, you’ll surface recommendations to enable Clair to reach millions of hourly workers and help them get paid on demand.

The ideal candidate will consider themselves a “full stack” data analyst with experience across the entire data pipeline, including data ingestion, processing, modeling, and visualization. This person will be comfortable with the analytics engineering workflow, mixing technical proficiency with the ability to engage stakeholders across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Leverage data to drive user growth, identify trends, and influence product and business decisions
Collaborate with cross-functional business partners to address key analytical questions and evaluate hypotheses, leveraging data to drive innovation and novel solutions.
Define and manage key metrics that inform strategic product, growth, and operational decisions, ensuring alignment with business goals
Put data at the fingertips of stakeholders and enable them to independently explore and utilize data
Build efficient data ingestion and transformation pipelines using tools like dbt
Develop intuitive dashboards, memos, slides, and other visualizations that tell stories and inspire action
Collaborate to brainstorm ideas, verify analyses, and review the work of your peers to ensure accuracy and quality


Qualifications


4–5 years of professional experience in the data analytics field
Fluent in SQL (translating business questions to queries, understanding joins and functions, and building data pipelines)
Experience with experimentation and statistical analysis to guide decision-making
Passionate about building the best version of whatever you’re working on


Things We Consider a Plus


Experience with the modern data stack, including Snowflake, dbt, Tableau
Experience with a scripting language like Python or R
Interest in financial systems and consumer behavior
Experience with machine learning or statistical modeling
Experience in a high-growth start-up environment


Additional Details

Location: This is a hybrid position based out of New York City, you will be expected to come into the office at least three days a week (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, & Thursdays) with additional days on occasion for client meetings.

Compensation: The annual base salary for this role is $150,000-$160,000. The base pay for this role is determined using many factors, such as education, skills and experience and is reflective of Clair Series stage and size. Base pay is only one part of Clair’s competitive total compensation package which includes equity, benefits and additional perks. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Clair will only contact candidates from @getclair.com email addresses. We will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you happen to receive anything suspicious, please ignore it.

Need more convincing?

Benefits

Apart from getting to work with our incredible team, here are some of the benefits you can expect when you join Clair:


Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage, with option to extend to your family
Fully-paid parental leave
Company-sponsored 401k, HSA, and FSA
Unlimited vacation for salaried roles, generous PTO for hourly roles
Work from home setup allowance
Access to your earnings every day on Clair
Company-sponsored short-term and long-term disability insurance


Equal Opportunity Employer Information

Clair is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For questions, please email us at careers@getclair.com

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description & Responsibilities

Persistent Systems is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team in our New York City headquarters. The Data Analyst will transform complex operational, financial, customer, product, and program data into accurate, timely, and actionable insights. This role will build trusted datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and analyses that help leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, manage risk, and make evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined problem solver and an effective "data translator" who can move comfortably between business questions and technical details. They combine strong SQL, data preparation, visualization, statistical reasoning, and stakeholder communication skills with a sharp eye for data quality and user experience.

Position Responsibilities


Own analytical work from requirements discovery and source-data assessment through transformation, modeling, validation, visualization, delivery, and ongoing support
Partner with leaders and subject-matter experts across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Product, and other functions to define key performance indicators (KPIs), reporting logic, and success measures
Develop reliable, reusable analytics assets and clear documentation so that metrics, assumptions, transformations, and data lineage can be understood and maintained
Apply statistical and analytical methods appropriate to the business question, communicate uncertainty and limitations, and distinguish correlation from evidence of causation
Promote secure, governed, accessible, and responsible use of data while improving self-service analytics across the organization
Design, build, and maintain intuitive dashboards, scorecards, semantic models, and recurring reports using Power BI as the primary platform and Tableau where appropriate
Write, review, and optimize complex SQL queries across relational databases, cloud warehouses, and Lakehouse platforms; reconcile results to source systems and explain query logic
Clean, profile, map, join, and transform structured and semi-structured data using Power Query, Python/pandas, spreadsheets, and related tools; design fact and dimension models using star-schema principles
Build or contribute to repeatable extraction, transformation, and loading workflows using frameworks and platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, and Databricks; monitor failures and document lineage
Analyze historical and current data to identify trends, drivers, anomalies, risks, and opportunities; perform segmentation, variance analysis, forecasting, cohort analysis, and experiment analysis when relevant
Create validation rules, reconciliations, exception reporting, and quality checks; investigate discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate durable fixes with data owners and engineering teams
Translate open-ended questions into measurable definitions, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and analytics plans; establish consistent KPI definitions and a shared business glossary
Reduce manual reporting through scheduled refreshes, parameterized workflows, Power Automate, reusable templates, and governed self-service datasets
Present concise findings and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences, using accessible visual design and clear narrative rather than relying on charts alone
Support embedded or custom analytics experiences using JavaScript visualization libraries and component-based charting tools such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, Chart.js, and shadcn/ui chart components
Explore responsible uses of Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and generative AI frameworks to accelerate discovery, natural-language analytics, documentation, and workflow assistance while validating outputs against trusted data


Job Qualifications & Experience

Minimum Qualifications


2–5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related role
Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, finance, computer science, information systems, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
Advanced proficiency in SQL, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregation, query validation, and performance-aware analysis
Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modeling, interactive report design, refresh strategies, workspace management, and row-level security; comparable Tableau depth is also valued
Advanced spreadsheet skills and practical experience reconciling, cleaning, and validating data from multiple sources
Working knowledge of dimensional data modeling, KPI design, data dictionaries, ETL/ELT concepts, and source-to-target mapping
Experience using Python with pandas and/or R for data manipulation, exploratory analysis, or statistical work
Understanding of descriptive statistics, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and common analytical pitfalls
Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, manage multiple priorities, communicate findings clearly, and influence decisions with evidence
Must have a United States Security Clearance or be able to obtain a United States Security Clearance


Relevant Certifications Or Credentials, Such As


Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)
Tableau Certified Data Analyst
Tableau Desktop Specialist certification
Experience operating in a regulated, security-sensitive, government, or defense-adjacent environment


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with ETL/ELT frameworks and orchestration platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, Databricks, or comparable tools
Experience building solutions with Power Platform, Power Apps, and Power Automate, including governed connections to enterprise data
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry for secure AI-assisted analytics, agent experiences, or workflow augmentation
Familiarity with generative AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex and the ability to identify appropriate, verifiable analytics use cases
Experience with JavaScript visualization libraries such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, or Chart.js, including shadcn/ui chart components built on Recharts
Experience with cloud data warehouses or Lakehouse platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift
Experience with Git, analytics testing, version-controlled SQL or semantic models, CI/CD, and collaborative development practices
Experience with data catalogs, lineage, access controls, sensitivity labels, or governance platforms such as Microsoft Purview
Experience designing experiments, performing A/B test analysis, building forecasts, or applying regression and other classical statistical methods


The total compensation for this role can vary from $133,000 to $166,000 a year based on individual qualifications. Eligibility for yearly discretionary bonus. Persistent Systems, LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; paid time off (sick time and vacation time); flexible spending accounts; 401(k) plan with company match; fitness membership reimbursement; tuition assistance; mental health benefits; and pet discounts.

Company Overview

Headquartered in New York City since 2007, Persistent Systems, LLC is a global communications technology company which develops, manufactures, and integrates a patented and secure Mobile Ad Hoc Networking (MANET) system: Wave Relay®. The company’s industry leading R&D team has designed wireless networking protocols to support their cutting-edge Wave Relay® system and technology. Wave Relay® is capable of running data, video, voice and other applications under the most difficult and unpredictable conditions. Their suite of products is field proven and utilized in Commercial, Military, Government, Industrial, Agriculture, Robotics, and Unmanned System markets.

Title: IAR Data Analyst
Description:
If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider WGU as the next step in your career.

Driven by a mission to expand access to higher education through online, competency-based degree programs, WGU is also committed to being a great place to work for a diverse workforce of student-focused professionals. The university has pioneered a new way to learn in the 21st century, one that has received praise from academic, industry, government, and media leaders. Whatever your role, working for WGU gives you a part to play in helping students graduate, creating a better tomorrow for themselves and their families.

The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

At WGU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is:

Grade: Professional 308

Pay Range: $75,200.00 - $112,700.00

Job Description

The IAR Data Analyst is responsible for extracting, processing, analyzing, and reporting on data to produce rigorous, actionable insights and research. They establish and maintain strong relationships with peers and leaders across IAR, Data Engineering, Product Management, Finance, EdTech, and Faculty staff. They perform ad hoc analyses, build standard reports and data visualizations, and deliver information and insights through various methods and media that privilege data storytelling and compress time-to-action.

Impact You'll Make

At WGU, data plays a critical role in shaping the student experience and informing strategic decisions. As a Data Analyst, you will transform complex data into actionable insights that support program development, student engagement, and marketing effectiveness. Working cross-functionally with stakeholders across Program Development, Product, Decision Intelligence, Marketing, and Data Engineering, you will help drive meaningful outcomes through data-driven decision-making.

What You'll Do


Analyze large datasets to uncover trends and deliver actionable insights that inform program development, student engagement strategies, and marketing initiatives.
Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and data visualizations, including consolidating and improving existing reporting assets.
Translate stakeholder needs and ambiguous business questions into technical requirements and data-driven solutions.
Partner with Data Engineering to support ETL and data pipeline development while ensuring data quality and reliability.
Perform ad hoc analyses and communicate findings through compelling data storytelling and recommendations.
Apply descriptive statistics, translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches, identify root causes and performance drivers, and develop actionable recommendations and analytical techniques to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Program Development, Product, Marketing, and Decision Intelligence to support strategic initiatives and drive business impact.
Analyze customer journeys, marketing funnels, audience segments, and channel performance to identify drivers of acquisition, engagement, conversion, and downstream outcomes.


What You'll Bring


Bachelor's degree in a related discipline.
3 years of related experience in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Decision Intelligence, Research, Learning Science, Behavioral/Cognitive Psychology, Marketing Analytics, or Digital Analytics.
Strong SQL skills and experience querying large datasets.
Experience with Tableau or Power BI for data visualization.
Experience working with ETL or ELT processes and data pipelines.
Solid working knowledge of descriptive statistics and analytical methods, with the ability to apply them to real-world datasets
Ability to apply sound judgment and analytical thinking to identify root causes of data issues and inform recommendations.


Bonus Points


Experience working with large-scale datasets containing millions of records.
Familiarity with Databricks or similar data platforms.
Proficiency in a programming language such as Python or R, experience with GitHub and analytics documentation standards, and experience contributing to dashboard optimization or consolidation projects.
Experience with marketing, digital, or customer journey analytics, preferably with hands-on experience for Adobe Analytics and/or Adobe Customer Journey Analytics or other related platforms.
Experience with marketing funnel measurement, attribution modeling, channel performance analysis, customer segmentation, and marketing experimentation and testing.
Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable technical and analytical solutions.
Experience applying root cause analysis and diagnostic methodologies to identify drivers of business performance and data issues.
Experience producing AI-assisted analytics, including leveraging AI-enabled tools and technologies to accelerate analysis, generate insights, enhance reporting, and support data-driven decision-making.


Experience In Lieu Of Education

An equivalent combination of education and experience that demonstrates the required competencies may be considered.

What To Expect

At WGU, our mission drives everything we do, including how we hire. Our interview experience is designed to allow qualified candidates to show their best work through meaningful conversations and collaboration.

We thoughtfully review every application and invite forward the candidates whose experience and potential best align with the role and our mission.


Introductory call
Hiring manager interview
Technical interview
Interview with Sr Director


Work Location

This is a full-time, in-office position requiring five days per week in our Salt Lake City, UT office, designed to foster the collaboration and connection that fuel our best work.

Visa Sponsorship

While we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, WGU is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

Travel Requirement

This position requires occasional travel of up to 20%, including required attendance at designated company summits (typically one to two per year). Additional travel may include conferences, visits to company locations, and other business-related events as needed. Additional travel may be assigned as needed to support business requirements.

Position & Application Details

Full-Time Regular Positions (classified as regular and working 40 standard weekly hours): This is a full-time, regular position (classified for 40 standard weekly hours) that is eligible for bonuses; medical, dental, vision, telehealth and mental healthcare; health savings account and flexible spending account; basic and voluntary life insurance; disability coverage; accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity supplemental coverages; legal and identity theft coverage; retirement savings plan; wellbeing program; discounted WGU tuition; and flexible paid time off for rest and relaxation with no need for accrual, flexible paid sick time with no need for accrual, 11 paid holidays, and other paid leaves, including up to 12 weeks of parental leave.

How to Apply: If interested, an application will need to be submitted online. Internal WGU employees will need to apply through the internal job board in Workday.

Accommodations: Applicants with disabilities who require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process should contact our Talent Acquisition team at recruiting@wgu.edu.

Equal Employment Opportunity: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic as required by law.

Description:
This position develops and maintains reports, dashboards, scorecards, and performance metrics; analyzes organizational data; ensures data accuracy and integrity; and provides actionable insights to executive leadership, physicians, department leaders, quality, finance, revenue cycle, clinical teams, and other stakeholders.


Expected pay for this position is $29.84-$44.75. Actual pay will be determined by experience, skills and internal equity.
MDH Benefits package includes:
Medical, Dental, Vision
457B and employer match
Company paid STD and LTD
Job Summary
The Healthcare Data Analyst serves as an enterprise reporting and analytics resource, transforming healthcare data into meaningful information that supports strategic, operational, financial, clinical, quality, and regulatory decision-making.

The Healthcare Data Analyst will also promote standardized reporting practices, automation, documentation, and continuous improvement while supporting the long-term sustainability of the organization's reporting and decision-support processes.

Bachelor's degree required in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Health Information Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Accounting, Public Health, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.


Job Specifications
Education


Experience

Three years of progressively responsible experience preferred in healthcare analytics, business intelligence, decision support, data analysis, financial analysis, quality reporting, or healthcare operations. Hospital experience strongly preferred.

Technical Knowledge & Skills


Advanced Microsoft Excel
SQL and database concepts
Data analysis, statistical analysis, forecasting, and benchmarking
Data visualization and dashboard development
Microsoft Power BI preferred
Crystal Reports, SSRS, or equivalent reporting tools preferred
Microsoft Office Suite
Electronic Health Record reporting systems


Professional Skills


Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities
Excellent written and verbal communication
Ability to translate complex data into clear information for non-technical audiences
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Effective organization, prioritization, and problem-solving skills
Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities
Strong customer-service and collaboration skills
Ability to maintain confidentiality


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Cerner or other EHR reporting tools
Experience with healthcare financial and revenue cycle reporting
Knowledge of CMS and healthcare quality measures
Experience developing dashboards and executive scorecards
Experience with healthcare benchmarking databases
Experience with healthcare budgeting, productivity, and operational analytics

Managing and analyzing maternal and neonatal health data.
Supporting data collection, reporting, and grant compliance requirements.
Measuring program outcomes and developing reports to inform maternal health initiatives in rural communities.
Supporting quality measures, program evaluation, and evidence-based decision-making.
Collaborating with clinical and community partners on maternal health data needs.


Preferred perinatal experience includes Obstetrics, maternal/neonatal health, public health grants, HRSA-funded programs, quality measures, database analysis, programming, or grant administration.

Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, SPSS, SAS, R, Tableau, or Power BI is beneficial.

Deliver accurate, timely, and reliable reporting.
Provide actionable analytics that support organizational decision-making.
Improve reporting efficiency through standardization and automation.
Maintain high standards of data integrity and validation.
Develop dashboards and reports that promote organizational transparency.
Support regulatory, quality, financial, clinical, and operational reporting needs.
Maintain clear documentation to ensure continuity of reporting processes.
Provide excellent service to hospital departments and leadership.
Maintain current knowledge of healthcare analytics, reporting technologies, and regulatory requirements.

Title: Data Analyst, Administration & Finance
Description:
Pay Range

The UMass President’s Office expects to pay within an approximate hiring range between $60,000 - $75,000 for this position. The specific pay for this position will be determined by the University based on consideration of all relevant factors when and if it decides to extend an offer of employment.

Primary Work Location:

Westborough, MA. Hybrid schedule.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President of Administration & Finance Support Services (Access) Team, the Data Analyst is responsible for developing analysis, reporting, and dashboard capabilities that support operational and strategic decision-making across Administration & Finance.

The Data Analyst will collaborate with data and analytics professionals across the Administration & Finance function, as well as product owners/stakeholders, and A&F leadership, to understand business requirements and translate them into effective analytics solutions. The position will monitor data quality and performance, validate data for accuracy and consistency, and identify opportunities to strengthen reporting processes and controls.

Working closely with IT and other technical partners, the Data Analyst will support the development of data models and the automation of data workflows and reporting processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and reliability. The position is also responsible for designing and developing intuitive, insightful dashboards, reports, and presentations that effectively communicate key performance indicators (KPIs), trends, and actionable insights to stakeholders and leadership.

Essential Functions


Design, develop, maintain, and enhance interactive dashboards and data visualizations that effectively communicate key metrics, trends, and insights.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities, and translate findings into meaningful and actionable insights.
Acquire, integrate, and prepare data from multiple sources for analysis and reporting.
Perform data validation and quality assurance to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data; investigate discrepancies and collaborate with IT and other technical partners to resolve data issues.
Develop and maintain KPI calculations, business rules, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistent and accurate reporting.
Identify opportunities to streamline and automate data preparation, validation, and recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across Administration & Finance to understand business requirements and develop appropriate analytical solutions.
Conduct ad hoc analyses and prepare reports, presentations, and analytical summaries that clearly communicate findings to managers and leadership.
Maintain documentation of data sources, calculations, business rules, reporting processes, and identified data issues and resolutions.
Perform testing and validation of new data sources, data models, system enhancements, and reporting solutions to ensure accuracy and alignment with business requirements.
Perform other related duties and support special projects and initiatives as assigned.



Other Functions

Perform other duties as may be assigned.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education, Experience)


BS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics.
1-3 years' experience as a data analyst or business data analyst.
Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.
Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
Advanced skills in creating interactive and visually compelling dashboards and reports that communicate data insights and findings clearly to business stakeholders.

Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences

Job Number: R0239936

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data analyst like you to bring your knowledge to the Navy.

As a client-facing data analyst on our team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on DoW acquisition programs and help accomplish project goals within budget as we improve IT capabilities for the military.

Work with us to help drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


2+ years of experience with Python, R, or SQL for data manipulation and analysis
2+ years of experience performing research, recommending strategies and performance metrics, and supporting business intelligence
Experience with data engineering in Databricks or Spark
Ability to be self-motivated and pay strict attention to detail
Secret clearance
Bachelor's degree



Nice If You Have:


Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Matplotlib, and Seaborn
Experience building or maintaining data pipelines
Knowledge of data science skillsets, including Pandas, Polars, Scikit-learn, Pytorch, Tensorflow, and R
Knowledge of AI engineering

Databricks or Power BI Certification

Description:

The Data & Analytics team is building Compass International Holdings' analytical platform - the governed foundation the company runs on. As a Data Analyst, you'll go beyond traditional dashboards and ticket queues - you will work cross-functionally with internal teams and business partners to leverage that foundation, delivering recommendations that drive decision-making.

We #obsess about the opportunity in front of our organization to continue building a transformative asset that unlocks insights for the company. We are looking for someone to join our team that shares in this enthusiasm and passion for leveraging data to make decisions.

At Compass You Will


Accelerate Decision-Making: Structure clear options and trade-offs that enable the business to act faster with clarity
Deliver High-Impact Narratives: Package complex findings into clear narratives that give business partners the evidence and confidence to make a decision
Unlock Data Value: Turn the organization's investment in data infrastructure into tangible business outcomes - ensuring data actively drives strategy
Bridge Insights to Strategy: Translate traditional business intelligence and data science assets into concrete recommendations for the business
Reframe Business Problems: Work within a project team to turn reactive requests into structured analytical questions
Work with Trusted Data: Use your technical skills to navigate centrally managed datasets - spending your time on analysis, not data wrangling

Includes providing results, and monitoring and implementing data quality. May provide guidance to others. Works under general supervision, with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment. The Healthcare Data Analyst works with various teams to explore different aspects of a system (people, policy, and processes) to determine why particular areas are performing well or have opportunities for improvement

The ideal candidate thrives in an environment that emphasizes teamwork to achieve goals, excellence through high professional standards and personal accountability, curiosity to continuously grow and learn, critical thinking for effective execution, and integrity to do things right even when what is right is not easy. This position will be required to travel to other LSCC facilities as needed. The Data Analyst collaborates with employees at all levels of the organization, fosters positive and professional working relationships, and delivers exceptional customer service.



A Day in the Life of a Data Analyst may look like this:


Attends work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with LSCC's leave policy and performs other duties as assigned.
Analyzes data using standard statistical tools, methods, and techniques. Consults with internal and external customers and LSCC staff to identify user needs. Compiles and queries data. Identifies data gaps, errors, anomalies, inconsistencies, and redundancies by analyzing the content, structure, and relationships within data. Interprets results to identify significant differences in data. Identifies and interprets data patterns and trends and assesses data quality. Cleans and prunes data to discard irrelevant information.
Prepares concise, comprehensive technical reports to present and interpret data, identify alternatives, and make and justify recommendations on data revisions. Assists in defining, developing, and implementing data standards. Assists in developing data quality measures, analyzing data quality results, and implementing necessary changes to ensure data quality improvement. Assists in developing statistical modeling and graphical analysis
Create comprehensive documentation for new developments, updates, and enhancements for both developers and end-users.
May develop and implement data collection systems, data analytics, and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality.
May perform quality assurance and serve as a subject matter expert on data integrity, extraction, and compilation. May guide the selection of data management tools, and the development of standards, usage guidelines, and procedures for those tools.
May provide guidance to others.
Performs related work as assigned.




We ask our Data Analysts to possess a minimum of:


Experience in data, reporting or business analytics
Experience in gathering requirements for reporting


The following experience/skills are preferred:


Experience and education may be substituted for one another with experience in healthcare, Medicaid, or other medical report data preferred.
Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with major coursework in data science, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, management information systems, accounting, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field is generally preferred.
Knowledge of SQL preferred.


Key Success Factors

Some key factors that will make an individual successful in this role:


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools.
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
Effective communication and collaboration with stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.


Benefits

LSCC offers a competitive benefits package, including:


Competitive salary;
Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance;
LSCC paid Life insurance;
LSCC paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability insurance;
Paid Time Off; and
403b Employee Retirement Plan

Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability

  • Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
  • Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
  • Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
  • Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
  • Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
  • Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
  • Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
  • Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.

Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.

A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.

Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights

4+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, mobile apps, or other digital products

Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. As a trusted thought partner to product and business teams, you’ll surface impactful insights supporting their goals. Through experimentation, analysis, modeling, and dashboard development, you’ll surface recommendations to enable Clair to reach millions of hourly workers and help them get paid on demand.

The ideal candidate will consider themselves a “full stack” data analyst with experience across the entire data pipeline, including data ingestion, processing, modeling, and visualization. This person will be comfortable with the analytics engineering workflow, mixing technical proficiency with the ability to engage stakeholders across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Leverage data to drive user growth, identify trends, and influence product and business decisions
Collaborate with cross-functional business partners to address key analytical questions and evaluate hypotheses, leveraging data to drive innovation and novel solutions.
Define and manage key metrics that inform strategic product, growth, and operational decisions, ensuring alignment with business goals
Put data at the fingertips of stakeholders and enable them to independently explore and utilize data
Build efficient data ingestion and transformation pipelines using tools like dbt
Develop intuitive dashboards, memos, slides, and other visualizations that tell stories and inspire action
Collaborate to brainstorm ideas, verify analyses, and review the work of your peers to ensure accuracy and quality


Qualifications


4–5 years of professional experience in the data analytics field
Fluent in SQL (translating business questions to queries, understanding joins and functions, and building data pipelines)
Experience with experimentation and statistical analysis to guide decision-making
Passionate about building the best version of whatever you’re working on

Experience with the modern data stack, including Snowflake, dbt, Tableau

Experience with machine learning or statistical modeling
Experience in a high-growth start-up environment

Title: Data Analyst - SQL / Databricks
Description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role

As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence organization, you will turn operational and customer data into actionable reports and dashboards that drive business decisions. You will partner directly with internal business teams, such as sales compensation, to gather reporting requirements, document technical specifications, and build user friendly data assets.

Your primary hands-on work will involve writing SQL views and building dashboards directly within Databricks using data populated by our engineering team. A key aspect of this role is context engineering, where you will add structured descriptions and metadata to tables, views, and columns so that our data is easily discoverable and accurately queried by AI tools like Claude. Additionally, you will validate report accuracy, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation of your reporting logic to ensure long-term reliability.

Your Opportunity


You will have the opportunity to build and scale the business reporting layer within Databricks.
You will be part of a globally distributed team of data professionals.
This role is designed for someone who wants to grow their analytical skills in a collaborative, business facing environment.
Leverage modern AI coding agents, such as Databricks' Genie or Claude, to assist in writing and optimizing your queries.


What You'll Need


2 to 4 years of experience in a business intelligence, reporting, or data analyst role.
To be considered for this role, you must meet one of the following criteria: Hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Columbia, MD office three days a week, or hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Boston, MA office three days a week.
Fundamental working proficiency in SQL, including an understanding of select statements, order of operations, joins, aggregations, and filtering.
Basic to working proficiency with Databrick, a comparable lakehouse, or cloud data platform such as Snowflake.
Experience building dashboards and presenting data visually using tools like Databricks native dashboards, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical business stakeholders and translate them into usable data assets.
A detail oriented mindset with comfort in documenting data objects, definitions, and logic for downstream users.


And Ideally


Prior experience writing table and column descriptions or metadata to support data catalogs, semantic layers, or natural language query tools.
Exposure to Python or PySpark within Databricks notebooks, which will give you a significant advantage for career progression on this specific team.
Familiarity with analytics engineering practices, such as dbt, or version control systems like Git.
Experience working in enterprise software, SaaS, or cybersecurity environments.


This is the base pay range for this position. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. Tenable also offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits which include: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) retirement savings with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; an employee referral program; flexible spending accounts; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); education assistance; parental leave; paid time off (PTO); company-paid holidays; health and wellness events; and community programs.

US Pay Range

$72,500—$96,500 USD
