Title: Data Analyst, Administration & Finance
Description:
Pay Range

The UMass President’s Office expects to pay within an approximate hiring range between $60,000 - $75,000 for this position. The specific pay for this position will be determined by the University based on consideration of all relevant factors when and if it decides to extend an offer of employment.

Primary Work Location:

Westborough, MA. Hybrid schedule.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President of Administration & Finance Support Services (Access) Team, the Data Analyst is responsible for developing analysis, reporting, and dashboard capabilities that support operational and strategic decision-making across Administration & Finance.

The Data Analyst will collaborate with data and analytics professionals across the Administration & Finance function, as well as product owners/stakeholders, and A&F leadership, to understand business requirements and translate them into effective analytics solutions. The position will monitor data quality and performance, validate data for accuracy and consistency, and identify opportunities to strengthen reporting processes and controls.

Working closely with IT and other technical partners, the Data Analyst will support the development of data models and the automation of data workflows and reporting processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and reliability. The position is also responsible for designing and developing intuitive, insightful dashboards, reports, and presentations that effectively communicate key performance indicators (KPIs), trends, and actionable insights to stakeholders and leadership.

Essential Functions


Design, develop, maintain, and enhance interactive dashboards and data visualizations that effectively communicate key metrics, trends, and insights.
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities, and translate findings into meaningful and actionable insights.
Acquire, integrate, and prepare data from multiple sources for analysis and reporting.
Perform data validation and quality assurance to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data; investigate discrepancies and collaborate with IT and other technical partners to resolve data issues.
Develop and maintain KPI calculations, business rules, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistent and accurate reporting.
Identify opportunities to streamline and automate data preparation, validation, and recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across Administration & Finance to understand business requirements and develop appropriate analytical solutions.
Conduct ad hoc analyses and prepare reports, presentations, and analytical summaries that clearly communicate findings to managers and leadership.
Maintain documentation of data sources, calculations, business rules, reporting processes, and identified data issues and resolutions.
Perform testing and validation of new data sources, data models, system enhancements, and reporting solutions to ensure accuracy and alignment with business requirements.
Perform other related duties and support special projects and initiatives as assigned.



Other Functions

Perform other duties as may be assigned.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education, Experience)


BS in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management or Statistics.
1-3 years' experience as a data analyst or business data analyst.
Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.
Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).
Advanced skills in creating interactive and visually compelling dashboards and reports that communicate data insights and findings clearly to business stakeholders.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Power Query), Python, or R.
Knowledge of data governance, compliance, and reporting best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Adept at queries, report writing, and presenting findings.



Preferred Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education, Experience)


Master’s degree in a related field



Working Conditions


Hybrid work environment. Primarily located at the UMass President’s Office located at 50 Washington St., Westborough, MA with remote work.
Must be able to travel occasionally to all UMass campuses and the Boston central office.



Additional Details

All offers are contingent on the successful completion of a background check.

Title: Data Analyst Senior
Description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

Join Mass General Brigham’s Population Health Services Organization Analytics team and help turn complex healthcare data into insights that improve outcomes, inform strategy, and support value-based care programs.

About The Team

PHSO Analytics is the data and analytics function within MGB Digital supporting Mass General Brigham’s Population Health Services Organization. The team delivers end-to-end analytics for value-based care programs, with a focus on improving clinical outcomes, managing cost and utilization, and optimizing performance in risk-based contracts.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will partner closely with clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders to deliver actionable insights across quality performance, risk adjustment and capture, care management, and payer contract performance. Using data from sources such as claims, EMR/Epic, and enterprise data platforms, you will develop dashboards, reports, and analytic models that inform strategic decision-making and drive measurable improvements in population health.

In this consultative role, you will provide data expertise, ad hoc analysis, KPI definition, and performance measurement support to help align programs and strengthen decision-making. Core deliverables include internal performance frameworks, cost and utilization analytics, quality reporting, and analytic support for value-based care Population Health clinical programs such as care management and post-acute initiatives.

Primary Responsibilities


Collect, clean, and transform large, complex data sets from multiple sources to support analysis and reporting.
Partner with senior leaders to understand business needs and plan data analytics and reporting solutions for assigned business units or functional areas.
Mentor and train other data analysts, sharing best practices and strengthening team capabilities.
Identify trends, correlations, and anomalies in data, and translate findings into clear explanations and recommendations.
Create clear, concise, and visually compelling data visualizations, dashboards, and reports.
Present complex data and analytical findings in a meaningful, accessible way for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Perform comprehensive quality assurance to ensure data, dashboards, and reports are accurate, reliable, and aligned with end-user specifications.


Qualifications

Qualifications


5+ years of experience in data analysis required.
Strong knowledge of relational databases, SQL, Snowflake, data visualization, and business intelligence tools such as Tableau required.
Ability to communicate complex workflows and data insights to diverse audiences required.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint required.
Familiarity with risk adjustment models such as CMS-HCC or DxCG is a plus.
Knowledge of value-based care models is a plus.
Project management experience or related skills are a plus.
Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques, including variance analysis and statistical significance testing is preferred.
Healthcare experience, particularly with electronic medical record data or claims data, is preferred.

Full-time, Monday through Friday, standard business hours.
Hybrid work model: On-site at Assembly Row in Somerville, MA four times per month. There is no set schedule for on-site days and it is flexible.
On remote workdays, employees must use a stable, secure, and compliant workstation in a quiet environment. Teams Video is required and must be accessed using MGB-provided equipment.

Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst to help us design and execute on clinical evidence studies with the mission of delivering personalized care to cancer patients.

What You’ll Do


Develop clinical data models using dbt and SQL based on business need and interoperability between existing data models, analysis requirements and data delivery requirements
Develop reports for central monitoring, KPI metrics, visualization of study performance and
Develop data automation pipelines for data delivery, data handling routines for post-processing of raw data for analysis-ready data sets

Experience with data manipulation, cleaning, and visualization
Excellent communication skills with demonstrated ability to communicate with diverse audiences

Title: Senior Healthcare Data Analyst, Analytics Hub
Description:
Overview

With over 50 years of proven success, ECG, ranked as a Best Midsized Firm to Work For 2026 by Consulting Magazine, is the most experienced healthcare consulting firm in the US. Working exclusively in this space, our people consistently demonstrate their ability to solve challenges for providers and achieve better patient outcomes. Across our seven office locations, we’re seeking individuals who will show the courage to find innovative solutions and make a direct impact on the delivery of healthcare services nationwide.

About ECG

ECG is a national consulting firm that is redefining healthcare together with its clients. We provide a broad range of strategic, financial, operational, and technology-enabled consulting services to the full continuum of care, including hospitals, health systems, medical groups, academic medical centers, children’s hospitals, cancer centers, ambulatory surgery centers, investors, and payers/health plans.

Our work focuses on creating practical, tailored solutions that help clients maximize resources and achieve sustainable results. We value collaboration, integrity, and innovation, and are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment.

Job Details

Join Our Analytics Hub

Our growing Analytics Hub works with our consulting teams to deliver new insights, streamlined analysis, and world-class intelligence to the healthcare organizations we serve as clients. Combined with our consulting teams, you will be helping physician and executive leadership make informed decisions that can alter the course of their enterprises in areas such as physician alignment, mergers and acquisitions, service line planning, provider compensation, financial performance, transforming care models, patient access, managed care portfolio optimization, digital health expansion, and more. ECG uses a Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment, with Microsoft Power BI as ECG’s current analytics visualization platform.

Our detailed plans incorporate qualitative findings with data-driven strategic, operational, and financial considerations that enable organizations to pursue realistic change. Our consultants bridge the gap between strategic thinking and operational implementation with sensible action plans and tactical recommendations. This approach allows us to stretch our clients’ thinking while ensuring that initiatives with the broadest and deepest impact are prioritized and implementable. Our wide-ranging engagements often focus on helping our clients:


Position themselves for value-based care delivery.
Align hospitals and physician organizations.
Strengthen financial performance.
Enhance clinical programs.
Develop strategic partnerships and/or mergers.


Your Opportunity with ECG: Senior Data Analyst

As a senior data analyst, you will support the firm’s client delivery and business development efforts, working with consultants and senior leaders to manage large datasets, aggregate internal and external data, develop scalable models and other analyses, and support data visualization and presentation sets. In addition, the analyst will work directly with our internal support teams (IT, business development, and L&D) and associated vendors for data management and IT solutions and will assist with a range of innovative analytic opportunities. Here, no two days or projects are alike, which means you’ll have a lot to learn and plenty of support to help you succeed.

Your Responsibilities May Include


Gather and synthesize data from various sources (e.g., national surveys, proprietary research, client interviews, industries, markets).
Prepare analyses related to hospital inpatient databases and provider claims data.
Build flexible, dynamic, and scalable financial and operational models to forecast trends, preparing scenarios for consulting efforts related to delivery and business development (e.g., strategic planning, operational improvement, market assessments).
Enhance existing models and capabilities built using SQL, primarily, with some use of Python or R in certain models or scenarios.
Perform complex analyses on big data, including cleaning, preparing, and interpreting.
Identify and execute analyses in response to consultant business intelligence inquiries.
Build relational databases using a Microsoft SQL Server or Fabric.
Communicate market insights to pursuit teams, and support business development efforts.
Configure, maintain, and build flexible reports, queries, and visuals within the Power BI environment and the production and development environments of related databases.
Research, test, and implement solutions in Power BI.
Partner with various consulting units (Strategy & Enterprise Growth, Payer Strategy & Contracting, Health System Performance, and Medical Group Optimization) to gather requirements related to data analytics.
Develop, configure, and maintain interfaces to exchange data among Power BI, SQL databases, and other cloud-based applications.
Create and maintain analytical support documentation and operating procedures.
Develop new and innovative methodologies and approaches.
Contribute to internal education and learning opportunities for consultants and operations members for the Analytics Hub and analytics in general, and support education about ECG’s use cases related to analytics.
Assist the vice president of data analytics and AI in developing analytics and data strategy to support data analytics capabilities at the firm.


Qualifications


Strong knowledge of and passion for the healthcare industry
A bachelor’s degree in either computer science, computer engineering, mathematics, statistics, health information management, or a related degree that relies heavily on critical thinking, logic, and math
5+ years of experience in healthcare data analytics, including analyzing clinical, operational, financial, or population health data
Experience in healthcare consulting, healthcare technology, or working for a hospital or health system, using data to deliver actionable insights and recommendations
Strong proficiency in data analysis, reporting, dashboard development, and translating complex data into actionable business insights
Experience working with healthcare datasets such as claims, EHRs, patient outcomes, quality metrics, or value-based care programs is highly preferred
Advanced skills in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI); experience with Python, R, Databricks, or Azure is a plus
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Excellent organizational skills


Job Locations


Preferred locations: Chicago or Washington, DC
Other location: Boston


Schedule

Full time/exempt

What You Can Expect Of Us

To reward our driven, innovative, and passionate employees, we’ve built a company culture that’s centered on performance. We offer an attractive compensation package, challenging work, and an entrepreneurial environment where you can take ownership of your career—and get out as much as you put in.

The estimated base salary range for this job is $100000.00 - $130000.00 annually. It represents a good faith estimate of the range that ECG reasonably expects to pay at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to years of experience, special skills, and market changes. This job is eligible to participate in ECG’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects ECG’s pay-for-performance philosophy. The job is also eligible to participate in ECG’s benefit plans, which include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) matching program, unlimited PTO, and other wellness programs.

Apply now and make an impact for years to come.

To begin the recruitment process, please submit your resume via our career site at https://careers.ecgmc.com.

ECG provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, age, disability, pregnancy, medical condition (cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We participate in E-Verify as part of our onboarding process. Having the permanent legal right to work in the United States is a condition of employment. ECG is not currently able to provide assistance to candidates requiring sponsorship or a visa.

Title: Data Analyst - SQL / Databricks
Description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role

As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence organization, you will turn operational and customer data into actionable reports and dashboards that drive business decisions. You will partner directly with internal business teams, such as sales compensation, to gather reporting requirements, document technical specifications, and build user friendly data assets.

Your primary hands-on work will involve writing SQL views and building dashboards directly within Databricks using data populated by our engineering team. A key aspect of this role is context engineering, where you will add structured descriptions and metadata to tables, views, and columns so that our data is easily discoverable and accurately queried by AI tools like Claude. Additionally, you will validate report accuracy, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation of your reporting logic to ensure long-term reliability.

Your Opportunity


You will have the opportunity to build and scale the business reporting layer within Databricks.
You will be part of a globally distributed team of data professionals.
This role is designed for someone who wants to grow their analytical skills in a collaborative, business facing environment.
Leverage modern AI coding agents, such as Databricks' Genie or Claude, to assist in writing and optimizing your queries.


What You'll Need


2 to 4 years of experience in a business intelligence, reporting, or data analyst role.
To be considered for this role, you must meet one of the following criteria: Hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Columbia, MD office three days a week, or hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Boston, MA office three days a week.
Fundamental working proficiency in SQL, including an understanding of select statements, order of operations, joins, aggregations, and filtering.
Basic to working proficiency with Databrick, a comparable lakehouse, or cloud data platform such as Snowflake.
Experience building dashboards and presenting data visually using tools like Databricks native dashboards, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical business stakeholders and translate them into usable data assets.
A detail oriented mindset with comfort in documenting data objects, definitions, and logic for downstream users.


And Ideally


Prior experience writing table and column descriptions or metadata to support data catalogs, semantic layers, or natural language query tools.
Exposure to Python or PySpark within Databricks notebooks, which will give you a significant advantage for career progression on this specific team.
Familiarity with analytics engineering practices, such as dbt, or version control systems like Git.
Experience working in enterprise software, SaaS, or cybersecurity environments.


This is the base pay range for this position. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. Tenable also offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits which include: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) retirement savings with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; an employee referral program; flexible spending accounts; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); education assistance; parental leave; paid time off (PTO); company-paid holidays; health and wellness events; and community programs.

Title: Senior Health Data Analyst - Compass
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As the Senior Health Data Analyst on the Compass Patient Team for Veeva Compass, you’ll focus on the health data in our Compass Patient data product.

Veeva Compass is our suite of data products, with Compass Patient including prescription and medical claims record-level data to support more broad de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases, like patient journey, market landscape, provider engagement, and more.

You’ll own health data investigations and improvements as part of our Product team. You’ll focus on three key areas:


Data Support - investigate internal and external questions and requests to understand data trends and behavior within customer-defined cohorts and across the network.
Data Quality - Define and track quality metrics in your target domain in dashboards, identify improvement opportunities, and work cross-functionally to document and share learnings.
Data Network Improvements - Collaboratively launch new features to continue to enhance our data in your target expertise area. You’ll focus on investigating, defining and testing productizable improvements that work at scale across billions of records.


This is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about data and excited about working alongside Product Managers, Customer Success Managers, Engineers, and QA to implement improvements to continue to enrich our data and drive product excellence.

What You’ll Do


Own the investigation and resolution of data observations and data questions driven by internal and external stakeholders
Understand our product pipeline and impact to data to identify improvements
Build standard templates and practices to streamline data quality in your target domains
Own key analytics projects in the data and feature roadmaps
Design new data analytics and data quality features & capabilities, including features such as match, merge, dedupe logic, value enrichment and reference mappings
Establish quality metrics and build dashboards to drive continuous improvement of our data products for key areas such as merging, payer data, lab, prescribers, etc.


Requirements


4+ years of experience analyzing prescription data and medical claims data
Advanced SQL skills; able to query and manipulate relational databases
Knowledge of Industry Standard billing codes such as ICD, CPT/HCPCS, NDC
Experience documenting and presenting analytics results with stakeholders
Experience defining KPIs and building dashboards to measure success


Nice to Have


Experience in Python
Experience with the BI tool Sigma
Experience in commercial life science use cases
Experience in enterprise products


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program


Compensation


Base pay: $80,000 - $125,000
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.


Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Title: Senior Analyst
Description:
The Senior Analyst is responsible for providing data-driven insight for key business stakeholders, across Coverys internal functional areas. This position will play a key role in the identification of trends that drive strategic and operational decision-making. This will necessitate an in-depth understanding of the business, its data, and corresponding technologies. The Senior Analyst will be responsible for setting, managing and meeting deadlines, ensuring the highest level of data accuracy in all work products.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities


Understand business problems, requirements or expectations and translate them into a data driven solutions.
Use various applications and systems to extract, transform, manipulate, explore, analyze and report data, using data integration/preparation, analytics, modeling, and visualization tools including (but not limited to) PowerBI, Alteryx, Excel, SAS/SQL, etc.
Work with business units to identify areas where reports, dashboards, and advanced analytic methodologies can provide sharper decision making and actionable insights. Work with cross-departmental teams to define metrics, guidelines, and strategies for effective use of algorithms and data.
Develop dashboards and reports for consumption by various levels of users across the organization.
Maintain an in-depth knowledge base in underwriting, claims, business development, and risk management business functions.
Establish links across existing data sources and finds new ways by which disparate data sets can be brought together.
Coordinate data requirements between analytics and IT teams.
Assist in the development of data management policies and procedures.
Assist in finding, evaluating and recommending new data sources and analytic tools. Identify tools that will help end users across Coverys interface more efficiently with large amounts of data.
Assist with developing and creating informative visualizations that intuitively display large amounts of data and/or complex relationships.
Work closely with the Coverys Data Governance body to ensure effective protection, integrity, and high quality of data assets. Analyze data quality issues, identify root causes of data defects, and continually seek ways by which high confidence in Coverys data can be sustained and strengthened.
Work with Data Scientist to assist in data prep and analysis for use in data models.
Simplify and explain advanced analytic work to business users.
Train staff on data definitions, coding structures, data sources and the use of Coverys tools.


Education, Requirements & Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree is required.
Insurance industry experience is required. Experience in healthcare preferred.
At least three years of relevant experience in analytics, informatics or statistics and/or an advanced degree is preferred.
Must possess knowledge of relational databases and reporting/analysis tools.
Proficient in the use of Power BI, Tableau, Excel, SQL or similar tools is required.
Experience with Advanced Analytic Tools a plus.
Ability to not only work well independently, but also to function seamlessly in a team-based, collaborative environment.
A meticulous attention to detail with a commitment to the highest standards of data accuracy, methodology integrity, and ongoing data quality.
Excellent teaming, communication and time management skills are essential.
A demonstrated capability of working on multiple projects simultaneously, with high functionality in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner
Highly self-motivated and directed.
Strong customer service orientation
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and maintain ongoing work authorization throughout employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship, including visa transfers, now or in the future.


Base salary range is $88,561 - $104,190. Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors that are unique to each candidate including location, skill set, experience, qualifications and education.

If you're a caring and customer focused individual who enjoys working with passionate team members, Coverys is the right company for you!

Title: Data Analyst III
Description:
Summary 

The Data Analyst III supports operations and conducts data analytics projects to provide information and insights for decision-making or solution development. Implements data standards and deploys automation tools to extract, synthesize, and validate data from different sources and transform data into usable metrics.

 

Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc. serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Business Services, Health, Infrastructure and Engineering, Mission Optimization, Technology and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical - Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.

As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act.

Essential Requirements

The ability to obtain, maintain, and access classified information at the DoD Secret level, which requires U.S. Citizenship.

Experience With AWS Cloud Computing Is Preferred.

Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience coding in Stata, R, or SAS at an advanced or expert level, including experience building reproducible workflows, automating analyses, and optimizing performance for large datasets. Familiarity with Stata is preferred.

A strong background in health economics, epidemiology, public health, applied statistics, or a related field is required.

Key Duties And Responsibilities

Essential Duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned. 

 

Designs and implements automated data pipelines and ETL processes to streamline data collection and integration from multiple sources.

Executes complex statistical analyses and machine learning algorithms to derive actionable insights and drive strategic initiatives.

Collaborates with IT and data engineering teams to enhance data infrastructure and ensure scalability and reliability of analytics solutions.

Title: Lead Data Analyst - Marketing and Customer Experience
Description:
Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp! 

This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast-paced, mission-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world. 

What we’re looking for: 

We're looking for a Lead Data Analyst to craft insightful and compelling data stories, empower business owners across Nexamp to make more effective data-driven decisions, and help build our self-service data platform. As one of the nation’s largest and longest tenured solar and storage owner operators – and one of the few that is fully vertically integrated – our data is a differentiator in the market and a catalyst for future growth. You’ll be solving uniquely challenging data problems, alongside a strong team, and for a company in which the business model and mission are inseparably intertwined: our solar farms save customers money, help the planet, and are profitable for Nexamp and its investors. 

You will be hybrid out of our Boston office. You will report to the Director, Product Management - Data.

What you’ll do:  

Independently gather requirements for, prioritize, deliver, maintain, and continuously improve reusable data models, dashboards, analyses, A/B tests, and other data assets. Act as the product manager and implementer for your domain-specific marketing and customer experience team's data offerings - including a customer acquisition and retention forecast. Implement work using advanced SQL and BI tool skills.
Become the subject matter expert for data in your business areas. Identify opportunities for impact, proactively surface insights, support decision-making, and contribute to and influence business strategy and initiatives. Serve as your business stakeholders’ right hand. Support other business areas opportunistically.
Create and maintain comprehensive data documentation and communicate updates to your stakeholders. Write user stories or tickets for data engineering, validate data mapping, conduct QA, and implement data quality monitoring.
Monitor the usage of data assets, increase data literacy, and promote self-service through BI tools among stakeholders. Provide training, guidance, and support as needed.
Work within a centralized data team using agile methodologies. Collaborate with peer analysts through overlapping work, priority shifting, and code reviews to broaden your Nexamp knowledge.
Partner with the data architect, engineers, scientists, and analysts to shape the vision and roadmap for Nexamp’s data platform. Define and track annual OKRs to measure your impact. 

What you’ll bring:

7+ years of experience as a data analyst serving business owners and collaborating with data engineers (experience in the energy/construction industry is a plus, but not required)
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field would be preferred; advanced degree is a plus.
Advanced in SQL and BI tool administration and usage (experience with Databricks and Sigma are a plus, but not required)
Strong track record of independently solving problems.
Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today.
Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization.   
Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality. 
Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions. 
Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry. 
Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.

At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. By encouraging a culture where ideas and decisions come from all people, we believe it will help us grow, innovate, and be a part of environmental and social change.

You’ll love working here because:  

Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. We have headquarters in Boston, MA and Chicago, IL, in addition to growing offices nationwide. We provide healthy snacks, coffee, service days and other volunteer opportunities, company outings, and more!  

Compensation

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Nexamp ranges from $110,000 - $130,000. In addition to base salary, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual bonus programs based on individual and company performance, non-annual sales incentive plans, or other non-annual incentive plans). Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in the Company’s stock option plan. Actual base salary may vary based upon, but is not limited to, skills and qualifications, internal equity, performance, and geographic location. 

Nexamp's People team manages all aspects of recruitment and hiring within our organization. We want to inform third-party recruiters, staffing firms, and related agencies that Nexamp does not accept unsolicited resumes. Resumes will only be considered from these entities if a signed agreement is in place and the People team explicitly authorizes external recruiting assistance for a specific position. Any unsolicited resumes received will be deemed the property of Nexamp. We want to emphasize that Nexamp is not liable for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.

Title: Senior Pharmacy Data Analyst
Description:
It’s an exciting time to join the WellSense Health Plan, a growing regional health insurance company with a 25-year history of providing health insurance that works for our members, no matter their circumstances.

Job Summary

The Senior Pharmacy Data Analyst is a highly experienced and results-driven professional who plays a critical role in advancing the strategic objectives of the Pharmacy Department. Reporting to the Manager of Pharmacy Contracting and Reporting, this role operates with a high degree of autonomy and precision, leveraging deep expertise in pharmacy data analytics to deliver timely, actionable insights that drive operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and member health outcomes.

This individual is a master of data strategy—skilled in SAS, SQL, and advanced Microsoft tools—with a proven ability to architect complex data models, streamline reporting processes, and lead cross-functional initiatives. The Senior Analyst is responsible for developing and maintaining enterprise-level dashboards, overseeing regulatory submissions, and serving as the Pharmacy Data Steward, ensuring data integrity across systems and stakeholders.

With a minimum of 10 years of industry experience, the ideal candidate demonstrates exceptional analytical acumen, strategic foresight, and a commitment to producing high-quality deliverables efficiently and independently. This role demands a proactive leader who can translate complex data into compelling narratives, influence decision-making, and support cost-effective, data-driven pharmacy benefit management.

Our Investment In You


Full-time remote work
Competitive salaries
Excellent benefits


Key Functions/Responsibilities


Develop and maintain a centralized dashboard for tracking pharmacy financial, operational, and clinical performance measures.
Lead the process of regulatory reporting from development, validation, and submission collaborating with vendor partners to ensure data accuracy.
Conduct data queries to monitor performance metrics, including Medicare STAR measures and quality improvement initiatives.
Oversee PBM submission of all Part D claims to CMS as PDEs, identifying discrepancies and resolving errors to ensure 100% alignment.
Assume the leadership role of Pharmacy Data Steward, advising cross-functional departments on data exchange specifications and serving as the subject matter expert for pharmacy data integrity.
Support program processes by conducting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) testing.
Collaborate with Pharmacy Department team members to identify, prioritize, and analyze customer needs and requests to include the development and execution of sophisticated data-driven strategies that are closely aligned with the company's overarching mission and strategic objectives
Communicate effectively with internal cross-functional areas regarding pharmacy programs, formulary management, and pharmacy processes.
Document workflows, perform analysis, and contribute to the design of systems to meet Pharmacy data needs.
Deliver compelling presentations of findings and insights to internal stakeholders, effectively communicating complex concepts in a clear, concise, and persuasive manner using Utilize leading BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Architect and implement intricate data models, data flows, and data integration processes to ensure the accuracy, reliability, and efficiency of data collection, storage, and retrieval mechanisms.
Engage collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, data scientists, and developers, to identify optimization opportunities and develop innovative, data-driven solutions.
Utilize leading BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI to create dynamic, visually compelling reports and distribute actionable insights effectively.
Harness advanced tools such as Excel (including VBA), Python, or R to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data with precision and sophistication.
Other duties as assigned


Supervision Received




General direction and supervision by Manager of Pharmacy Contracting and Reporting


Qualifications

Education Required:


Bachelor's degree in mathematics, information management, information systems, statistics, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.


Education Preferred


Master's degree preferred.


Experience Required


Minimum of 5 years of healthcare experience.
Working knowledge of industry coding standards (e.g., generic product indicators, national drug codes, GPI’s, etc.).


Experience Preferred/Desirable


Minimum of 10 years in health insurance or with a PBM
Working knowledge of industry coding standards (e.g., generic product indicators, national drug codes, GPI’s, etc.).
Extensive experience analyzing pharmacy claims data, formulary utilization, and drug cost trends.
Familiarity with Medicare Part D data, STAR measures, and PDE submissions
Required Licensure, Certification or Conditions of Employment:
Successful completion of pre-employment background check


Competencies, Skills, And Attributes


Excellent written and verbal communication skills, adept at presenting complex data insights to senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners.
Advanced technical proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas, Power Query), with strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis. Skilled in additional BI and reporting tools (Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent).
Deep understanding of IT and business processes, with proven ability to translate clinical and operational requirements into actionable technical solutions.
Demonstrated ability to influence, consult, and build consensus across multiple stakeholders, driving collaboration between business, IT, and vendor teams.
Strong clinical and operational problem-solving skills with experience in synthesizing large, complex datasets into actionable insights and executive-ready reports.
Proficient in designing, developing, and automating queries, dashboards, and ad hoc reports that support strategic decision-making.
Committed to data integrity, accuracy, and quality, with meticulous attention to detail and validation processes.
Quick to adopt new systems, tools, and analytic approaches, consistently staying ahead of industry trends and best practices.
Ability to organize, synthesize, and analyze large volumes of information.
Skilled at prioritizing multiple initiatives, managing timelines, and delivering high-quality outputs in fast-paced environments.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to producing analytic products of the highest accuracy.
Strong interpersonal skills with a track record of thriving in collaborative, team-based environments.


Working Conditions And Physical Effort


Ability to work OT during peak periods. (Non-Exempt Positions)
Regular and reliable attendance is an essential function of the position.
Work is normally performed in a typical interior/office work environment.
No or very limited physical effort required. No or very limited exposure to physical risk.


Compensation Range

$77,000 - $111,500

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, skills, and certifications/licensure as they directly relate to position requirements; as well as business/organizational needs, internal equity, and market-competitiveness. In addition, WellSense offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), merit increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family wellbeing.

Note: This range is based on Boston-area data, and is subject to modification based on geographic location.

WellSense Health Plan is a nonprofit health insurance company serving more than 740,000 members across Massachusetts and New Hampshire through Medicare, Individual and Family, and Medicaid plans. Founded in 1997, WellSense provides high-quality health plans and services that work for our members, no matter their circumstances. WellSense is committed to the diversity and inclusion of staff and their members.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Title: Senior Data Analyst (Gas Engineering)
Description:
About Us

Every day we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. We are there when people need us the most. We connect people to the energy they need for the lives they live. The pace of change in society and our industry is accelerating and our expertise and track record puts us in an unparalleled position to shape the sustainable future of our industry. To be successful we must anticipate the needs of our customers, reducing the cost of energy delivery today and pioneering the flexible energy systems of tomorrow. This requires us to deliver on our promises and always look for new opportunities to grow, both ourselves and our business.

At National Grid, we aim to create an environment where everyone is welcomed for who they are and where our differences are celebrated. We utilize the insights of our employees that come from all different cultures, backgrounds, and beliefs to better serve our customers and communities.

National Grid is hiring a Senior Data Analyst (Gas Engineering). This hybrid role is located in our Waltham MA location.

Job Purpose

Responsible for advancing data management maturity, analytics capabilities, GIS utilization, and technology enablement across Gas Asset Management & Engineering (GAME). The role leads and supports efforts to improve asset data quality, governance, system connectivity, risk model utilization, automation, and reporting while advancing the strategic use of Snowflake, GIS, Enterprise Maximo, and related platforms.

The primary focus is to connect people, processes, data, and technology to create trusted, analytics-ready information that supports risk-informed asset management, regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and measurable business value.

Key Accountabilities


Drive improved utilization of connected data across Snowflake, GIS, Enterprise Maximo, risk model platforms, reporting environments, and other relevant systems.
Define business and analytical requirements for data integration, interoperability, pipelines, interfaces, and reusable data models.
Identify data silos, reconciliation points, and manual handoffs; partner with IT and data engineering teams to implement sustainable improvements.
Promote end-to-end traceability from source data through analytical outputs and business decisions.
Expand the use of GIS from mapping and visualization to spatial analysis, workflow enablement, asset intelligence, and decision support.
Develop geospatial analytics supporting asset management, risk models, leak management, integrity activities, regulatory needs, and capital planning.
Improve GIS data quality, attribution, connectivity, topology, location accuracy, and usability in partnership with data owners and GIS teams.
Design reusable GIS-enabled tools, maps, dashboards, analyses, and automation that improve engineering and operational workflows.
Identify processes where coding, automation, integration, low-code tools, or emerging technology can remove non-value-added work and improve control effectiveness.
Design, code, test, document, deploy, and maintain reusable scripts, applications, workflows, and analytical tools using approved technologies.
Automate data extraction, transformation, validation, quality checks, GIS analysis, reporting, and repeatable business processes.
Develop proofs of concept and pilots; define value, controls, support needs, and transition paths for scalable solutions.
Apply sound development practices including modular design, version control, testing, documentation, monitoring, and knowledge transfer.
Develop advanced analysis, dashboards, KPIs, and executive scorecards that support asset, risk, investment, compliance, and operational decisions.
Perform data profiling, root-cause analysis, trend analysis, and scenario analysis to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
Create repeatable analytical processes and self-service capabilities that improve consistency, speed, and transparency.
Translate complex data into clear findings, recommendations, and decision-ready stories.
Engage stakeholders to define business outcomes, requirements, priorities, success measures, and sustainment needs.
Communicate analytical findings, data risks, solution options, and technology opportunities to technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop business cases, roadmaps, recommendations, and implementation plans for leadership consideration.
Act as a trusted advisor connecting the business, data, GIS, and technology communities.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, GIS, or a related field
Minimum of 3+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, data strategy, engineering analytics, GIS, automation, or a related discipline
Demonstrated experience delivering analytics, reporting, coded solutions, automation, or technology-enabled business improvements
Experience working with enterprise data platforms, complex datasets, and cross-functional stakeholders
Experience leading workstreams, projects, requirements development, or continuous improvement initiatives


Knowledge, Experience & Technical Know How


SQL; Power BI; Snowflake; advanced Excel; data modeling; data governance; data quality management
Python; scripting; APIs and web services; Git/version control; Power Apps; Power Automate
ArcGIS Pro; ArcGIS Enterprise; ArcPy; spatial analytics; Enterprise Maximo; utility asset data
ETL/ELT concepts; data pipelines; system interoperability; Azure data services
AI and generative AI applications; machine learning fundamentals; intelligent document extraction; risk analytics platforms such as Synergi or equivalent


Salary

$111,000 - $130,000 a year

National Grid will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. You must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

National Grid utilizes an assessment that evaluates the job qualifications/characteristics using AI or statistically based scoring. For more information, please view NYC Local Law 144.

This position has a career path which provides for advancement opportunities within and across bands as you develop and evolve in the position; gaining experience, expertise and acquiring and applying technical skills. Candidates will be assessed and provided offers against the minimum qualifications of this role and their individual experience.

National Grid maintains affirmative action programs for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

National Grid complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!



Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.



What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!



Who we are:

Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments in higher education. We’ve since scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.



Today we support more than 5,100 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.



With over 1,200 global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 12 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.







Job Description



The Opportunity



We, at Flywire, are looking for a smart, analytical thinker who's excited to wow our clients with best in class data and analytics capabilities. As a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst, you will help set the vision and direction for how we communicate the story of Flywire's data to our clients, both with interactive in-app reporting solutions and custom analytics projects that speak to the unique value and ROI that our product has delivered throughout our partnership.



This is a true cross-functional role, with responsibilities crossing data & analytics, product development, relationship management, and sales. The ideal candidate will feel comfortable managing cross-functional projects and also have a deep technical understanding of a general BI stack and will be able to periodically contribute to development and analysis.



The responsibilities of the role include:



Help set a broad company vision for the way we communicate data and our value proposition to clients
Partner with business stakeholders to understand unique client situations and deliver analyses to show the value of Flywire's value and performance
Lead the design and development of customer-facing dashboards
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure that reporting and analytical solutions are secure, scalable, and part of a seamless user experience


Qualifications



Here's What We're Looking For



5-7 years of experience in business intelligence, product management, data and analytics, or a related field
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams
Strong experience with business intelligence tools is required, with a preference for Looker and Sigma
Comfortable presenting to both internal and external stakeholders
Strong communication skills: You can make even the most complex data easy to comprehend
Emerging data science and analytical skills
Familiar and comfortable with emerging AI technologies, digital assistants for natural language queries, and core LLM tools
Strong business acumen by connecting data and dashboard design decisions to revenue, client retention, and broader company strategy, not just technical execution
Experience working with finance-related data (revenue, billing, payments, or similar financial reporting) and translating it into stakeholder-ready insights
Experience working with client or CRM data (e.g. Salesforce) to build a unified view of client relationships and usage patterns


Additional Information



Submit today and get started!



We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager and other Flymates. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for questions.



Flywire is an equal opportunity employer and follows a policy of administering all employment decisions and personnel actions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity, national origin, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, genetic disposition or carrier status, veteran status, or any other category protected under applicable national, federal, state or local law.



The US base salary range for this full-time position is $91,000 - $114,000, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, position level, and location. The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and several other factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education and training.

Title: Senior GTM Data Analyst
Description:
About the company: LinkSquares is a Boston-based, AI-powered CLM SaaS leader trusted by organizations like DraftKings, Manscaped, and Vivid Seats. We automate the contracting process for legal, finance, and HR teams, helping them save time, cut costs, and improve business outcomes. For more information, visit linksquares.com.

About the team: Join our Revenue Operations organization, the central engine of our Revenue Team that sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, sales execution, and AI innovation. We are a detail-oriented and financially driven team dedicated to driving long-term value and growth by transforming internal processes into strategic advantages. We prioritize a "learn and get better" mentality, where you will not only execute proven processes but actively help refine them for the next generation of LinkSquares' growth.

About the role: As the Senior GTM Data Analyst, you will shape how we understand and optimize our growth engine by owning the analytical truth layer across the entire revenue organization. In this high-impact role, you will function as an internal revenue economist and independent partner to the GTM executives, answering three critical questions: What is happening? Why is it happening? What should we do about it?

You’ll join a collaborative team where you have the autonomy to evolve an existing foundation while building new, scalable data models, KPI architectures, and executive reporting systems that directly influence strategic decisions. Sitting at the intersection of revenue analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, and strategic decision support, this is an ideal role for a strategic thinker who enjoys the balance of technical depth, commercial judgment, and hands-on execution.

Responsibilities:

Serve as an independent analytical partner to GTM leadership, analyzing performance across the full customer lifecycle (pipeline creation, conversion, bookings, retention, expansion, and churn) to surface emerging trends, quantify business impact, and recommend strategic actions.
KPI Architecture & Dashboards: Own the Revenue organization's KPI architecture, metric definitions, and calculation logic across Sales, CX, Marketing, Product, and Finance. Rationalize reporting, reduce dashboard sprawl, and create trusted, scalable reporting.
Planning & Scenario Analytics: Develop models that support revenue planning, pipeline coverage, conversion, velocity, push/slip, and productivity analysis. Model upside/downside scenarios and leading indicators of risk to improve organizational predictability.
Executive & Board Support: Own the analytical development of recurring executive and Board reporting, ensuring outputs are grounded in reconciled metrics, consistent business logic, and clear, decision-ready frameworks.
Data Modeling & Architecture: Own, build, and optimize durable transformation and semantic models across the modern data stack for core GTM concepts (accounts, pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention, expansion, churn, and customer lifecycle) while ensuring data quality and lineage.
Analytics Innovation & AI: Leverage AI tools and automation to accelerate analytical workflows, investigation, documentation, quality assurance, and insight generation while establishing responsible AI governance and patterns.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Product, and Finance to challenge assumptions, guide roadmap prioritization, and act as a trusted advisor on major GTM decisions.

Requirements:

B2B SaaS Experience: 6+ years supporting a B2B SaaS or recurring-revenue business, with deep fluency in SaaS/GTM economics, unit economics, and full customer lifecycle analysis across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Experience.
Technical & Modeling Depth: Advanced proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Looker (or comparable BI tool), Git, semantic-layer design, ETL/ELT concepts, and data quality monitoring, alongside strong familiarity with Salesforce and GTM data structures.

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst, Dealer
Description:
Who We Are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What We Do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to join our Dealer team which tackles a complex data environment, building out core assets, running experiments, and many more unstructured analytics tasks to support the growth of the dealer product suite.

Our Product Data Analytics org as a whole supports our Product and Engineering teams, providing the final word on all analytics for CarGurus’ user and dealer experiences. We are looking for thoughtful, curious, internally driven candidates who can dive into complex data and draw novel, insightful conclusions.

What You’ll Do


Conduct exploratory empirical analyses using SQL and Python that bridge disparate data sources (e.g. website usage, subscription records, inventory volumes, etc.). to quantify product performance, user behavior, and/or market trends. Distill unstructured “big data” around product performance, user behavior and/or market insights into actionable outcomes.
Creatively compress sweeping, high-level exploratory requests into specific calculations that address your stakeholders’ underlying needs. Relentlessly dig into the data, taking initiative to consult with other individuals and teams as you judge necessary. Go beyond the letter of the initial assignment, to hammer out any anomalies or self-direct your inquiry into other relevant issues.
Advocate and participate in brainstorming/planning sessions for specific, data-driven product innovations that help further high-level company strategy, primarily in partnership with the Product/Engineering teams.
Avoid passivity in the face of flawed proposals; tactfully and persuasively push back against potential missteps.
Craft, audit and improve metrics that define business success, condensing abstract or loosely-defined concepts down to concrete calculations.
Experiment with new kinds of visualizations, build intuitive dashboards and other visual monitoring tools to guide daily decision-making by senior stakeholders and the company at large. Re-work underlying code to appropriately structure visualization inputs.
Communicate and present complex quantitative findings in easily digestible terms to company leadership, homing in on key takeaways. Concretely and informatively respond to any probing, on-the-spot follow-up questions from senior decision-makers.
Conceive of new data assets and build automated transformations (via DBT, LookML, etc.) to bring them to fruition.
Partner with Data Engineering teams to advance core data modeling/architecture (e.g. user clickstream logging), by optimizing, integrating, and distilling large raw datasets and metadata.
Draw upon prior experience with expansive, unrefined datasets to fix modeling bottlenecks in quick, scalable, outside-of-the-box ways.
Use Claude Code and agentic workflows to automate, accelerate, and escalate the sophistication of your analyses.
Be comfortable escalating and automating your analyses using R/Python scripting.


What You’ll Bring


4+ years of experience in analytics, ideally involving complex modeling, quantitative analysis and applied statistics 2+ years of experience communicating the high-impact results of analyses to leadership teams to influence strategy
Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI to optimize workflows and agentic coding platforms like Claude Code (preferred) or Cursor
Expert fluency in SQL. A strong background with either R or Python is highly desirable.
Second-nature understanding of core statistical concepts (regression, significance testing, omitted variable bias, independence/dependence, etc.)
Willingness to step outside your role and independently come up with novel ideas for the business.
Willingness to challenge others’ ideas and advocate for your own.
Strong project planning skills, with experience building roadmaps, estimating required resources, and flagging inter-dependencies with other teams/projects.
Preferred tools/programs: Snowflake, Snowplow, dbt, Claude Code or Cursor, Looker/Omni, Jira, Salesforce, Google/MS suite

Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Position Pay Range

$120,000—$151,000 USD

Working at CarGurus

We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives.

CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate.

We welcome all

CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus.

Title: Senior Analyst, Property Claims Analytics
Description:
Description

The Loss Insights Analytics team sits within US Retail Markets Property Claims organization and is at the center of some of the most consequential decisions in our claims organization. We quantify the financial impact of changes across the full lifecycle of a claim — from first notice of loss through final resolution — including the adoption of new tools, vendors, and process innovations. We are a team of rigorous, intellectually driven analysts who believe that the right question, asked at the right time, is just as powerful as the right answer. If you are energized by complex problems, motivated by meaningful work, and want your analysis to directly shape how one of the world's largest insurers handles billions of dollars in property claims, this is your team.


This role may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location**


Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote.

About The Role

We are hiring a Senior Analyst to join the Loss Insights team. In this role, you will design and execute high-complexity analyses that drive tangible improvements to claims handling processes and financial outcomes. You will serve as a trusted analytical voice to senior stakeholders, translating nuanced data findings into clear, compelling recommendations. This is not just a reporting role — it is a thinking role. You will be expected to challenge assumptions, identify the stories hidden in data, and advocate for evidence-based decisions.

What You Will Do


Drive Financial Insight: Design and conduct moderate-to-high complexity analyses evaluating the financial performance of claims operations, process changes, and newly adopted tools or vendor partnerships across the full claim lifecycle.
Measure What Matters: Build and maintain reporting frameworks that track initiative success, financial performance, and key operational metrics — ensuring stakeholders always have a clear, accurate picture of business outcomes.
Lead Analytical Projects: Own moderately complex, end-to-end analytical projects independently, partnering with Claims Process, Data Office, Product, and other key partners to develop rigorous solutions and see initiatives through to measurable impact.
Turn Data into Action: Synthesize complex, multi-source data into concise, actionable recommendations and present findings confidently to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
Shape the Future of Claims: Contribute to a team culture of intellectual curiosity and continuous improvement, proactively identifying new analytical opportunities that enhance customer outcomes and operational efficiency.


What We're Looking For


You are intellectually curious. You don't just answer the question asked — you interrogate it. You are energized by ambiguity, drawn to complex problems, and always looking for the insight beneath the surface.
You are analytically rigorous. You have hands-on experience gathering, interpreting, and synthesizing data across multiple sources. You are proficient in one or more of the following: SAS, SQL, Python, or R — and you know how to use these tools not just to pull data, but to build compelling analytical narratives.
You think critically and communicate clearly. You can translate a sophisticated analysis into a story that resonates with a non-technical audience. You are comfortable presenting to stakeholders and defending your methodology under scrutiny.
You are a proactive, organized self-starter. You manage your own workload with discipline, follow through without being prompted, and thrive in an environment where you are trusted to work independently.
You are a collaborative team player. You bring energy and engagement to the team, invest in the success of your colleagues, and build strong relationships across partner teams.


Qualifications


Bachelor's Degree plus a minimum 3 years, typically 4 or more years of experience, or equivalent, is required. Mathematics, Economics, Statistics or other quantitative field are preferred fields of study.
Advanced knowledge of data sources, tools, statistical principles and methodologies, and techniques.
Advanced proficiency in Excel (VBA, macros, scripts, formulas, data visualization, etc.), PowerPoint, and statistical software packages (SAS, Snowflake).
Must have good planning, analytical, decision-making and communication skills.
Solid understanding of business to improve business outcomes.


About Us

The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role.
