Title: Claims Analyst
Description:
The Claims Analyst will be responsible for supporting the effective management of claims portfolios through data analysis, forecasting, and reporting, providing insights into claim trends and financial performance to inform decision-making in line with Group Claims processes.




Responsibilities

Analyze claims data across managed portfolios to identify trends, patterns, and key drivers of loss performance
Support claims forecasting activities, including projections of loss development, reserves, and financial outcomes
Prepare and maintain regular management reporting on claims performance, key metrics, and emerging trends
Partner with Claims, Finance, Actuary, IT, and Operations teams to validate data accuracy and ensure consistency across reporting outputs
Monitor and analyze variances between actuals and forecasts, providing insights and recommendations to support decision-making
Develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data models to improve visibility into claims performance
Support the identification and remediation of unreconciled data, reporting, and systems-related gaps impacting claims analytics and forecasting capabilities
Contribute to initiatives aimed at improving consistency and standardization across claims processes, including controls, KPIs, and governance practices
Provide analytical support for portfolio reviews, including evaluation of resource needs, alignment with forecasted claims outcomes, and overview of portfolio performance
Assist in tracking and prioritizing operational and reporting improvements to enhance readiness, scalability, and overall claims performance
Ensure data integrity and compliance with internal controls, reporting standards, and Group Claims policies
Work with external stakeholders to fulfill any claims related requests, including loss runs, data calls and other time-sensitive matters
Support ad hoc analysis requests related to claims performance, portfolio trends, and emerging risks




Requirements

2–6+ years of relevant experience in insurance, claims analytics, or financial/data analysis
Experience working with large data sets, including reporting, trend analysis, and performance monitoring
Strong analytical capability and problem-solving skills, including experience with data modeling, forecasting, and variance analysis
Advanced Excel Skills (e.g., Pivot Tables and Lookup Formulas) proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL ,SAP, or similar analytics platforms) and PowerPoint skills strongly desired
Solid understanding of insurance and/or reinsurance business models, with exposure to claims operations preferred

Title: Analyst, Commercial Insights
Description:
Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

Key Responsibilities

The Analyst, Commercial Insights & Analytics enables data-driven decision-making across the organization by delivering actionable insights, performance reporting, and advanced analytics that support Commercial strategy and execution. This individual serves as a trusted analytics partner to Sales, Marketing, Market Access, Commercial Excellence, and other cross-functional stakeholders, translating business questions into clear analytical approaches and decision-oriented recommendations. The role combines strong analytical skills, business acumen, and technical capabilities to develop reporting solutions, identify performance drivers, uncover opportunities and risks, and advance field force effectiveness. The ideal candidate is curious, highly detail-oriented, and comfortable using large and complex datasets to communicate concise, actionable insights to Commercial leaders.

Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in Commercial Analytics, Business Analytics, Sales Operations, Business Intelligence, Insights, or a related analytical role.
Experience supporting Sales, Marketing, Commercial Excellence, Market Access, or related Commercial functions.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into actionable business recommendations.
Advanced proficiency with SQL and data querying tools.
Experience building dashboards and visualizations using Power BI or a similar reporting platform.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience integrating and analyzing large, complex datasets from multiple sources.
Ability to communicate analytical findings effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong attention to detail, organization, analytical rigor, and commitment to reporting quality.
Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, healthcare, or another regulated industry preferred.
Experience with AI-enabled analytics, predictive analytics, advanced analytical techniques, or reporting automation preferred.


Physical Requirements And Work Environment

This role requires the ability to perform standard office activities, including extended periods of computer use, participation in virtual and in-person meetings, and collaboration across teams. Depending on business needs, occasional travel may be required. Work environments and physical requirements may vary based on the requirements of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties and responsibilities may be modified, added, or removed as necessary to meet business and organizational needs.

Compensation

The target base salary range for this role is $90,000-$100,000 per year. This range reflects the anticipated compensation for the role. Where pay falls withing the range may vary based on many factors, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, skills, experience, education, certifications, location and applicable geographic pay zones, market conditions, internal equity and business considerations. Compensation decisions are made based on an assessment of the candidate’s qualifications and the totality of relevant factors.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in an annual short-term incentive program, subject to plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Benefits

Galderma offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid time off, and other benefits, subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms.

Work Authorization

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the United States.

What We Offer

At Galderma, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization committed to advancing dermatology and improving patient outcomes worldwide. We offer competitive compensation, annual incentive opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, along with meaningful opportunities for growth, development, and collaboration in an inclusive and innovative environment.

Next Steps


If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first virtual conversation with the recruiter.
The next step is a virtual conversation with the hiring manager
The final step is a panel conversation with the extended team


Don't meet every single requirement? At Galderma, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply anyway!

Title: Senior Analyst - Boston, MA
Description:
Job Description A leading organization within the insurance and healthcare risk management industry is seeking a Senior Analyst to deliver data-driven insights that support strategic business initiatives and operational performance across multiple departments.

This role will work closely with stakeholders to identify trends, develop reporting solutions, and provide actionable recommendations that drive informed decision-making. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical capabilities with the ability to communicate complex findings to both technical and business audiences.

This is a hybrid position requiring three days onsite per week in the Boston area. Required Skills & Experience


Bachelor's degree required
Insurance industry experience required
Minimum of 3 years of experience in analytics, informatics, statistics, or a related field
Strong knowledge of relational databases and reporting platforms
Proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, SQL, or comparable analytics tools
Experience extracting, transforming, analyzing, and reporting large datasets
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy
Excellent communication, collaboration, and time management skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities
Ability to translate complex quantitative analysis into actionable business recommendations
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams


Desired Skills & Experience


Healthcare industry experience
Advanced degree in Analytics, Statistics, Informatics, or a related discipline
Experience with advanced analytics or statistical modeling tools
Familiarity with Alteryx, SAS, or similar data preparation platforms
Experience supporting data governance initiatives
Exposure to predictive analytics or data science projects

Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and develop data-driven solutions
Extract, transform, analyze, and visualize data from multiple systems and sources
Design and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance metrics for business users
Identify trends and opportunities that improve strategic and operational decision-making
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to establish reporting standards, KPIs, and analytics strategies
Integrate and connect disparate data sources to improve business intelligence capabilities
Coordinate data and reporting requirements between business and technology teams
Support data governance, quality, and integrity initiatives
Evaluate and recommend new data sources, reporting technologies, and analytical tools
Investigate data quality issues and identify root causes and remediation strategies
Prepare data and perform analysis in support of advanced analytics and modeling efforts
Present analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Train end users on reporting tools, data definitions, and available data resources

Competitive compensation package
Hybrid work environment
Opportunity to influence business strategy through analytics and reporting
Collaborative, data-driven culture with strong cross-functional engagement


You will receive the following benefits


Medical Insurance
Dental Benefits
Vision Benefits
Paid Time Off (PTO)
401(k)

Help develop and maintain a public-facing government data dashboard


Analyze, collect, and organize data to support greenhouse gas, energy, and water reduction projects, benchmarking, and reporting


Research and develop briefing materials on sustainability topics, including decarbonization and building and fleet electrification


Provide additional data analysis and technical communications support on environmental, sustainability, and public health topics







Qualifications and Skills:


Bachelor’s degree in environmental science or a related field


Minimum of one year of experience working with environmental or sustainability-related data


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other data management tools preferred


Experience with data visualization software, such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik Sense


Familiarity with energy efficiency improvements, water conservation measures, and greenhouse gas emissions inventories


Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, including experience drafting technical reports and presenting findings


Experience working with and managing large, complex datasets


Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary team


Strong interpersonal skills with a customer service focus


Ability to take initiative, stay organized, and manage multiple tasks

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Gupta Media was founded over 25 years ago on the idea that advertising could create huge leverage in our clients' businesses. Our work initially focused on the entertainment industry, specifically live events and recorded music (SXSW, Sony Music, Universal Music, and Disney Music Group are all clients). We have grown to include global brands (Amazon, Sophia Learning), major sports franchises (X Games, Florida Panthers, Washington Commanders, Cleveland Cavaliers, Women’s Tennis Association), as well as public sector institutions (City of Boston, Massachusetts Office of Travel and Tourism).




We are on the hunt for a talented Data Analyst I to join our Strategy & Analytics team to assist with reporting, tracking, data analysis, advertising strategy, and visualization needs. In this role, you will work internally to assist paid media analysts with reporting requests and externally to provide clients with insights into their advertising campaigns.




The ideal candidate is inherently resourceful. We need someone who enjoys the "instruction manual" level of detail and views a technical hurdle as a problem to be solved rather than a roadblock. When you encounter a gap in your knowledge, you have the drive to research, test, and figure out the answer. We want someone who doesn't just want to run reports, but wants to build a better, faster version of them.




Who You Are:

You have no problem tearing apart complex problems and living inside spreadsheets, data sets, or documentation to find the answer to any question
You bring a strong technical toolkit, including SQL, Excel, Google Data Studio/Data Visualization, and enjoy working with SQL on a day-to-day basis
You are technically curious and resourceful. You have a natural ability to navigate and understand technical documentation—whether it’s for an API, a piece of software, or a new platform—and use it to troubleshoot or build new solutions. Experience with Marketing APIs, BigQuery, Snowflake, ETL tools (Rivery, Supermetrics), or Python is a significant plus
You communicate with clarity. You can take the deep-dive technical work you do under the hood and explain the logic, the solution, and the results to a non-technical audience without losing the meaning
You have a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 1 year of experience working with complex datasets, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Experience with marketing data or paid advertising is a plus




What You’ll Do:

Analytics & Visualization: You will design and maintain customized dashboards that transform thousands of lines of data into clear, visual stories. You’ll be responsible for translating complex performance media metrics into digestible, client-ready reports via Google Sheets, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Media Strategy: You will learn our clients’ businesses inside and out to align their media strategy with overarching business goals. You’ll identify advertising trends across projects to help guide media buying decisions and optimize spend.
Data Integrity: You will collaborate across teams to ensure our tracking and measurement frameworks are scalable, accurate, and best-in-class, acting as a bridge between raw data and strategy.
Strategic Consulting: You will use your understanding of concepts like LTV, ROAS, and Incremental Revenue to lead discussions with clients, gaining trust and shareholder buy-in on media strategy and results.




Work Environment

Gupta Media is an office-first organization.




Our Commitment

At Gupta Media, we work hard every day to be better at all that we do — and that includes fostering a diverse and inclusive community that encourages and respects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and ideas.




Compensation

At Gupta Media, base salary is one component of our total compensation and benefits package. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000 - $85,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan, which is based on the company's performance.




We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and pet insurance; Flexible and Dependent Care Savings Accounts; a 401(k) with up to 5% Safe Harbor contributions; paid time off; paid family leave; commuting and wellness stipends; and opportunities for professional development and career growth.




Candidates must be authorized to work in the US.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Leader Bank is looking for exceptionally dedicated team members to join one of the region’s fastest growing community banks and mortgage lenders. At the time of its founding in 2002, Leader Bank had one branch office, $6.5 million in assets and 7 team members. Since then, the Bank has become one of the most successful banks in Massachusetts with more than $5 billion in assets, 450+ team members, 7 branch offices, and annual mortgage originations of over $2 billion.

Exemplary products and an innovative spirit have driven Leader Bank’s rapid growth over the years, and our team members embrace these values. Our mission is to obsess over our clients, make them feel valued, and maintain long-term relationships with them by constantly enhancing our products and processes to always improve our client experience. For our team members, Leader Bank prioritizes competitive compensation and benefits, a healthy work-life balance, and an environment that fosters diversity and inclusion.

Summary

At Leader Bank, we recognize that data is an opportunity to create better experiences, smarter decisions, and value for our clients. As a BI Analyst, you enable stakeholders to make data-driven decisions and turn insights into action through automation.

The BI Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the Bank's enterprise reporting and analytics platform. This role bridges business reporting and data engineering by creating trusted data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and analytics solutions that empower data-driven decision-making across the organization.

The successful candidate will have deep experience with Snowflake, Retool/Power BI, Python, JavaScript, SQL, and modern data technologies. This individual will partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and technology teams to transform raw data into trusted, actionable insights while establishing scalable reporting and governance practices.

Responsibilities


Data Modeling & Analytics
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise data models, semantic layers, and analytics-ready datasets in Snowflake.
Build and maintain data dictionaries, KPI definitions, and business metrics to ensure consistency across reporting platforms.
Develop scalable reporting architectures that support operational, analytical, and executive reporting needs.
Optimize data structures, queries, and warehouse performance for BI workloads.
Reporting & Visualization
Create and maintain dashboards, workflows and self-service reporting solutions using Retool, and other BI tools.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business questions into actionable analytics.
Develop executive-level dashboards and operational reporting that provide meaningful business insights.
Ensure data visualizations are intuitive, accurate, and aligned with organizational goals.
Data Engineering & Automation
Develop and maintain ELT/ETL processes for structured and semi-structured data.
Build automated data validation, quality monitoring, and reconciliation processes.
Utilize Python, SQL, and JavaScript to automate reporting, data transformations, and analytics workflows.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to enhance data ingestion, transformation, and governance frameworks.
Governance & Quality
Establish and maintain data quality standards, validation rules, and monitoring processes.
Define and enforce data governance best practices, metadata management, and documentation standards.
Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Promote adoption of trusted data sources and standardized reporting practices.
Collaboration
Work closely with business leaders, product managers, analysts, and engineering teams.
Participate in Agile planning, estimation, and solution design activities.
Provide guidance on analytics best practices, dashboard design, and data storytelling.

Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related disciplines.
3+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake or other relational databases.
3+ years of experience building dashboards and analytics solutions using Power BI/Tableau/Retool or similar BI platforms.
Strong SQL expertise including performance optimization, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse design.
Strong Python programming experience for analytics, automation, and data processing.
Experience with JavaScript for dashboard customization, application development, and automation.
Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.
Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data quality principles.
Experience working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with dbt, Matillion or similar modern data stack technologies.
Experience working in banking, financial services, fintech, or regulated industries.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS.
Knowledge of API development and integrations.
Experience leveraging AI and machine learning tools to improve analytics and reporting.
Snowflake, Power BI, or cloud certifications.

At Leader Bank, we recognize that data is an opportunity to create better experiences, smarter decisions, and value for our clients. As a BI Analyst, you enable stakeholders to make data-driven decisions and turn insights into action through automation.

The BI Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the Bank's enterprise reporting and analytics platform. This role bridges business reporting and data engineering by creating trusted data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and analytics solutions that empower data-driven decision-making across the organization.

The successful candidate will have deep experience with Snowflake, Retool/Power BI, Python, JavaScript, SQL, and modern data technologies. This individual will partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and technology teams to transform raw data into trusted, actionable insights while establishing scalable reporting and governance practices.

Responsibilities

  • Data Modeling & Analytics
    • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise data models, semantic layers, and analytics-ready datasets in Snowflake.
    • Build and maintain data dictionaries, KPI definitions, and business metrics to ensure consistency across reporting platforms.
    • Develop scalable reporting architectures that support operational, analytical, and executive reporting needs.
    • Optimize data structures, queries, and warehouse performance for BI workloads.
  • Reporting & Visualization
    • Create and maintain dashboards, workflows and self-service reporting solutions using Retool, and other BI tools.
    • Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business questions into actionable analytics.
    • Develop executive-level dashboards and operational reporting that provide meaningful business insights.
    • Ensure data visualizations are intuitive, accurate, and aligned with organizational goals.
  • Data Engineering & Automation
    • Develop and maintain ELT/ETL processes for structured and semi-structured data.
    • Build automated data validation, quality monitoring, and reconciliation processes.
    • Utilize Python, SQL, and JavaScript to automate reporting, data transformations, and analytics workflows.
    • Collaborate with Data Engineers to enhance data ingestion, transformation, and governance frameworks.
  • Governance & Quality
    • Establish and maintain data quality standards, validation rules, and monitoring processes.
    • Define and enforce data governance best practices, metadata management, and documentation standards.
    • Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
    • Promote adoption of trusted data sources and standardized reporting practices.
  • Collaboration
    • Work closely with business leaders, product managers, analysts, and engineering teams.
    • Participate in Agile planning, estimation, and solution design activities.
    • Provide guidance on analytics best practices, dashboard design, and data storytelling.
Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related disciplines.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake or other relational databases.
  • 3+ years of experience building dashboards and analytics solutions using Power BI/Tableau/Retool or similar BI platforms.
  • Strong SQL expertise including performance optimization, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse design.
  • Strong Python programming experience for analytics, automation, and data processing.
  • Experience with JavaScript for dashboard customization, application development, and automation.
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data quality principles.
  • Experience working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.
  • Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with dbt, Matillion or similar modern data stack technologies.
  • Experience working in banking, financial services, fintech, or regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Knowledge of API development and integrations.
  • Experience leveraging AI and machine learning tools to improve analytics and reporting.
  • Snowflake, Power BI, or cloud certifications.

Description:
At MFS, you will find a culture that supports you in doing what you do best. Our employees work together to reach better outcomes, favoring the strongest idea over the strongest individual. We put people first and demonstrate care and compassion for our community and each other. Because what we do matters – to us as valued professionals and to the millions of people and institutions who rely on us to help them build more secure and prosperous futures.

THE ROLE

For a leading and rapidly growing asset management firm, the Data Management team drives accountability for, and stewardship of, data as a strategic business asset. The team brings together technical practices, workflows, cultural norms, and architectural patterns to enable rapid innovation and trusted data. Leveraging deep data expertise, the team supports effective issue resolution, improved data quality, reliable data pipelines, and transparent measurement and monitoring. In contributing to a culture of operational excellence, the Data Management team focuses on ensuring accountability for resolving data quality issues, confirming that data is fit for purpose across consumption points, and collaborating with data stakeholders to structure data and design workflows that strengthen operational outcomes. Using strong investment data and operational knowledge, the team provides superior support to investment and reporting teams and performs specialized “first response” duties related to managing and ensuring data quality, accuracy, and availability for stakeholders. This position will be part of a team of Data Analysts who directly own and are accountable for the stewardship of critical data domains, including centralized implementation, documentation, and ownership of methodology decisions. The position is based in Boston, MA, with a focus on all aspects of data management related to a multi-asset book of business supporting investment and enterprise reporting capabilities.

What You Will Do


Identify, problem solve and track investment data quality and accuracy concerns to resolution, including detecting, analyzing, and remediating root causes to complex issues.
Autonomously manage and prioritize the backlog of data quality issues and requests, incorporating stakeholder input and risk mitigation principles, for both short-term and long-term end-to-end quality remediation.
Subject matter expert on end-to-end data flows and data dependencies to track data lineage, resolve data ambiguities, and conduct data quality impact analysis.
Identify and manage the resolution path for data issues and escalate decisions and thematic challenges where appropriate to leadership. Develop broad solutions by working cross functionally with operations, technology, distribution, legal and compliance.
Provide subject matter expertise for data-related strategic initiatives to optimize data outcomes and capabilities. Includes requirements, testing, and business support for the development of data packages.
Execute data standardization activities where possible to achieve short-term resolution of issues.
Ensure data policies and standards are adhered to within stakeholder systems and reports.
Inform funding decisions with respect to data and technology needs in support of data management related requirements.
Develop and improve the Data Management team processes, manage data quality dashboards, and provide input in their design and development.
Collaborate with members of Data, Technology, and Operations to ensure consistent stewardship of data and to maintain data quality in accordance with data quality standards.
Assume additional responsibilities as required.


What We Are Looking For


Bachelor's Degree or equivalent with a major in finance, computer science, engineering, data science or related field.
6-8+ years of investment management industry experience, with preferably 7 or more years of related experience in investment data, analytics, and/or investment operations.
Strong project management and process management skills to guide point-in-time and ongoing targeted data quality improvement projects.
Proven analytical and problem-solving skills and ability to independently develop creative and scalable solutions to meet dynamic business needs.
Deep understanding of how data is used within investment and related processes and its impact on desired process outcomes.
Broad knowledge of equity and fixed income security types, including derivatives, as well as associated data methodologies and industry standards.
Strong professional judgement and communication skills across multiple levels of the organization. Demonstrated ability to form effective working relationships, be resourceful and resolve conflicts.
Experience with basic data analysis techniques such as descriptive analysis, diagnostic analysis, regression analysis, etc.
Ability to communicate at all levels of an organization.
Demonstrated ability to perform job responsibilities collaboratively as well as independently, and effectively in a fast paced and demanding environment.


Preferred Skills, Qualifications And Expereince


Snowflake, Bloomberg PORT, Charles River Investment Manager Solution, Eagle Investment Systems, Factset, Tableau &/or Power BI
Python, SQL

Title: Principal People Data Analyst
Description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

Reporting to: SVP of People Operations

Location: Boston, MA office (hybrid)

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal People Data Analytics Analyst to lead advanced people analytics and workforce insights, with Workday serving as the backbone of our people data ecosystem.

This role will be responsible for turning Workday data into strategic insights that inform workforce planning, talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee retention, compensation, and broader People strategy. In this role, you will partner closely with the People Leadership Team, HR Technology, Finance, business leaders, and other stakeholders to ensure that Workday data is trusted, well-governed, accessible, and translated into meaningful business intelligence.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in People Analytics and Workday data with strong analytical, technical, and consulting capabilities. This individual will operate as a subject-matter expert, establish analytical standards and best practices, and serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders.

Key Responsibilities


Serve as a subject-matter expert for Workday people data, including the underlying data structures, business processes, organizational hierarchies, worker data, job and position data, compensation, recruiting, talent, and other adjacent technologies.
Use Workday as the primary source and foundation for enterprise people analytics, ensuring that workforce insights are grounded in consistent and trusted data.
Develop and maintain sophisticated analytical datasets, metrics, dashboards, and reporting solutions leveraging Workday data.
Partner with HR Technology and HRIS teams to understand and optimize Workday configuration, data structures, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve Workday data quality, consistency, completeness, and usability for analytics.
Establish standardized definitions and methodologies for critical workforce metrics, using Workday as the system of record wherever appropriate.
Evaluate data flows between Workday and downstream data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, and other enterprise systems.


People Analytics & Strategic Insights


Lead high-impact analytics initiatives addressing complex workforce and business questions.
Analyze workforce data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities across the employee lifecycle.
Develop predictive and advanced analytics to support workforce planning, retention, talent management, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience.
Connect people metrics to business outcomes to help leaders understand the organizational implications of workforce trends.
Develop executive-level dashboards and data solutions that provide clear, actionable visibility into the workforce.
Translate complex analytical findings into compelling recommendations for senior People leaders and executives.


Strategic Partnership


Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior People leaders, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business executives.
Partner with HR Technology, HRIS, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Finance, and other teams to develop integrated workforce insights.
Proactively identify important workforce trends and analytical opportunities rather than relying solely on reporting requests.
Influence strategic decisions through data-driven recommendations and clear executive storytelling.
Lead analytical projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, and implementation.


Data Governance & Analytics Architecture


Help establish and maintain a trusted People data foundation centered on Workday.
Define and document enterprise people metrics, data definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards.
Partner with HR Technology and Data teams to establish appropriate data governance, lineage, quality controls, and access practices.
Identify gaps between Workday data and other enterprise data sources and develop approaches for reconciling and integrating information.
Promote responsible use of employee data, including appropriate privacy, confidentiality, security, and access controls.
Help shape the evolution of the People Analytics data architecture and technology roadmap.


Technical & Analytical Leadership


Leverage Workday reporting and analytics capabilities, including Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, composite reports, dashboards, and other relevant Workday reporting technologies.
Develop visualizations and analytical products using tools such as Visier, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to use predictive analytics, machine learning, experimentation, and other advanced methodologies to improve workforce decision-making.
Mentor analysts and provide analytical and technical guidance across the People Analytics organization.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Human Resources, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
8+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Deep experience working with Workday as a primary source of people data, including strong understanding of its data model, reporting capabilities, business processes, and organizational structures.
Strong understanding of workforce metrics, HR processes, and the employee lifecycle.
Experience translating Workday data into executive dashboards, analytical models, and strategic insights.
Experience with Workday reporting technologies such as Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and/or advanced reporting capabilities.
Experience working with downstream data warehouses, BI platforms, or enterprise data environments connected to Workday.
Strong statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to executive and non-technical audiences.
Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders.
High degree of discretion and understanding of employee data privacy, confidentiality, and governance.


Preferred Qualifications


Workday certification or significant hands-on Workday reporting experience.
Experience with Workday Prism Analytics or other Workday analytics capabilities.
Experience with Workday integrations and downstream data pipelines.
Experience integrating Workday data with Finance, Finance Planning, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, or other enterprise systems.
Experience with predictive workforce analytics, attrition modeling, workforce planning, or organizational network analysis.
Experience establishing enterprise People Analytics data governance and metric frameworks.
Experience in a complex, global, or rapidly scaling organization.


What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating a trusted, Workday-centered people data foundation that enables leaders to make faster, more informed workforce decisions.

The Principal People Analytics Analyst will ensure that Workday data is not simply reported—it is understood, connected, analyzed, and translated into strategic insight. Leaders should be able to trust the underlying data, understand what the metrics mean, and confidently use the resulting insights to make decisions about people, talent, organization, and business performance.

Core Competencies


Workday & People Data Expertise
Advanced People Analytics
Strategic Thinking
Data Architecture & Governance
Statistical & Quantitative Analysis
Executive Data Storytelling
Business Acumen
Stakeholder Influence
Data Visualization
Problem Solving
Innovation
Collaboration & Mentorship
Judgment & Discretion

Title: Senior Data Analyst TIAI
Description:
Overview

Tufts Institute for Al focuses on the intersections of Al technologies and healthy living, precision and translational medicine, human-machine interaction, and aspects of foundational Al and data science. This initiative represents an evolution of Tufts' commitment to advancing Al for Social Good and enhancing U.S. competitiveness in Al and data science.

What You'll Do

Provide support and guidance to researchers regarding data management and analysis. The data management responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, provide data management services to TIAI investigators, staff, and trainees. Training services include workshops and training for labs, core units, and trainees on data management best practices, and in data sharing and retention policies. Data management services include partnering with investigators and data scientists to develop, refine, and implement data collection and management plans; provide guidance for data collection, quality control and data cleaning; and contribute to development of plans for data close-out and codebooks, data sharing, and data retention; conduct analysis as directed by investigators and data scientists.


Data management services to TIAI investigators, staff, develop and support computational pipelines
Develop, refine, and implement data collection and management plans; provide guidance for data collection, quality control and data cleaning
Training services include workshops and training for labs, core units, and trainees on data management best practices, and in data sharing and retention policies
Conduct analysis as directed by investigators and data scientists; Set up and support analysis pipelines with proper data protection rules; Explore and qualify new tools for analysis;
Collaborate on current/future grants through participation in grant proposals, submissions, publications and presentations.


What We're Looking For

Basic Requirements:

Knowledge and experience typically acquired by:


Master's Degree MS in data science, bioinformatics, computer science
2 or more years of related experience especially in life science related areas.
Demonstrated experience building data pipelines and preparing large or complex datasets for analysis
Proficiency in Python and R.
Experience with statistical inference and machine learning applied to biological or biomedical data, and communicating results to a research audience
Experience with bioinformatics analysis of next-generation sequencing (NGS) data, including single-cell, transcriptomics, and multi-omics integration


Preferred Qualifications:


Machine learning and deep learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
Quantitative image analysis, for example microscopy, medical or radiological imaging
MLOps: workflow orchestration and experiment tracking
High-performance computing
Large language models (LLMs) or other foundation models applied to scientific or clinical text


Pay Range

Minimum $89,100.00, Midpoint $111,500.00, Maximum $133,800.00

Salary is based on related experience, expertise, and internal equity; generally, new hires can expect pay between the minimum and midpoint of the range.

Title: SIU Fraud Analyst
Description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Health Plan Holding Company, Inc.

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

Mass General Brigham Health Plan is an exciting place to be within the healthcare industry. As a member of Mass General Brigham, we are at the forefront of transformation with one of the world’s leading integrated healthcare systems. Together, we are providing our members with innovative solutions centered on their health needs to expand access to seamless and affordable care and coverage.

Our work centers on creating an exceptional member experience – a commitment that starts with our employees. Working with some of the most accomplished professionals in healthcare today, our employees have opportunities to learn and contribute expertise within a welcoming and supportive environment that embraces their unique and varied backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

We are pleased to offer competitive salaries and a benefits package with flexible work options, career growth opportunities, and much more.

The Fraud Analyst is building data analytics for MGB Health Plan's Special Investigations Unit; this role uses data analytics for the SIU to find fraud leads. This includes creating SQL queries for known fraud schemes to run against claims data, ad hoc regulatory reporting, and creating reports to support Fraud Investigators.

The ideal candidate is proficient in SQL and has a background in healthcare fraud investigations.

The role will be responsible for creating, refining, and performing various analytic reports aimed at identifying potential fraudulent, wasteful, or abusive claim submissions. In addition to performing analytics, the position will be required to conduct preliminary research of identified providers or members to include public records, contracts, and social media review, among others. The analyst will be accountable for documenting analytic and research activities within concise reports or memoranda.

Essential Functions


Develop and run reports, analyze data to identify suspicious billing patterns, assess the merits of allegations, and present those findings to leadership.
Analyze claims data to find suspicious billing patterns and outliers, using knowledge of healthcare coding conventions, fraud schemes, and general areas of vulnerabilities.
Conduct preliminary investigations to assess the merits of allegations through fact-gathering and analyses of data sets.
Organize data and document preliminary investigative steps with a high level of detail and accuracy to clearly and concisely support investigative inferences, conclusions, and recommendations.
Report discoveries of fraud or program abuse to external parties, as required by law, rule, or contract.
Receive investigative requests from field staff, internal claims associates, and underwriting.


Qualifications

Education


Bachelor's Degree


Experience


At least 2-3 years of experience investigating claims or compliance required
At least 2-3 years of experience as an analyst in healthcare, data reporting or data analysis required
Healthcare fraud experience highly preferred
Data analysis with SQL proficiency highly preferred


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong verbal/written communication skills.
Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and organizational skills.
Comprehensive knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD10-CM diagnosis, and procedure codes.
Strong aptitude for technology-based solutions.
Ability to develop, introduce, defend, and gain support for new ideas and approaches.
Ability to challenge the status quo and drive innovative thinking and the capability to successfully implement strategy.

Working Conditions


This is a hybrid role with at least one team meeting onsite per month in Somerville, MA
This is a full-time role with a Monday through Friday schedule, generally 8:30-5:00 PM Eastern Time

Title: Senior Analyst, Commercial Analytics (Digital Commerce)
Description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Analyst to join the Commercial Analytics team and serve as a key analytics partner to our Digital Commerce business. In this role, you will own analysis and reporting across our direct-to-consumer and marketplace channels, translating data into insights that inform pricing, promotions, merchandising, and product strategy. You will help us understand what drives bookings, conversion, and margin across our digital storefronts and partner closely with Marketing Analytics to connect acquisition and traffic trends to downstream commercial performance.

Responsibilities


Serve as a key analytics partner to the Digital Commerce team, analyzing performance across direct-to-consumer and marketplace channels to identify opportunities that drive bookings, conversion, and margin growth.
Own analysis of digital pricing and promotions, including incrementality, cannibalization, discount depth, and pull-forward, to inform promotional strategy and investment decisions.
Analyze funnel and conversion performance, merchandising, product mix, attach rate, and average order value to understand the drivers of digital commerce performance and identify opportunities for growth.
Own marketplace performance analysis, evaluating channel economics, assortment, pricing, and customer behavior across marketplaces and our direct-to-consumer business.
Build scalable reporting and analytical tools that give Digital Commerce leadership visibility into channel performance, partnering with Analytics Engineering to ensure data is accurate, consistent, and trusted.
Support commercial planning and forecasting by developing Digital Commerce inputs and channel-level drivers, and partner with Marketing Analytics to connect acquisition and traffic trends to downstream commercial outcomes.


Qualifications

Title: Senior Analytics Consultant
Description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Analytics Consultant coordinates with other analytics, IT and business areas across the organization to ensure work is completed with insights from knowledge SMEs. The Senior Informaticist work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

The Senior Analytics Consultant is a senior individual contributor who serves as a strategic analytics partner to business leaders. This role transforms complex pharmacy, sales, and operational data into actionable insights that inform decisions, improve performance, and drive business outcomes. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy, analytics, and technology, the Senior Analytics Consultant translates ambiguous business questions into analytical approaches, delivers decision-support solutions, and communicates the story behind the data to technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

Use your skills to make an impact


Lead complex analytical initiatives that support strategic business priorities and operational performance.
Serve as a consultative analytics partner to business leaders, helping define problems, identify opportunities, formulate hypotheses, and develop data-driven recommendations.
Independently lead analytics engagements from intake and discovery through analysis, solution development, stakeholder alignment, and delivery of business outcomes.
Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and key performance drivers.
Design and develop meaningful metrics, frameworks, dashboards, and decision-support tools.
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations tailored to executive, operational, and technical audiences.
Influence strategic decisions by providing insights that impact growth, profitability, customer outcomes, and operational efficiency.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of analytics experience or Master's degree and 3+ years of analytics experience.
Demonstrated ability to serve as a consultative analytics partner, working directly with business stakeholders to define problems, evaluate opportunities, and deliver actionable recommendations.
Experience leading projects through the full analytics lifecycle, including business intake, discovery, analysis, solution development, communication of insights, and implementation support.
Progressive experience in analytics, business intelligence, informatics, pharmacy analytics, sales analytics, or a related field.
Strong proficiency with SQL, reporting and visualization tools, and analytical methodologies.
Experience communicating insights and recommendations to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications


Advanced degree in Informatics, Analytics, Business Analytics, Healthcare Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience working with pharmacy, payer, provider, sales, or operational data.
Demonstrated intellectual curiosity and continuous learning with the ability to rapidly learn new business domains and analytical approaches.
Experience using SQL, Power BI, Databricks, Python, or similar tools to support business decision-making.


Role Clarification

This role is best suited for candidates who are energized by consultative analytics, business problem solving, and decision support. This is an individual contributor role focused on using data to solve high-impact business problems. While the role requires strong SQL skills to query, analyze, and work with large datasets, the primary focus is not pipeline development, infrastructure engineering, or software development.

40

Title: Associate Data Scientist
Description:
Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As Our Business Continues To Expand, There Is Growing Demand For More Data Science Team Members. We Are Hiring 4-6 People To Drive Impact In These Areas


Growth Marketing
Product Development
AI & Automation
Strategic Partnerships


On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here


No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.
Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.


What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.


Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.
Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.
Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.


Who You Are


First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"
Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.
Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.


What You'll Bring


1+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.
Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.
Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.
Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.


Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at recruiting@jerry.ai

Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We are a remote-first company, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

Title: Supply Chain Analyst
Description:
A World-Class Team

BJ’s Wholesale Club is powered by more than 30,000 team members who make a real impact every day. Whether you're stocking shelves, solving problems or shaping strategy, your work helps families save on what matters most.

We’re a team built on purpose and opportunity. Join us and be part of something meaningful.

Why You’ll Love Working at BJ’s

At BJ’s Wholesale Club, our team members are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being and future – both on and off the job. When you grow, we grow.

Here’s just some of what you can look forward to:


Weekly Pay: Get paid every week so that you can manage your money on your terms.
Free BJ’s Memberships: Enjoy a complimentary The Club Card Membership, plus a free Supplemental Membership for someone in your household.*
Generous Paid Time Off: Take the time you need with vacation, personal, sick days, holidays, bereavement, and jury duty leave.*
Flexible and Affordable Health Benefits: Choose from three medical plans, and access optional dental, vision, Health Savings Account (HSA), and flexible spending account options to fit your lifestyle.*
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan: Build your financial future with a company match (available to team members 18 and older).*
Employee Stock Purchase Plan: Accumulate funds through after-tax payroll deductions that can be used to purchase shares of BJ’s common stock at a 15% discount.*
Eligibility requirements vary by position.


About The Role

We are seeking a Supply Chain Analyst to join a high-impact analytics team responsible for improving operational outcomes in our Planning and Allocation team as well as the broader supply chain.

Our Supply Chain Analytics team serves as the company’s central analytics authority on inventory, the lifeblood of the company, and its movement through the supply chain. We work with stakeholders across the organization including Merchandising, Transportation, and Distribution Operations to translate complex operational data into clear insights, recommendations, and tools that drive measurable improvements.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex operational problems, partnering with business leaders, and using analytics to influence real-world outcomes at scale.

Job Responsibilities:

Your work will focus on driving business outcomes through data.

You will partner with leaders across Planning and Allocation and Supply Chain to solve high-impact operational problems involving inventory and product flow.

Typical work includes:


Building analytical tools and frameworks that guide supply chain decisions at scale
Writing SQL queries and working with large datasets to extract and analyze information
Supporting root cause analysis on operational issues (e.g., out-of-stocks, inventory imbalances, DC performance)
Assisting in the development of models, frameworks, and analyses used by the team
Translating data into clear summaries and insights for stakeholders
Ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across analyses
Learning and applying best practices in analytics, data modeling, and visualization
Your work will contribute to improving inventory productivity, supply chain efficiency, and sales across the BJ’s network.


Job Qualifications:


Curiosity: You are eager to understand how things actually work and ask thoughtful questions to get to the root of problems.
Growth Mindset: You love learning and thrive in a dynamic environment.
Communication & Collaboration: You enjoy working closely with others and communicate proactively and with clarity.
Technology & Innovation: You are excited to leverage modern analytics tools (e.g., Databricks, Tableau) to improve how decisions are made. Some technical experience through coding is highly preferred.
Experience: 0–2+ years of experience in an analytical or quantitative role (internships or academic experience relevant).
Office Environment: Hybrid position with 3-days per week in the Marlborough, MA corporate office.


This is a hybrid role. Tuesday through Thursday are in-office days at BJ's Club Support Center in Marlborough, MA and Monday and Friday are remote days.

In accordance with the Pay Transparency requirements, the following represents a good faith estimate of the compensation range for this position. At BJ’s Wholesale Club, we carefully consider a wide range of non-discriminatory factors when determining salary. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, education, experience, and qualifications. The pay range for this position is $68,500.00 - $87,500.00

We recognize the growing role of AI tools, including ChatGPT, and value familiarity with them. That said, we want to hear from your authentic self. Your application should reflect your own skills, experiences, and insights rather than AI-generated responses.

Title: Senior Analyst, Workforce Analytics
Description:
Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Workforce Analytics Analyst to provide advanced analytical support for our Contact Center Workforce Management (WFM) function.

This role will leverage workforce data, analytics, and technology to optimize staffing strategies, strengthen workforce planning, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision-making. The Senior Workforce Analytics Analyst will partner closely with HRBPs, business leaders, and cross-functional teams to translate complex workforce and operational data into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical and technical capabilities, an understanding of contact center and workforce management operations, and the ability to connect workforce insights with business needs.

Key Responsibilities

Workforce Analytics & Insights


Collect, analyze, and interpret workforce and contact center operational data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
Translate complex datasets into actionable insights that support workforce and operational decisions.
Conduct root cause analyses related to service levels, staffing, capacity, productivity, and workforce performance.
Identify emerging workforce trends and proactively recommend actions to improve operational effectiveness.
Partner with stakeholders to develop and enhance predictive models that improve workforce forecasting and planning.


Workforce Planning & Forecasting


Partner with WFM leaders to develop data-driven staffing and capacity models aligned with business objectives and operational requirements.
Provide analytical support for short- and long-term workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and intraday management.
Perform scenario modeling to evaluate the workforce implications of changes in demand, staffing, productivity, and business requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve staffing efficiency, capacity utilization, productivity, and cost management.
Support workforce forecasts and provide insights into potential staffing gaps, risks, and opportunities.


Reporting & Visualization


Develop and maintain workforce reports, dashboards, and analytical tools using SQL, Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, Workday, and other relevant technologies.
Establish and maintain accurate, consistent, and reliable workforce metrics across reporting processes and data sources.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations and executive-ready insights.
Present complex information in a concise and understandable format for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Identify opportunities to automate and improve workforce reporting and analytics.


Performance & Optimization


Define, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) related to workforce efficiency, service levels, productivity, capacity, and operational effectiveness.
Monitor performance trends and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and areas requiring intervention.
Benchmark performance against internal targets and relevant industry standards to inform workforce strategies.
Recommend process improvements that strengthen WFM operations and overall organizational effectiveness.
Measure the impact of workforce initiatives and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.


Technology & Data Enablement


Leverage Workday and workforce management/contact center platforms, including AWS Connect, NICE, Alvaria, or similar technologies, to support workforce analytics, forecasting, scheduling, reporting, and decision-making.
Utilize Workday workforce and organizational data alongside operational data sources to develop integrated workforce insights and reporting.
Utilize advanced analytics tools and enterprise data platforms to improve the accuracy, accessibility, and usability of workforce information.
Support the implementation and integration of new tools, technologies, and processes that strengthen workforce analytics capabilities.
Partner with HR, HRBPs, Technology, Operations, and business teams to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and system capabilities.
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and increase the scalability of workforce analytics.


Qualifications

Education & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Workforce Management, Business Administration, Statistics, or a related field.
Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in workforce analytics, workforce management, contact center operations, business intelligence, or a related analytical role.
Demonstrated experience using workforce data and analytics to support operational and business decision-making.
Experience working within a complex, cross-functional organization preferred.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and Excel, with experience developing dashboards, reports, and analytical models.
Experience working with Workday, including workforce, organizational, and employee data for reporting and analytics.
Experience with workforce management or contact center technologies such as AWS Connect, NICE, Alvaria, or comparable platforms.
Working knowledge of forecasting methodologies, predictive modeling, statistical analysis, and data mining.
Demonstrated ability to integrate and analyze data from multiple sources and translate complex datasets into meaningful business insights.
Experience with data visualization, reporting automation, and analytical storytelling.


Core Capabilities


Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently identify issues, analyze alternatives, and recommend solutions.
Strong business acumen and ability to connect workforce analytics with broader business and operational priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to diverse audiences.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Ability to influence decisions through data, insights, and fact-based recommendations.
Proactive and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and evolving environment.


Physical Requirements And Work Environment

This role requires the ability to perform standard office activities, including extended periods of computer use, participation in virtual and in-person meetings, and collaboration across teams. Depending on business needs, occasional travel may be required. Work environments and physical requirements may vary based on the requirements of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties and responsibilities may be modified, added, or removed as necessary to meet business and organizational needs.

Compensation

The target base salary range for this role is $90,000-$130,000 per year. This range reflects the anticipated compensation for the role. Where pay falls withing the range may vary based on many factors, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, skills, experience, education, certifications, location and applicable geographic pay zones, market conditions, internal equity and business considerations. Compensation decisions are made based on an assessment of the candidate’s qualifications and the totality of relevant factors.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in an annual short-term incentive program, subject to plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Benefits

Galderma offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid time off, and other benefits, subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms.

Work Authorization

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the United States.

What We Offer

At Galderma, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization committed to advancing dermatology and improving patient outcomes worldwide. We offer competitive compensation, annual incentive opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, along with meaningful opportunities for growth, development, and collaboration in an inclusive and innovative environment.

Next Steps


If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first virtual conversation with the recruiter.
The next step is a virtual conversation with the hiring manager
The final step is a panel conversation with the extended team


Don't meet every single requirement? At Galderma, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply anyway!

If you are considering employment at Galderma, review our job postings at www.galderma.com/us/careers. Please be aware of fraudulent job offers and individuals falsely claiming to represent our Human Resources department. Our company will never request or offer payment, personal financial information, or sensitive data (such as Social Security numbers or bank details) during the early stages of recruitment. All legitimate communications from our HR team will come from official company email domains and follow our established hiring process.
