Title: HR Platforms Reporting & Data Analyst
Description:
About The Opportunity

Job Summary

To meet the challenges of the university’s continued growth and expansion, the HR Platforms (HRIT) team is looking for a qualified candidate who will contribute to the support and data analytics of Workday HCM. This is a hybrid position; required to be ON CAMPUS Mon, Tues, Thurs, Fri (Wed is remote).

The HR Platforms (HRIT) Reporting & Data Analyst serves as a key data and reporting resource within HR Platforms, partnering with HR functional areas, Payroll, Finance, and college/division HR stakeholders to understand complex business requirements and deliver accurate, meaningful workforce data and analytics.

This role requires a strong understanding of Workday HCM and Payroll business processes, particularly within the complexities of a decentralized higher education environment with diverse employee populations, organizational structures, and business practices.

The Reporting & Data Analyst translates business needs into effective reporting and analytical solutions, developing and maintaining Workday reports, SQL queries, and other data solutions. The role analyzes complex datasets to identify trends, discrepancies, anomalies, and data integrity issues; investigates root causes; and provides insights that support operational and strategic decision-making.

This position also partners closely with HR Platforms Business Systems Analysts and other technical and functional teams to test, validate, and resolve data and reporting issues.

Success in this role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, expert proficiency in Excel, proficiency in SQL, attention to detail, and a naturally curious mindset. The successful candidate will be comfortable asking questions, challenging data that does not appear correct, investigating complex issues, and translating analytical findings into clear, actionable information for both technical and non-technical audiences. The role requires sound judgment, initiative, strong customer service skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines in a high-volume environment while maintaining confidentiality and the highest standards of data integrity.

Key Responsibilities Include


Partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, and college/division HR stakeholders to understand complex business requirements and translate data needs into accurate, sustainable reporting and analytical solutions.
Develop, maintain, and enhance reports and queries using Workday HCM/Payroll, Prism, SQL, Excel, and other reporting and analytical tools.
Analyze and reconcile complex HR and Payroll datasets to identify trends, anomalies, discrepancies, and data integrity issues and investigate root causes.
Collaborate with HR Platforms Business Systems Analysts and other technical and functional partners on requirements, testing, validation, system changes, and resolution of data and reporting issues.



To support the University's essential services and business operations, this position may occasionally be required to work outside of regular business hours, including during critical system activities, reporting deadlines, or other periods of operational need.

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Human Resources, Data Analytics, or a related field required.
3–5 years of progressive experience in HR data analytics, HR systems, reporting, or a related field, with demonstrated experience analyzing complex HR and payroll data.
Strong understanding of Workday HCM and Payroll business processes, including the ability to understand how transactions, business processes, organizational structures, compensation, time, absence, payroll, and employee lifecycle events impact downstream data and reporting.
Experience with Workday reporting across HCM and Payroll, including developing, maintaining, interpreting, and troubleshooting reports and identifying opportunities to improve reporting accuracy and effectiveness.
Higher education HR and Payroll experience is strongly preferred, with an understanding of the unique organizational structures, academic populations, employee types, appointments, positions, grants/funding, faculty/staff populations, and other complexities common to higher education.
Expert proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas/functions, pivot tables, lookups, data cleansing, conditional logic, data validation, reconciliation, and analysis of large and complex datasets. Experience using Excel to identify trends, anomalies, discrepancies, and data-quality issues is highly desirable.
Proficiency in SQL, with the ability to query, join, filter, aggregate, and analyze complex datasets across multiple tables and data sources.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a naturally curious mindset and the ability to recognize when data does not make sense and independently investigate the underlying issue, ask insightful questions, identify patterns and anomalies, determine root causes, and translate findings into meaningful business insights.
Demonstrated ability to work with large, complex, and sensitive HR and Payroll datasets, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, completeness, consistency, and confidentiality.
Experience with data reconciliation and validation, including comparing data across Workday and downstream systems, identifying discrepancies, researching root causes, and partnering with functional and technical teams to resolve issues.
Ability to translate complex HR and Payroll business requirements into meaningful reporting and data solutions, including gathering requirements, understanding the underlying business need, and recommending appropriate reporting or analytical approaches.
Experience with data management, reporting governance, documentation, testing, and systems changes, including developing test plans and test cases and validating the impact of system changes on data and reporting.
Workday Prism Analytics experience preferred, particularly experience working with multiple data sources and complex datasets.
Experience with Cognos or other enterprise reporting/analytics tools preferred.
Ability to interpret and communicate data clearly, translating complex analysis and technical findings into concise, actionable information for HR leadership, functional partners, and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, with the ability to recognize when data does not make sense and independently investigate the underlying issue.
Strong customer-service and consulting mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, clarify ambiguous requests, provide thoughtful recommendations, and deliver high-quality reporting and analytical solutions.
Self-starter with strong initiative and sound judgment, capable of working independently while knowing when to escalate issues or engage appropriate technical and functional partners.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-volume environment, organize work effectively, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing business and project requirements.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with technical and non-technical audiences at all levels of the organization.
Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to partner effectively across HR, Payroll, HR Technology, IT, and other university functions.
Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee, HR, and Payroll information with discretion and in accordance with university policies and data-security requirements.
Commitment to continuous improvement, with the ability to identify opportunities to automate, simplify, improve data quality, and enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of HR reporting and analytics.



Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

Reporting and Analytics


Develop, maintain, and enhance Workday HCM and Payroll reports and SQL queries to meet complex HR, Payroll, operational, compliance, and business requirements.
Analyze complex HR and Payroll data from Workday and other data sources to identify trends, anomalies, data-quality issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
Serve as a reporting and data analytics subject matter expert for HR and Payroll, providing expertise to troubleshoot reporting issues, investigate discrepancies, and determine root causes.
Partner with HR and Payroll stakeholders to understand business needs and translate requirements into effective reporting and analytical solutions, recommending the most appropriate reporting approach or data source.
Provide advanced Excel-based analysis and data reconciliation, including analyzing large datasets, identifying discrepancies, validating results, and developing meaningful insights for HR leadership and business partners.
Develop and support ad-hoc and standardized reporting capabilities that enable HR users and leadership to access timely, accurate, and actionable workforce information.
Evaluate existing Workday reports and the report library to identify opportunities to leverage, enhance, consolidate, or retire existing reports and reduce redundant reporting.
Establish and maintain reporting documentation, including report definitions, data sources, business logic, calculations, dependencies, and intended use to support consistency and knowledge sharing.
Support reporting testing and validation associated with Workday releases, system changes, integrations, and business process changes, ensuring data and reporting outcomes remain accurate.
Develop, analyze, and deliver recurring workforce metrics and reporting packages, including quarterly metrics and other HR leadership reporting, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and meaningful interpretation of results.
Monitor and promote data quality and reporting integrity, partnering with HR, Payroll, and technical teams to research and resolve data discrepancies and reporting issues.
Provide reporting guidance, training, and support to HR users, helping users understand available reporting capabilities, interpret report results, and use data appropriately for decision-making.
Serve as a resource for HR staff and leadership on Workday reporting capabilities, including advising on report design, data availability, appropriate use of Workday data, and limitations of reporting outputs.
Identify opportunities to improve, automate, and streamline reporting processes, leveraging Workday, SQL, Excel, Prism, Cognos, and other available technologies.



Data Integrity & Security


Monitor, analyze, and validate HR and Payroll data across Workday and related systems, developing and executing audit queries to proactively identify data quality issues, anomalies, and inconsistencies.
Reconcile HR and Payroll data across Workday, integrations, and downstream systems, investigating discrepancies and partnering with functional and technical teams to identify root causes and implement resolutions.
Support data integrity audits, testing, and controls associated with HR systems, integrations, releases, and business process changes, ensuring accurate, complete, and reliable data.
Protect the confidentiality and security of sensitive HR and Payroll data, adhering to University policies and data governance standards while identifying and escalating potential privacy, security, or access concerns.



Training/Communications


Develop and deliver training to HR and Payroll users on Workday reporting, data analysis, and related reporting tools and capabilities.
Develop, update, and maintain user guides, training materials, job aids, and other documentation to support effective and consistent use of Workday reporting and analytics.
Develop and maintain a centralized library of standard reports and reporting documentation, including report purpose, data definitions, business logic, and intended use.
Communicate reporting changes, new capabilities, and data insights to HR stakeholders and provide guidance to help users effectively interpret and utilize HR and Payroll data.



Position Type

Human Resources

Additional Information

Northeastern University considers factors such as candidate work experience, education and skills when extending an offer.

Northeastern has a comprehensive benefits package for benefit eligible employees. This includes medical, vision, dental, paid time off, tuition assistance, wellness & life, retirement- as well as commuting & transportation. Visit https://hr.northeastern.edu/benefits/ for more information.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Compensation Grade/Pay Type

111S

Expected Hiring Range

$87,785.00 - $123,998.75

With the pay range(s) shown above, the starting salary will depend on several factors, which may include your education, experience, location, knowledge and expertise, and skills as well as a pay comparison to similarly-situated employees already in the role. Salary ranges are reviewed regularly and are subject to change.

Job Description:

Job Description

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

This job is responsible for leading analytical work efforts for projects within the consumer and small business product space. Key responsibilities include leveraging databases to acquire client, product, and performance data; transforming data into meaningful insights and trends; and delivering recommendations that support business and product decisions. Job expectations include partnering with marketing, product, and technology teams to translate questions into analytical approaches, define and monitor key performance indicators, evaluate product adoption and outcomes, and communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities


Sources, integrates, and transforms data across relational and non-relational platforms using SQL, Python, Spark/Scala, SAS, and other analytical tools to create meaningful measures, insights, and reusable analytical outputs.
Translates business and product questions into analytical frameworks and applies quantitative, segmentation, behavioral, and test-and-learn techniques to develop actionable recommendations.
Evaluates product performance and customer journeys by defining and monitoring metrics related to adoption, usage, engagement, retention, attrition, customer outcomes, and business impact.
Partners across product, marketing, technology, data product management, governance, and business teams to clarify requirements, align priorities, support data product adoption, and deliver agreed outcomes.
Communicates complex analytical findings to technical, non-technical, and senior audiences through clear data storytelling, visualizations, and actionable recommendations using tools such as PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Tableau.
Validates data and analytical outputs, resolves or escalates inconsistencies, and follows documentation, control, governance, and business-continuity requirements to support trusted data and consistent metrics.
Leads complex analytical initiatives, manages competing priorities to achieve outcomes, and supports the development of people and team capabilities.


Skills


Application Development
Business Analytics
Product Analytics
Data and Trend Analysis
Data Mining
Data Visualization
Business Intelligence
Data Quality Management
Quality Assurance
Technical Troubleshooting
Analytical Thinking
Business Acumen
Innovative Thinking
Continuous Improvement
Collaboration
Presentation Skills


Desired Qualifications


Ability to source, integrate, transform, and validate data from multiple systems of record using modern data tools and techniques.
Experience in product analytics, customer analytics, marketing analytics, portfolio analytics, or business performance analytics.
Experience evaluating product performance, customer engagement, customer journeys, and business outcomes, including adoption, usage, retention, and attrition.
Ability to define and track key performance indicators, develop practical measurement frameworks, and assess business impact.

Title: Analyst
Description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About The Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential Team Placements Include


Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.


About The Role

As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

What You Will Do


Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.
Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.
Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.
Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.
AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.


What We Look For


1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.
Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.
Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.


Pay Grade - I

Equity Grade - 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $115,000 - $165,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:


Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.


We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. The Enterprise Intelligence (EI) team is involved in every aspect of data at EA, using it to deliver valuable insights and solutions for game teams and players. We drive strategy, build data and AI tools, and support personalization, experimentation, and analytics. Join D&I to work with experts dedicated to improving understanding, workflows, and player experiences.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our analytics team supporting a high-definition title in development. In this hybrid role based in Vancouver, you’ll collaborate with product managers, engineers, and quality teams to enhance development quality, product stability and drive business outcomes through data. Reporting to the Manager of Analytics, you’ll use your expertise to inform strategic decisions across product optimization, technology, testing, and overall quality.

What You'll Do


Communicate with studio stakeholders to identify opportunities where data can better support decision making
Work with partners to define the right questions to ask and the right data to use, helping embed data in daily decision-making
Present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
Build dashboards, reports, and visualisations that help stakeholders make better, faster decisions
Contribute to the development of predictive models and other applications of machine learning that personalise player experiences or support product decisions
Explore and apply generative AI tools to increase the efficiency of your own work and support scalable insights


What You'll Bring


4+ years of experience in data analysis or applied analytics, in gaming, mobile apps, or other digital products
Proficiency in SQL for querying large datasets; experience with analysis and modelling in Python or R
Experience with visualisation tools such as Looker, PowerBI
Ability to translate business needs into technical data requirements
Experience with or interest in using machine learning and generative AI tools to support analytics or player insights
You will use storytelling to convert business objectives into analytical questions, and communicate results with practical recommendations and actionable steps.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. Title: Senior Data Analyst, Autodesk Education
Description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100787

Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Canada based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $80,000 and $117,700. JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.

As a member of the Data Analyst team, your primary responsibilities will be to identify, collect, process, and analyze datasets to help make informed business decisions. You will also assist with data analysis assignments, projects, visualization tasks, data quality improvements, and troubleshooting of data incidents.

YOUR IMPACT


Discover, acquire, explore, prepare, assess and maintain datasets from internal data sources to support analyses and ad-hoc investigative requests for projects which are function/business unit specific
Under limited supervision, responsible for data analysis assignments, projects, visualization tasks, data quality improvements, and troubleshooting of data incidents, including resolution of root causes.
Apply skills in SQL and statistical techniques to the acquisition, enrichment, and analysis of data.
Resolve incidents, changes, problems, tasks, and demands
Applies knowledge of process, people, product, data, and systems of related business functions within at least one business unit
Define Business Problems & Opportunities
Define Relevant Dimensions & Measures
Collaborating with Data Engineers, draft and test data views to meet business needs for projects
Collaborating with Data Scientists, learn and align on basic understanding of predictive and prescriptive analytics, as well as machine learning and artificial intelligence
Provide Data to Confirm Problems & Opportunities
Draft Goals, Roles, and Sustainment Plans
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. scientists, data engineers, business operations support, consultants) on data needs for solutions which may be projects focused on a single business function within a single business unit (Limited Complexity)
Apply technical writing and verbal communication skills to assist in the change management (e.g. training instructions) and on-going management of data solutions.
Actively participate in Function/Business Unit/Digital Technology Analytics Communities of Practice
Assist business' citizen analysts in building views and in analyzing, interpreting, and communicating data insights.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent.
Three (3) or more years of experience in Data Analysis, Information Technology, or in a related area.
Experience and proficiency with various web-based software applications including Power Bi Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
Ability to travel 20%



Standout Qualifications


Experience in data analysis, analytics
Attention to detail, problem solving, and decision-making skills.
Analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
Experience and proficiency with various web-based software applications including Power Bi Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
Experience and proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, and/or C#

This role is primarily performed in a professional office environment with standard lighting, ventilation, and temperature-controlled settings.
Duties are largely sedentary, requiring extended periods of sitting and using a computer and telephone.
Visual acuity to operate a computer and read documents is required, along with auditory ability to participate in virtual and in-person meetings.
Occasional movement within the office environment is necessary, including walking short distances, standing, or reaching for files.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role

As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence organization, you will turn operational and customer data into actionable reports and dashboards that drive business decisions. You will partner directly with internal business teams, such as sales compensation, to gather reporting requirements, document technical specifications, and build user friendly data assets.

Your primary hands-on work will involve writing SQL views and building dashboards directly within Databricks using data populated by our engineering team. A key aspect of this role is context engineering, where you will add structured descriptions and metadata to tables, views, and columns so that our data is easily discoverable and accurately queried by AI tools like Claude. Additionally, you will validate report accuracy, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation of your reporting logic to ensure long-term reliability.

Your Opportunity


You will have the opportunity to build and scale the business reporting layer within Databricks.
You will be part of a globally distributed team of data professionals.
This role is designed for someone who wants to grow their analytical skills in a collaborative, business facing environment.
Leverage modern AI coding agents, such as Databricks' Genie or Claude, to assist in writing and optimizing your queries.


What You'll Need


2 to 4 years of experience in a business intelligence, reporting, or data analyst role.
To be considered for this role, you must meet one of the following criteria: Hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Columbia, MD office three days a week, or hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Boston, MA office three days a week.
Fundamental working proficiency in SQL, including an understanding of select statements, order of operations, joins, aggregations, and filtering.
Basic to working proficiency with Databrick, a comparable lakehouse, or cloud data platform such as Snowflake.
Experience building dashboards and presenting data visually using tools like Databricks native dashboards, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical business stakeholders and translate them into usable data assets.
A detail oriented mindset with comfort in documenting data objects, definitions, and logic for downstream users.


And Ideally


Prior experience writing table and column descriptions or metadata to support data catalogs, semantic layers, or natural language query tools.
Exposure to Python or PySpark within Databricks notebooks, which will give you a significant advantage for career progression on this specific team.
Familiarity with analytics engineering practices, such as dbt, or version control systems like Git.
Experience working in enterprise software, SaaS, or cybersecurity environments.


This is the base pay range for this position. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. Tenable also offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits which include: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) retirement savings with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; an employee referral program; flexible spending accounts; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); education assistance; parental leave; paid time off (PTO); company-paid holidays; health and wellness events; and community programs.

US Pay Range

$72,500—$96,500 USD

We’re committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable - through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact Recruiting@Tenable.com for further assistance.

Tenable is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Depending on your location, one or more of the following notices may apply to you:

General Applicant Privacy Notice

California Applicant Privacy Notice

Title: Data Analyst (Remote Opportunity in Knoxville, TN)
Description:
Description

University Health Network (UHN) is hiring a Data Analyst to work in the growing field of Healthcare Value Based Care. This position offers a hybrid work from home option for employees who meet performance requirements. Candidate must reside in the Knoxville, Tennessee metropolitan area and be able to commute to the corporate office located in Knoxville, TN when needed. Candidate must be able to maintain HIPAA privacy requirements when working in a home office setting.

University Health Network is a clinically integrated network and manages University Health ACO, LLC (an accountable care organization). We work in partnership with the University of Tennessee Medical Center, University Physicians’ Association (UPA), area physicians, and commercial and Medicare insurance companies. We strive to deliver the healthcare triple aim: Better care for individuals, better health for populations, and lowering growth in expenditures.

Benefits Include


Remote Work Opportunity
Medical (including HDHP options), Dental, Vision, Life Insurance
FSA and HSA with employer contribution
Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave
Onsite Fitness Center
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
401K Match with Immediate Vesting


Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The Data Analyst is a full-time position that is responsible for analyzing large sets of data from multiple sources. The Data Analyst creates and validates multiple weekly and monthly end user reports. They will also monitor process performance, satisfaction of our customers, and identify improvements in data collection that will better meet the needs of the department. Experience with SQL, Python, Power BI, and ETL processes is highly desired. This position reports to the Manager of Data Analytics.

Requirements


BS in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Management, Statistics, or relevant field desired.
Proven working experience as a data analyst or similar role required. Will consider education in lieu of work experience.
Proficiency in programming languages including SQL and Python.
Proficiency using data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Familiarity with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes desired.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description & Responsibilities

Persistent Systems is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team in our New York City headquarters. The Data Analyst will transform complex operational, financial, customer, product, and program data into accurate, timely, and actionable insights. This role will build trusted datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and analyses that help leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, manage risk, and make evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined problem solver and an effective "data translator" who can move comfortably between business questions and technical details. They combine strong SQL, data preparation, visualization, statistical reasoning, and stakeholder communication skills with a sharp eye for data quality and user experience.

Position Responsibilities


Own analytical work from requirements discovery and source-data assessment through transformation, modeling, validation, visualization, delivery, and ongoing support
Partner with leaders and subject-matter experts across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Product, and other functions to define key performance indicators (KPIs), reporting logic, and success measures
Develop reliable, reusable analytics assets and clear documentation so that metrics, assumptions, transformations, and data lineage can be understood and maintained
Apply statistical and analytical methods appropriate to the business question, communicate uncertainty and limitations, and distinguish correlation from evidence of causation
Promote secure, governed, accessible, and responsible use of data while improving self-service analytics across the organization
Design, build, and maintain intuitive dashboards, scorecards, semantic models, and recurring reports using Power BI as the primary platform and Tableau where appropriate
Write, review, and optimize complex SQL queries across relational databases, cloud warehouses, and Lakehouse platforms; reconcile results to source systems and explain query logic
Clean, profile, map, join, and transform structured and semi-structured data using Power Query, Python/pandas, spreadsheets, and related tools; design fact and dimension models using star-schema principles
Build or contribute to repeatable extraction, transformation, and loading workflows using frameworks and platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, and Databricks; monitor failures and document lineage
Analyze historical and current data to identify trends, drivers, anomalies, risks, and opportunities; perform segmentation, variance analysis, forecasting, cohort analysis, and experiment analysis when relevant
Create validation rules, reconciliations, exception reporting, and quality checks; investigate discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate durable fixes with data owners and engineering teams
Translate open-ended questions into measurable definitions, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and analytics plans; establish consistent KPI definitions and a shared business glossary
Reduce manual reporting through scheduled refreshes, parameterized workflows, Power Automate, reusable templates, and governed self-service datasets
Present concise findings and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences, using accessible visual design and clear narrative rather than relying on charts alone
Support embedded or custom analytics experiences using JavaScript visualization libraries and component-based charting tools such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, Chart.js, and shadcn/ui chart components
Explore responsible uses of Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and generative AI frameworks to accelerate discovery, natural-language analytics, documentation, and workflow assistance while validating outputs against trusted data


Job Qualifications & Experience

Minimum Qualifications


2–5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related role
Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, finance, computer science, information systems, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
Advanced proficiency in SQL, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregation, query validation, and performance-aware analysis
Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modeling, interactive report design, refresh strategies, workspace management, and row-level security; comparable Tableau depth is also valued
Advanced spreadsheet skills and practical experience reconciling, cleaning, and validating data from multiple sources
Working knowledge of dimensional data modeling, KPI design, data dictionaries, ETL/ELT concepts, and source-to-target mapping
Experience using Python with pandas and/or R for data manipulation, exploratory analysis, or statistical work
Understanding of descriptive statistics, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and common analytical pitfalls
Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, manage multiple priorities, communicate findings clearly, and influence decisions with evidence
Must have a United States Security Clearance or be able to obtain a United States Security Clearance


Relevant Certifications Or Credentials, Such As


Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)
Tableau Certified Data Analyst
Tableau Desktop Specialist certification
Experience operating in a regulated, security-sensitive, government, or defense-adjacent environment


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with ETL/ELT frameworks and orchestration platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, Databricks, or comparable tools
Experience building solutions with Power Platform, Power Apps, and Power Automate, including governed connections to enterprise data
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry for secure AI-assisted analytics, agent experiences, or workflow augmentation
Familiarity with generative AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex and the ability to identify appropriate, verifiable analytics use cases
Experience with JavaScript visualization libraries such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, or Chart.js, including shadcn/ui chart components built on Recharts
Experience with cloud data warehouses or Lakehouse platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift
Experience with Git, analytics testing, version-controlled SQL or semantic models, CI/CD, and collaborative development practices
Experience with data catalogs, lineage, access controls, sensitivity labels, or governance platforms such as Microsoft Purview
Experience designing experiments, performing A/B test analysis, building forecasts, or applying regression and other classical statistical methods


The total compensation for this role can vary from $133,000 to $166,000 a year based on individual qualifications. Eligibility for yearly discretionary bonus. Persistent Systems, LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; paid time off (sick time and vacation time); flexible spending accounts; 401(k) plan with company match; fitness membership reimbursement; tuition assistance; mental health benefits; and pet discounts.

Company Overview

Headquartered in New York City since 2007, Persistent Systems, LLC is a global communications technology company which develops, manufactures, and integrates a patented and secure Mobile Ad Hoc Networking (MANET) system: Wave Relay®. The company’s industry leading R&D team has designed wireless networking protocols to support their cutting-edge Wave Relay® system and technology. Wave Relay® is capable of running data, video, voice and other applications under the most difficult and unpredictable conditions. Their suite of products is field proven and utilized in Commercial, Military, Government, Industrial, Agriculture, Robotics, and Unmanned System markets.

Title: Rural Health Data Analyst
Description:
At the Illinois Primary Health Care Association, we educate, empower and advocate for Illinois’ community health centers so every person across the state can access the cutting-edge, compassionate care they need. We are searching for a Rural Health Data Analyst to support rural healthcare transformation initiatives through data collection, analysis, reporting, and performance measurement.




This position works with rural healthcare providers and internal teams to translate healthcare data into actionable insights that improve quality outcomes, support population health management, strengthen program evaluation efforts, and inform strategic decision-making. The Rural Health Data Analyst assists with developing dashboards, monitoring key performance indicators, identifying trends, and ensuring data integrity across multiple healthcare and grant-funded initiatives.




Duties:

• Collect, validate, clean, and analyze healthcare and programmatic data from multiple sources, including:

o Electronic Health Records (EHRs)

o Practice Management Systems

o Health Information Exchanges (HIEs)

o Claims and billing systems

o Population health platforms

o Surveys and program databases

• Analyze healthcare utilization, quality metrics, and operational performance indicators.

• Identify trends, patterns, disparities, and opportunities for improvement.

• Conduct ad hoc analyses to support program initiatives and organizational decision-making.

• Develop and maintain routine and ad hoc reports for leadership, stakeholders, and participating organizations.

• Create interactive dashboards and visualizations using reporting and business intelligence tools.

• Work with the project evaluation team to ensure data reporting supports programmatic needs.

• Monitor key metrics such as:

o Clinical quality measures

o Preventive screening rates

o Chronic disease outcomes

o Behavioral health integration measures

o Access and utilization metrics

o Value-based performance measures

• Present findings in a clear and understandable manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Support data reporting requirements for state and federal programs.

• Provide comparative analysis using project specific metrics and the Uniform Data System (UDS)

annual reports.

• Support program evaluations and continuous quality improvement initiatives.

• Collaborate with Rural Health Practice Transformation Coach and other program staff to

monitor project progress.

• Provide technical assistance regarding data interpretation and reporting.

• Develop educational materials, toolkits, and resources.

• Build strong relationships with healthcare providers, administrators, and community partners.




Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, Statistics,

Data Science, Computer Science, Epidemiology, or related field. Preference given to graduate

level applications.

• Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in healthcare data analysis, reporting or program

evaluation.

• Experience working with healthcare datasets and reporting systems.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, SQL, Data Visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.




Valued Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Knowledge of healthcare quality improvement and population health concepts.

• Understanding of healthcare data structures and clinical workflows.

• Ability to interpret healthcare regulations and reporting requirements.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

• Ability to communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.

• Knowledge of HIPAA and data privacy requirements.




Other Necessary Skills and Abilities:

• Must be able to work in a fast-paced diverse workplace in a team environment.

• Must be able to present a business image to people who have diverse interests and ideas.

• Must be able to travel and attend meetings as requested, including some overnight stays.

• Must be able to work independently.

• Must have a valid Illinois driver’s license.

• Must be able to use your own automobile and have all liability and other automobile insurance

as required by law.




Physical Requirements and Work Environment:

The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Work is performed in a normal office environment with remote working options available. While performing the duties of this job employee will be sitting at a desk for extended periods of time. May be required to lift up to 15 pounds at times.




Full-time, Exempt

Pay: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Springfield, IL 62704




Benefits:

Dental insurance
Employee assistance program
Flexible spending account
Health insurance
Health savings account
Life insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Professional development assistance
Retirement plan
Vision insurance




Additional Information:

We are a proud participant in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security’s E‑Verify program. All new hires will be required to complete the Form I‑9 and have their employment eligibility confirmed through E‑Verify.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
PartsSource is the leading technology and software platform for managing mission-critical healthcare equipment. Trusted by over 5,000 US hospitals and 15,000 clinical sites, PartsSource empowers providers and service organizations to maximize clinical availability for patient care and automates the procurement of parts, services and training through a unique digital experience.

PartsSource team members are deeply committed to our mission of Ensuring Healthcare is Always On®, which is foundational to our success and growth. Our vibrant culture is built upon aligned values, shared ownership, mutual respect, and a passion for collaborating to solve complex customer problems.

About The Job Opportunity

The Data Analyst supports PartsSource's growth and operational excellence by transforming raw data into actionable insights. Working with business stakeholders across sales, operations, product, and finance, you will conduct detailed analyses on customer behavior, operational metrics, and business opportunities—identifying patterns, trends, and optimization opportunities. This role combines technical data skills with business acumen to answer complex questions, support strategic decisions, and uncover new value creation opportunities. You'll develop repeatable analytical processes, document findings clearly for diverse audiences, and stay curious about how emerging tools—including AI—can enhance analytical quality and efficiency.

What You'll Do

Data Preparation & Analysis


Extract, clean, and organize data from multiple sources to prepare datasets for analysis.
Conduct detailed quantitative analyses to identify patterns, trends, and insights that address specific business questions.
Use SQL to query databases and retrieve data; apply Excel and visualization tools to explore and communicate findings.
Validate analytical work for accuracy and completeness; document methodologies and assumptions clearly.


Reporting & Communication


Develop clear, compelling reports and dashboards that translate complex findings into actionable recommendations for business stakeholders.
Prepare written summaries of analytical findings with clear explanations of methodology, assumptions, and business implications.
Present analyses and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership, tailoring communication to audience and context.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand analytical needs and define scope for data projects.


Process Improvement & Tool Development


Identify opportunities to streamline analytical workflows and reduce manual work through better processes or automation.
Create and document repeatable analysis templates, queries, and workflows that enable consistent output and knowledge sharing across the team.
Stay current with emerging analytical tools and methodologies, including practical applications of AI; experiment with new approaches to enhance efficiency and insight quality.
Support team members in understanding analytical methodologies and best practices.


Cross-Functional Partnership


Work with sales, operations, product, and finance teams to understand their analytical needs and deliver insights that support business decisions.
Translate between technical analytical concepts and business language to ensure clarity and alignment.
Contribute ideas for how data and analytics can create competitive advantage across PartsSource's business.


What You'll Bring

Your Background


Bachelor's degree in data science, mathematics, economics, business, engineering, or a related quantitative field.
2–4 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis, financial analysis, or similar analytical roles.
Proficiency with SQL for data extraction and query writing; demonstrated ability to work with relational databases.
Strong Excel skills including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, data visualization, and analysis.
Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches; comfort working with ambiguity and defining scope.
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple analytical projects with competing priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain analytical findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
Intellectual curiosity about data, analytics, and emerging tools; self-starter who learns new methodologies independently.


Preferred


Experience with Python or R for data manipulation and statistical analysis.
Familiarity with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI) or BI platforms.
Experience in SaaS, healthcare, or subscription/managed service business models.
Hands-on experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) and understanding of how they can enhance analytical work.
Experience developing dashboards or creating repeatable analytical processes.


Who We Want to Meet

Act Like an Owner

You take responsibility for the accuracy and quality of your analyses. You validate your work, document your methodologies clearly, and follow through on analytical commitments. Accountability & Execution, Results Driven

When data doesn't tell a clear story or you uncover an unexpected pattern, you dig deeper rather than accepting surface-level interpretations. Accountability & Execution, Curiosity & Problem Solving

Serve with Purpose

You understand that your analysis supports business decisions that impact PartsSource's customers and strategy. You bring analytical rigor and integrity to every project. Clear & Critical Thinking, Active Listening

You communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical audiences, translating complexity into actionable insights that resonate with business stakeholders. Relationship Management, Communication

Adapt to Thrive

You learn new tools, methodologies, and analytical approaches independently and apply feedback constructively to improve your work. Learning Agility, Resilience

You're curious about how emerging tools like AI can enhance your analytical processes, and you actively experiment with new approaches to improve efficiency and insight quality. Learning Agility, Innovation

Collaborate to Win

You work effectively with cross-functional teams, asking clarifying questions to understand business needs and tailoring your analysis and communication to different audiences. Team Orientation, Alignment & Cohesion

You document your work and share knowledge with teammates, creating repeatable processes that amplify the team's impact. Collaboration, Continuous Improvement

Challenge the Status Quo

You notice when analytical processes are inefficient and bring ideas for how to streamline workflows, reduce manual work, or improve consistency across analyses. Curiosity & Problem Solving, Continuous Improvement

You ask why certain questions matter to the business and propose new analytical approaches that create value. Initiative, Critical Thinking

Benefits & Perks 


Competitive compensation package with salary, incentives, company ownership/equity, and comprehensive benefits (401k match, health, college debt reduction, and more!)
Career and professional development through training, coaching and new experiences.
Hybrid culture with new & beautiful workspaces that balance flexibility, collaboration, and productivity.
Inclusive and diverse community of passionate professionals learning and growing together.


 

Interested? 

We’d love to hear from you! Submit your resume and an optional cover letter explaining why you’d be a great fit.

Since 2001, PartsSource has evolved into the leading technology and software platform for managing mission-critical equipment, serving over half of the U.S. hospital infrastructure. Our digital systems modernize and automate the procurement of parts, services, technical support, and training for HTM professionals to efficiently and effectively maintain their mission-critical equipment. PartsSource employs over 700 employees nationwide that committed to supporting healthcare providers and ensuring healthcare always on.

In 2021, Bain Capital invested in the business, further accelerating our growth and positive impact within the healthcare industry.
